# korbat transparency and automation (3d) — Task 1 of 10: The quarantine: sealed files moved out of the image store and back by a one-shot service with no network and no database, recorded line by line, with their counts, a seal's custody, the lost file's end and its notices.

You are executing one task of an approved implementation plan. Every file and command below was executed and verified on 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-20 in a scratch clone of this repository, with the exact versions named. Your job is transcription and verification, not design. Do this task completely, verify it, commit it, and report.

## Project context

Task 1 of sub-project 3d (transparency and automation), the first of its eight tasks and a batch end, following docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-transparency-automation-3d-design.md, sections 5 (The services), 6.1, 7.1, 8.2, 8.4, 8.10, 9.6, 10.1 to 10.5, 12.1 rows 13 to 15, 13 (Task 1) and W.7, W.8 and W.11. It builds the quarantine of sealed image files that the release of Task 2 rests on: the files of a seal for good leave the API's and the worker's reach, their moves are recorded, and a file found in neither place has an end its author is told.

### Create `apps/admin/test/custody.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { QUARANTINE_RULES, type CaseDecision, type CaseView, type StaffOverview } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { CUSTODY_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { CustodyLines, OverviewView } from "../src/screens/Home";
import { bothTimes } from "../src/ui";
import { decision, frozenCase, NO_STANDING, overview } from "./case-fixtures";

/**
 * The quarantine on the console (3d design, sections 8.1, 8.2 and 8.4; Task 1), server-rendered: Home's [home.quarantine]
 * in the block "Sealed files and programs", with its addition once the oldest due move is older than the alert's
 * threshold; and a seal for good's custody on its case: [case.custody.in] with and without the files that are still in
 * the store, [case.custody.return], and [case.custody.lost] in its two forms. Every number comes from the answer or a
 * constant, and nothing names a file.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const text = (out: string) =>
  out
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replaceAll("&quot;", '"')
    .replaceAll("&#x27;", "'")
    .replaceAll("&lt;", "<")
    .replaceAll("&gt;", ">")
    .replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const noop = () => undefined;
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-18T12:00:00.000Z").getTime();
const hoursBefore = (hours: number) => new Date(NOW - hours * 3_600_000).toISOString();

const base: Omit<CaseScreenViewProps, "caseId" | "view"> = {
  shownImage: null,
  busy: null,
  notice: null,
  error: null,
  note: "",
  reveal: null,
  onOpenCase: noop,
  onShowImage: noop,
  onShowClearly: noop,
  onHideImage: noop,
  onImageError: noop,
  onSnapshot: noop,
  onNoteChange: noop,
  onNoteSave: noop,
  onRevealOpen: noop,
  onRevealChange: noop,
  onRevealConfirm: noop,
  onRevealClose: noop,
};
const SEAL_ACTION = "e1f20314-2536-4849-9ab5-d0e1f2031425";
const SEAL_DECISION = "f2031425-3647-495a-8bc6-e1f203142536";

/** The frozen case with a seal for good, in force or lifted, whose custody is as given. */
function sealedCase(custody: CaseDecision["custody"], inForce = true): CaseView {
  const view = frozenCase();
  return {
    ...view,
    decisions: [
      ...view.decisions,
      decision({
        id: SEAL_DECISION,
        kind: "final",
        ruleId: "R2",
        category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
        suspect: true,
        needsAdmin: true,
        actions: [{ id: SEAL_ACTION, kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] }, ...NO_STANDING }],
        ...(custody === undefined ? {} : { custody }),
      }),
    ],
  };
}
const page = (view: CaseView) => text(html(<CaseScreenView {...base} caseId={parseCaseId(view.id)!} view={view} />));

describe("Home's [home.quarantine] (3d design, section 8.2)", () => {
  const quarantined = (q: StaffOverview["quarantine"]) => overview({ quarantine: q });

  test("while a move is due: the counts and the oldest time, and from the alert's threshold the daily alert; nothing while none is", () => {
    const fresh = hoursBefore(2);
    const young = text(html(<CustodyLines overview={quarantined({ dueIn: 3, dueOut: 1, undestroyed: 0, oldest: fresh })} now={NOW} />));
    expect(young).toBe(`${CUSTODY_WORDS.homeTitle}${CUSTODY_WORDS.homeQuarantine(3, 1, bothTimes(fresh))}`);
    expect(young).toContain("Files to move or return: 3 images to move into the quarantine, 1 to return to the image store, the oldest due since");
    const old = hoursBefore(QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours + 1);
    const late = text(html(<CustodyLines overview={quarantined({ dueIn: 0, dueOut: 2, undestroyed: 0, oldest: old })} now={NOW} />));
    expect(late).toBe(`${CUSTODY_WORDS.homeTitle}${CUSTODY_WORDS.homeQuarantine(0, 2, bothTimes(old))} ${CUSTODY_WORDS.homeQuarantineLate}`);
    expect(CUSTODY_WORDS.homeQuarantineLate).toBe(`More than ${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours} hours: every staff account is alerted daily until the move is recorded.`);
    expect(html(<CustodyLines overview={quarantined({ dueIn: 0, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 4, oldest: null })} now={NOW} />)).toBe("");
    // The block stands below "Authorities", before the lanes.
    const home = text(html(<OverviewView overview={quarantined({ dueIn: 1, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 0, oldest: fresh })} now={NOW} onOpenCase={noop} />));
    expect(home.indexOf(CUSTODY_WORDS.homeTitle)).toBeLessThan(home.indexOf("Cases"));
  });
});

describe("a seal for good's custody on its case (3d design, section 8.4)", () => {
  const movedAt = "2026-10-17T08:00:00.000Z";

  test("[case.custody.in]: not moved yet; some moved, the others still in the store; all moved", () => {
    expect(page(sealedCase({ files: 4, moved: 0, movedAt: null, toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 }))).toContain("Files: not moved to the quarantine yet.");
    const some = page(sealedCase({ files: 4, moved: 2, movedAt, toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 }));
    expect(some).toContain(`Files: 2 of 4 are in the quarantine, since ${bothTimes(movedAt)}. ${CUSTODY_WORDS.custodyInRest}`);
    const all = page(sealedCase({ files: 4, moved: 4, movedAt, toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 }));
    expect(all).toContain(`Files: 4 of 4 are in the quarantine, since ${bothTimes(movedAt)}.`);
    expect(all).not.toContain(CUSTODY_WORDS.custodyInRest);
    // A decision without custody shows none of it.
    expect(page(sealedCase(undefined))).not.toContain("Files:");
  });

  test("[case.custody.return] after the seal was lifted, and [case.custody.lost] in its form for a seal that stands and for one that was lifted", () => {
    const back = page(sealedCase({ files: 2, moved: 2, movedAt, toReturn: 2, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 }, false));
    expect(back).toContain(
      "Files to return: the seal was lifted and 2 files of its images are still in the quarantine. The images are shown again once whoever has the server has returned them (the README, Quarantine).",
    );
    expect(back).not.toContain("are in the quarantine, since");
    const keptLost = page(sealedCase({ files: 4, moved: 2, movedAt, toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 2 }));
    expect(keptLost).toContain("Files lost: 2. They were found in neither the image store nor the quarantine and are recorded as lost; there is nothing to move, hand over or destroy for them.");
    // Two moved and two lost: every file is accounted for, so nothing is said of the store.
    expect(keptLost).not.toContain(CUSTODY_WORDS.custodyInRest);
    const liftedLost = page(sealedCase({ files: 2, moved: 0, movedAt: null, toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 2 }, false));
    expect(liftedLost).toContain("Files lost: 2. Their images cannot be shown again; their author was told so.");
    for (const out of [back, keptLost, liftedLost]) expect(out).not.toMatch(/[.]webp|files[/]/);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/cli-custody.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../../src/auth";
import { STAFF_USAGE, runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { storedImageName } from "../../src/media";
import { custodyStore, type CustodyStore } from "../quarantine/custody-store";
import { planOf, quarantineCount, quarantineRows, removeCustody } from "./custody-fixtures";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, aPost, act, imagePost, removeDecided, removeFixtures, report, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { SEAL_FOR_GOOD, removeRecords, sealActionOf } from "./records-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
const sha256 = (data: Buffer | string) => createHash("sha256").update(data).digest("hex");

/** A post of this file sealed for good: its author, its images, its case, the sealing decision and its seal's ledger row. */
interface Sealed {
  authorId: string;
  postId: string;
  mediaIds: string[];
  caseId: string;
  decisionId: string;
  sealActionId: string;
}

/**
 * The quarantine's commands around its mover (3d design, sections 7.1, 8.10 and 10.5; 12.1 rows 13 and 15): staff.js
 * quarantine-list and quarantine-record as the migrator, with the mover's program run on two temporary directories laid
 * out as the image store and the quarantine (custodyStore), filled with harmless files that are not images. The list
 * prints a line a file; the record takes the receipt line by line, whatever the plan says now, with its audit row last;
 * a stale line is recorded where the file is and reported, and the next list moves the file back; a file in neither place
 * records nothing, and only --lost records it lost, with the alert; an inventory gives a file without a row its row; a
 * post whose rows do not match its seal is left out and named. The seals commit with real keys; the last test removes
 * what the file made.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the quarantine's commands and its mover (3d Task 1)", () => {
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let store: CustodyStore;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let quarantineBefore: number;
  let startedAt: string;
  const authors: string[] = [];
  const posts: string[] = [];
  const media: string[] = [];

  /** A post with images whose files the store holds (unless said), reported on the path for child sexual abuse material and sealed for good by the admin's key. */
  async function sealedForGood(images: number, files = true): Promise<Sealed> {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, images);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    media.push(...p.mediaIds);
    if (files) store.put(p.mediaIds);
    const { caseId } = await report(apiDb, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not recorded (${outcome})`);
    return { ...p, caseId, decisionId: outcome.decisionId, sealActionId: await sealActionOf(migrateDb, outcome.decisionId) };
  }
  async function unseal(s: Sealed): Promise<void> {
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, s.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: s.decisionId, actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not lifted (${outcome})`);
  }

  const env = () => ({ DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! });
  /** The command's printed lines, each marked with its stream, and its exit code; standard input as given. */
  async function cli(args: string[], input?: string) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, env(), { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.from(input ?? "", "utf8"));
    return { code, lines, out: lines.filter((line) => line.startsWith("out ")).map((line) => line.slice(4)), err: lines.filter((line) => line.startsWith("err ")).map((line) => line.slice(4)) };
  }
  /** quarantine-list's lines about these images only: other suites' seals are none of this file's business. */
  async function listFor(ids: readonly string[]) {
    const run = await cli(["quarantine-list"]);
    return { ...run, mine: run.out.filter((line) => ids.includes(line.split(" ")[1]!)) };
  }
  const lastAudit = async () =>
    ({ ...(await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select action, actor_id, target_type, metadata from public.audit_log order by chain_seq desc limit 1`))[0]! });
  const lines = (...files: string[]) => files.join(LF) + LF;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // Read in beforeAll: a suite without a database is collected and skipped, and its environment is not loaded then.
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    store = custodyStore();
    // Counted before the admin's profile exists: the last test removes it with the seals.
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, [...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
    quarantineBefore = await quarantineCount(migrateDb);
    startedAt = (await migrateDb.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`))[0]!.now;
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
  }, 120_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    store.remove();
    await removeCustody(migrateDb, media, startedAt);
    await removeRecords(migrateDb, [...authors, admin.id]);
    await removeDecided(migrateDb, posts, [admin.id]);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, authors);
    await world.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(migrateDb), closeDb(apiDb)]);
  });

  test("list, move, record: a line a file of a seal for good, the mover's receipt recorded with its audit row last, and then nothing is due for them; the home's counts and the case's custody", async () => {
    const a = await sealedForGood(2);
    const b = await sealedForGood(1);
    const ids = [...a.mediaIds, ...b.mediaIds];
    const listed = await listFor(ids);
    expect(listed.code).toBe(0);
    expect([...listed.mine].sort()).toEqual(ids.flatMap((id) => ["small", "large"].map((size) => `in ${id} ${storedImageName(id, size as "small" | "large")}`)).sort());
    expect(listed.err[0]).toMatch(/^quarantine-list: [0-9]+ files to move in, [0-9]+ to return, [0-9]+ to destroy, [0-9]+ for the operator[.]$/);
    const moved = await store.run(lines(...listed.mine));
    expect(moved.code).toBe(0);
    for (const id of ids) for (const size of ["small", "large"] as const) expect(store.place(storedImageName(id, size))).toBe("quarantine");

    const receipt = lines(...moved.lines);
    const recorded = await cli(["quarantine-record"], receipt);
    expect([recorded.code, recorded.err]).toEqual([0, []]);
    expect(recorded.out).toEqual([expect.stringMatching(/^quarantine-record: 6 files recorded as moved, 0 as returned, 0 as destroyed, 0 as lost, 0 found without a record[.] Still due: [0-9]+[.]$/)]);
    const audit = await lastAudit();
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.target_type]).toEqual(["quarantine_recorded", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, null]);
    expect(audit.metadata).toEqual({ in: 6, out: 0, destroyed: 0, mismatched: 0, lost: 0, found: 0, againstPlan: 0, reported: 0, receiptSha256: sha256(receipt) });
    const rows = await quarantineRows(migrateDb, ids);
    expect(rows.map((row) => [row.file, row.size, row.sha256, row.unknown, row.returned_at, row.lost_at])).toEqual(
      rows.map((row) => [row.file, store.read(row.file, "quarantine").length, sha256(store.read(row.file, "quarantine")), false, null, null]),
    );
    expect((await listFor(ids)).mine).toEqual([]);
    expect(await planOf(migrateDb, ids)).toEqual([]);
    // The same receipt again writes nothing more: every line is where its row says.
    const again = await cli(["quarantine-record"], receipt);
    expect([again.code, again.out[0]]).toEqual([0, expect.stringMatching(/^quarantine-record: 0 files recorded as moved, 0 as returned/)]);

    // Home: the four values of quarantine_counts(); the case: the seal's custody, counts and one time.
    const [counts] = await apiDb.execute<{ due_in: number; due_out: number; undestroyed: number }>(sql`select due_in, due_out, undestroyed from public.quarantine_counts()`);
    const overview = await world.moderation.forStaff.overview(admin.session);
    expect(overview.quarantine).toMatchObject({ dueIn: counts!.due_in, dueOut: counts!.due_out, undestroyed: counts!.undestroyed });
    const view = await world.moderation.forStaff.caseView(admin.session, a.caseId);
    const decision = view.decisions.find((d) => d.id === a.decisionId)!;
    expect(decision.custody).toEqual({ files: 4, moved: 4, movedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$/), toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 });
    // Every decision without a seal for good carries none.
    for (const other of view.decisions.filter((d) => d.id !== a.decisionId)) expect(other).not.toHaveProperty("custody");
  });

  test("a stale in line: list, unseal, move, record: the move is recorded where the file is and reported, the next list returns it, and its return is recorded", async () => {
    const c = await sealedForGood(1);
    const id = c.mediaIds[0]!;
    const listed = await listFor([id]);
    expect(listed.mine).toHaveLength(2);
    await unseal(c);
    const moved = await store.run(lines(...listed.mine));
    expect(moved.code).toBe(0);
    const recorded = await cli(["quarantine-record"], lines(...moved.lines));
    expect(recorded.code).toBe(1);
    expect(recorded.out[0]).toMatch(/^quarantine-record: 2 files recorded as moved, 0 as returned/);
    expect(recorded.err).toEqual([1, 2].map((n) => `quarantine-record: line ${n}: image ${id} no longer fits the plan; recorded where the file is, and the next list moves it back`));
    expect((await lastAudit()).metadata).toMatchObject({ in: 2, againstPlan: 2, reported: 2 });
    // The image is visible again and its files are in the quarantine: the plan returns them.
    const back = await listFor([id]);
    expect([...back.mine].sort()).toEqual(["small", "large"].map((size) => `out ${id} ${storedImageName(id, size as "small" | "large")}`).sort());
    const returned = await store.run(lines(...back.mine));
    expect(returned.code).toBe(0);
    const recordedBack = await cli(["quarantine-record"], lines(...returned.lines));
    expect([recordedBack.code, recordedBack.out[0]]).toEqual([0, expect.stringMatching(/^quarantine-record: 0 files recorded as moved, 2 as returned/)]);
    expect((await quarantineRows(migrateDb, [id])).every((row) => row.returned_at !== null)).toBe(true);
    expect((await listFor([id])).mine).toEqual([]);
    const view = await world.moderation.forStaff.caseView(admin.session, c.caseId);
    expect(view.decisions.find((d) => d.id === c.decisionId)!.custody).toMatchObject({ moved: 0, toReturn: 0, lost: 0 });
  });

  test("the mirror: a stale out line, after the seal was taken again, is recorded as the return it was and reported, and the next list moves the file in again", async () => {
    const d = await sealedForGood(1);
    const id = d.mediaIds[0]!;
    const moved = await store.run(lines(...(await listFor([id])).mine));
    expect((await cli(["quarantine-record"], lines(...moved.lines))).code).toBe(0);
    await unseal(d);
    const outLines = (await listFor([id])).mine;
    expect(outLines.every((line) => line.startsWith("out "))).toBe(true);
    // Sealed for good again before the mover ran the out lines.
    const { caseId } = await report(apiDb, aPost(d.postId), "csam");
    const again = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
    if (typeof again === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not recorded (${again})`);
    const returned = await store.run(lines(...outLines));
    const recorded = await cli(["quarantine-record"], lines(...returned.lines));
    expect(recorded.code).toBe(1);
    expect(recorded.out[0]).toMatch(/^quarantine-record: 0 files recorded as moved, 2 as returned/);
    expect(recorded.err).toEqual([1, 2].map((n) => `quarantine-record: line ${n}: image ${id} no longer fits the plan; recorded where the file is, and the next list moves it back`));
    expect([...(await listFor([id])).mine].every((line) => line.startsWith("in "))).toBe(true);
    expect(await planOf(migrateDb, [id])).toEqual([`in ${id}`]);
  });

  test("a file in neither place: missing records nothing and the run goes on; with --lost it is recorded lost, quarantine_lost alerts every staff account, and the image leaves the plan", async () => {
    const e = await sealedForGood(1, false);
    const id = e.mediaIds[0]!;
    const listed = await listFor([id]);
    const missing = await store.run(lines(...listed.mine));
    expect(missing.code).toBe(1);
    expect(missing.lines).toEqual(listed.mine.map((line) => `${line} missing`));
    const recorded = await cli(["quarantine-record"], lines(...missing.lines));
    expect(recorded.code).toBe(1);
    expect(recorded.err).toEqual(listed.mine.map((line, i) => `quarantine-record: line ${i + 1}: ${line.split(" ")[2]} is missing in both places; nothing recorded (see the README, Quarantine, step 5)`));
    expect(await quarantineRows(migrateDb, [id])).toEqual([]);

    const lost = await store.run(lines(...listed.mine), ["--lost"]);
    expect([lost.code, lost.lines]).toEqual([0, listed.mine.map((line) => `${line} lost`)]);
    const recordedLost = await cli(["quarantine-record"], lines(...lost.lines));
    expect([recordedLost.code, recordedLost.out[0]]).toEqual([0, expect.stringMatching(/^quarantine-record: 0 files recorded as moved, 0 as returned, 0 as destroyed, 2 as lost, 0 found without a record/)]);
    // Sealed for good: nobody is told of a lost file of a seal that stands; staff are.
    expect((await quarantineRows(migrateDb, [id])).map((row) => [row.lost_told, row.size])).toEqual([
      ["none", null],
      ["none", null],
    ]);
    const [alert] = await migrateDb.execute<{ priority: number; scope: string; step: number | null; facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select priority, scope, step, facts from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'quarantine_lost' order by id desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect({ ...alert! }).toEqual({ priority: 3, scope: "all", step: null, facts: { count: 2, at: expect.stringMatching(/Z$/) } });
    expect((await lastAudit()).metadata).toMatchObject({ lost: 2, reported: 0 });
    expect(await planOf(migrateDb, [id])).toEqual([]);
    const view = await world.moderation.forStaff.caseView(admin.session, e.caseId);
    expect(view.decisions.find((x) => x.id === e.decisionId)!.custody).toEqual({ files: 2, moved: 0, movedAt: null, toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 2 });
  });

  test("the inventory: a file without a record gets its row, one of an image the database does not know is the operator's; a line that is no receipt line is skipped; another digest is reported and the stored one stays", async () => {
    const f = await sealedForGood(1, false);
    const id = f.mediaIds[0]!;
    const unknown = randomUUID();
    media.push(unknown);
    // Files that lie in the quarantine without a record: a receipt that was lost, and a restore that forgot an image.
    const fNames = store.put([id], "quarantine");
    const uNames = store.put([unknown], "quarantine");
    const inventory = await store.run("", ["--inventory"]);
    expect(inventory.code).toBe(0);
    const mine = inventory.lines.filter((line) => line.includes(id) || line.includes(unknown));
    expect(mine).toHaveLength(4);
    const recorded = await cli(["quarantine-record"], lines(mine[0]!, "a line that the mover never prints", ...mine.slice(1)));
    expect(recorded.code).toBe(1);
    expect(recorded.out[0]).toMatch(/0 as lost, 4 found without a record[.]/);
    expect(recorded.err).toContain("quarantine-record: line 2 is not a receipt line; skipped");
    expect(recorded.err.filter((line) => line.endsWith("was found in the quarantine without a record; recorded"))).toHaveLength(4);
    expect((await quarantineRows(migrateDb, [id, unknown])).map((row) => [row.media_id, row.unknown])).toEqual(
      [...[id, id].map((x) => [x, false]), ...[unknown, unknown].map((x) => [x, true])].sort((x, y) => (String(x[0]) < String(y[0]) ? -1 : String(x[0]) > String(y[0]) ? 1 : 0)),
    );
    const listed = await listFor([id, unknown]);
    expect([...listed.mine].sort()).toEqual(uNames.map((name) => `operator ${unknown} ${name}`).sort());
    // The mover leaves an operator line alone.
    const left = await store.run(lines(...listed.mine));
    expect([left.code, left.lines]).toEqual([0, []]);
    // A line of a file whose recorded digest is another: recorded, reported and counted; the stored digest stays.
    const stored = (await quarantineRows(migrateDb, [id])).find((row) => row.file === fNames[0])!;
    const forged = await cli(["quarantine-record"], lines(`have ${id} ${fNames[0]} 77 ${"f".repeat(64)}`));
    expect(forged.code).toBe(1);
    expect(forged.err).toEqual([`quarantine-record: line 1: ${fNames[0]} has another digest than the one recorded when it was moved; the recorded digest stays`]);
    expect((await lastAudit()).metadata).toMatchObject({ mismatched: 1, reported: 1 });
    expect((await quarantineRows(migrateDb, [id])).find((row) => row.file === fNames[0])!.sha256).toBe(stored.sha256);
  });

  test("quarantine-list leaves out a post whose image rows do not match its seal, names it, prints every other post's lines, and exits 1", async () => {
    const g = await sealedForGood(1);
    const h = await sealedForGood(1);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.seal_posts set images = 2 where action_id = ${g.sealActionId}::uuid`);
    try {
      const listed = await listFor([...g.mediaIds, ...h.mediaIds]);
      expect(listed.code).toBe(1);
      expect(listed.mine.every((line) => line.includes(h.mediaIds[0]!))).toBe(true);
      expect(listed.mine).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(listed.err).toContain(`quarantine-list: post ${g.postId}: its image rows do not match its seal; left out`);
    } finally {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.seal_posts set images = 1 where action_id = ${g.sealActionId}::uuid`);
    }
    // Moved and recorded, so nothing of this test is due when the file ends.
    for (const s of [g, h]) {
      const moved = await store.run(lines(...(await listFor(s.mediaIds)).mine));
      expect((await cli(["quarantine-record"], lines(...moved.lines))).code).toBe(0);
    }
  });

  test("STAFF_USAGE names both commands; an argument is refused; an empty receipt is refused and changes nothing", async () => {
    for (const command of ["quarantine-list", "quarantine-record"]) expect(STAFF_USAGE, command).toContain(`  ${command}`);
    expect((await cli(["quarantine-list", "now"])).code).toBe(2);
    const audits = (await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.audit_log`))[0]!.n;
    const empty = await cli(["quarantine-record"], LF);
    expect([empty.code, empty.err]).toEqual([1, ["quarantine-record: the receipt holds no line; give the quarantine service's receipt on standard input; nothing changed"]]);
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.audit_log`))[0]!.n).toBe(audits);
  });

  test("this file left nothing behind: its seals, cases, records and quarantine rows are removed, and the tables hold what they held before", async () => {
    await removeCustody(migrateDb, media, startedAt);
    await removeRecords(migrateDb, [...authors, admin.id]);
    await removeDecided(migrateDb, posts, [admin.id]);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, authors);
    posts.length = 0;
    authors.length = 0;
    expect(await quarantineCount(migrateDb)).toBe(quarantineBefore);
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, [...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/custody-fixtures.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { uuids } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/**
 * 3d Task 1: fixtures of the quarantine's record (3d design, sections 6.1 and 12). quarantine_files is the migrator's
 * alone: the API's role holds no right on it, so every read, write and count here is made as the migrator.
 */

/** One file's row of the quarantine, as the migrator reads it, times as text. */
export interface QuarantineRow {
  media_id: string;
  file: string;
  post_id: string | null;
  size: number | null;
  sha256: string | null;
  moved_at: string;
  returned_at: string | null;
  destroyed_at: string | null;
  lost_at: string | null;
  lost_told: string | null;
  imported_at: string | null;
  unknown: boolean;
}

/** The rows of these images, by image and file. */
export async function quarantineRows(q: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<QuarantineRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<QuarantineRow & Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    select media_id, file, post_id, size::int as size, sha256, moved_at::text, returned_at::text, destroyed_at::text, lost_at::text,
           lost_told::text, imported_at::text, unknown
      from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)}) order by media_id, file`);
  return found.map((row) => ({ ...row }));
}

/** How many rows the table holds, as the migrator (the API role cannot count them). */
export async function quarantineCount(q: Db | DbTx): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.quarantine_files`);
  return row!.n;
}

/** The plan as the migrator reads it, for these images only, as "<direction> <image id>" strings, sorted. */
export async function planOf(q: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ direction: string; media_id: string }>(sql`select p.direction, p.media_id from public.quarantine_plan() p where p.media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  return found.map((row) => `${row.direction} ${row.media_id}`).sort();
}

/** What ageCustodyForTest moves back: a decision (when a move in became due) with its ledger rows; an image's quarantine rows; or an alert kind's rows. */
export type CustodyAgeTarget = { decision: string } | { media: string } | { alerts: "quarantine_due" | "quarantine_lost" };

/**
 * The fixture of 3d's section 12, `ageCustodyForTest(target, interval)` (Task 1; Tasks 2, 6 and 7 grow it): as the
 * migrator, moves the times of the rows a day's alert or a due move is judged by back by the interval. It is the only way
 * a test meets a day's alert: every time is forced when it is first written, and no setting shortens a number. For a
 * decision: its decided_at, and the created_at of its ledger rows and of every ledger row that reversed one of them (when
 * a return became due). For an image: every time its quarantine rows hold. For an alert kind: when each of its outbox
 * rows was created. Run it inside a transaction that ends in a rollback, or undo it.
 */
export async function ageCustodyForTest(q: Db | DbTx, target: CustodyAgeTarget, interval: string): Promise<void> {
  if ("decision" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.decisions set decided_at = decided_at - ${interval}::interval where id = ${target.decision}::uuid`);
    await q.execute(sql`
      update public.decision_actions set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval
       where decision_id = ${target.decision}::uuid
          or reverses_action_id in (select a.id from public.decision_actions a where a.decision_id = ${target.decision}::uuid)`);
  } else if ("media" in target) {
    await q.execute(sql`
      update public.quarantine_files
         set moved_at = moved_at - ${interval}::interval, returned_at = returned_at - ${interval}::interval,
             destroyed_at = destroyed_at - ${interval}::interval, lost_at = lost_at - ${interval}::interval
       where media_id = ${target.media}::uuid`);
  } else {
    await q.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - ${interval}::interval where kind = ${target.alerts}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Removes, as the migrator, the quarantine's rows of these images and, given the time the test began, the staff alerts
 * raised since then that name no message and no order: those its seals, lifted seals and records raised
 * (moderation_urgent, moderation_csam_lifted, quarantine_lost). Files of this kind run one at a time.
 */
export async function removeCustody(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, mediaIds: readonly string[], alertsSince?: string): Promise<void> {
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.quarantine_files where media_id = any(${uuids(mediaIds)})`);
  if (alertsSince !== undefined) {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where message_id is null and order_id is null and created_at >= ${alertsSince}::timestamptz`);
  }
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/quarantine-plan.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { MEDIA_SIZES, QUARANTINE_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { AuthForModeration } from "../../src/auth";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { quarantineNames, storedImageName } from "../../src/media";
import { serve } from "../../src/media/flows/serve";
import { status } from "../../src/media/flows/status";
import { lostImageNotices } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { ageCustodyForTest, planOf, quarantineCount, quarantineRows, removeCustody } from "./custody-fixtures";
import { mediaHarness } from "./media-harness";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, aPost, act, imagePost, moderationDeps, raised, removeDecided, removeFixtures, report, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { SEAL_FOR_GOOD, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING, removeRecords, sealActionOf } from "./records-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/** A sealed post of this file: its author, its images, its case, the sealing decision and its seal's ledger row. */
interface Sealed {
  authorId: string;
  postId: string;
  mediaIds: string[];
  caseId: string;
  decisionId: string;
  sealActionId: string;
}

/**
 * The quarantine's record and plan (3d design, sections 6.1, 7.1 and 10.3; 12.1 rows 14 and 15), on the database: what
 * the plan lists for a seal for good and for a seal taken while deciding, before and after a move and after an
 * unseal_media; what the insert and update triggers force; the CHECKs; the six functions the API's role may call and the
 * table and the plan it may not reach; the count against seal_posts.images; quarantine_due daily from 24 hours; what the
 * owner's status and serve say of an image being restored or lost; and the lost image's notice, once. The seals commit
 * with real keys; every other change is made as the migrator in a transaction that is rolled back, and the last test
 * removes what the file committed.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the quarantine's plan and record (3d Task 1)", () => {
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let quarantineBefore: number;
  let startedAt: string;
  /** Sealed for good, two images; sealed while deciding, one image; sealed for good, moved, then lifted, one image. */
  let forGood: Sealed;
  let deciding: Sealed;
  let lifted: Sealed;
  const authors: string[] = [];
  const posts: string[] = [];
  const media = () => [...forGood.mediaIds, ...deciding.mediaIds, ...lifted.mediaIds];

  /** A post with images, reported on the path for child sexual abuse material, and sealed by the admin's real key. */
  async function sealed(images: number, how: "final" | "deciding"): Promise<Sealed> {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, images);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    const { caseId } = await report(apiDb, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, how === "final" ? SEAL_FOR_GOOD : SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not recorded (${outcome})`);
    return { ...p, caseId, decisionId: outcome.decisionId, sealActionId: await sealActionOf(migrateDb, outcome.decisionId) };
  }
  /** A file's row as quarantine-record writes it for a move in: the image, its name, a size and a digest. */
  const moved = (q: Db | DbTx, mediaId: string, size: "small" | "large", digest = "a".repeat(64)) =>
    q.execute(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256) values (${mediaId}::uuid, ${storedImageName(mediaId, size)}, 1234, ${digest})`);
  const counts = async (q: Db | DbTx) => (await q.execute<{ due_in: number; due_out: number; undestroyed: number; oldest: string | null }>(sql`select due_in, due_out, undestroyed, oldest::text from public.quarantine_counts()`))[0]!;
  const custody = async (q: Db | DbTx, action: string) =>
    ({ ...(await q.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select files, moved, moved_at is not null as moved_at, to_return, files_left, lost from public.seal_custody(${action}::uuid)`))[0]! });
  const asBool = async (q: Db | DbTx, fn: "media_quarantined" | "media_lost", mediaId: string) =>
    (await q.execute<{ b: boolean }>(sql.raw(`select public.${fn}('${mediaId}'::uuid) as b`)))[0]!.b;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // Read in beforeAll: a suite without a database is collected and skipped, and its environment is not loaded then.
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    // Counted before the admin's profile exists: the last test removes it with the seals.
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, [...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    quarantineBefore = await quarantineCount(migrateDb);
    startedAt = (await migrateDb.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`))[0]!.now;
    forGood = await sealed(2, "final");
    deciding = await sealed(1, "deciding");
    // The third: sealed for good, its files moved into the quarantine and recorded, then the seal lifted by a correction.
    lifted = await sealed(1, "final");
    for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) await moved(migrateDb, lifted.mediaIds[0]!, size);
    const unseal = await world.decideAs(admin, lifted.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: lifted.decisionId, actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
    if (typeof unseal === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not lifted (${unseal})`);
  }, 240_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeCustody(migrateDb, media(), startedAt);
    await removeRecords(migrateDb, [...authors, admin.id]);
    await removeDecided(migrateDb, posts, [admin.id]);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, authors);
    await world.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(migrateDb), closeDb(apiDb)]);
  });

  test("the API's role has no right on quarantine_files and cannot run the plan; it may call the six functions, and nothing of them names a file", async () => {
    const [rights] = await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, boolean>>(sql`
      select has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.quarantine_files', 'SELECT') as sel, has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.quarantine_files', 'INSERT') as ins,
             has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.quarantine_files', 'UPDATE') as upd, has_table_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.quarantine_files', 'DELETE') as del,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.quarantine_plan()', 'EXECUTE') as plan,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.quarantine_sealed_for_good(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as helper1,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.quarantine_lost_told(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as helper2,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.quarantine_counts()', 'EXECUTE') as counts,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.seal_custody(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as custody,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.media_quarantined(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as quarantined,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.media_lost(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') as lost,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.lost_untold(integer)', 'EXECUTE') as untold,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.lost_told(uuid, delivery_state)', 'EXECUTE') as told`);
    expect({ ...rights }).toEqual({ sel: false, ins: false, upd: false, del: false, plan: false, helper1: false, helper2: false, counts: true, custody: true, quarantined: true, lost: true, untold: true, told: true });
    expect(raised(await apiDb.execute(sql`select count(*) from public.quarantine_files`).then(() => null, (err: unknown) => err))?.code).toBe("42501");
    expect(raised(await apiDb.execute(sql`select * from public.quarantine_plan()`).then(() => null, (err: unknown) => err))?.code).toBe("42501");
    // What the six answer: counts, one time and booleans; the column names say so.
    const columns = async (query: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => Object.keys((await apiDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(query))[0] ?? {}).sort();
    expect(await columns(sql`select * from public.quarantine_counts()`)).toEqual(["due_in", "due_out", "oldest", "undestroyed"]);
    expect(await columns(sql`select * from public.seal_custody(${forGood.sealActionId}::uuid)`)).toEqual(["files", "files_left", "lost", "moved", "moved_at", "to_return"]);
    expect(await asBool(apiDb, "media_quarantined", forGood.mediaIds[0]!)).toBe(false);
    expect(await asBool(apiDb, "media_lost", forGood.mediaIds[0]!)).toBe(false);
    await apiDb.execute(sql`select public.lost_told(${randomUUID()}::uuid, 'sent')`);
  });

  test("the plan: in for every image of a seal for good, none for a seal taken while deciding; the counts and the seal's custody", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      expect(await planOf(tx, [...forGood.mediaIds, ...deciding.mediaIds])).toEqual(forGood.mediaIds.map((id) => `in ${id}`).sort());
      const c = await counts(tx);
      expect(c.due_in).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
      const [decided] = await tx.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select decided_at::text as at from public.decisions where id = ${forGood.decisionId}::uuid`);
      expect(new Date(c.oldest!).getTime()).toBeLessThanOrEqual(new Date(decided!.at).getTime());
      expect(await custody(tx, forGood.sealActionId)).toEqual({ files: 4, moved: 0, moved_at: false, to_return: 0, files_left: 0, lost: 0 });
      expect(await custody(tx, deciding.sealActionId)).toEqual({ files: 2, moved: 0, moved_at: false, to_return: 0, files_left: 0, lost: 0 });
    });
  });

  test("the insert forces the record's time, the post, the mark and the ends; an image whose two files are recorded leaves the plan, and a lost file counts as recorded", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const [first, second] = forGood.mediaIds as [string, string];
      // Whatever the insert says of the time, the post, the mark and the ends, the trigger writes the database's.
      await tx.execute(sql`
        insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, post_id, size, sha256, moved_at, returned_at, unknown)
        values (${first}::uuid, ${storedImageName(first, "small")}, ${randomUUID()}::uuid, 10, ${"b".repeat(64)}, '2001-01-01', now(), true)`);
      const [row] = await quarantineRows(tx, [first]);
      const [now] = await tx.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`);
      expect(row).toMatchObject({ post_id: forGood.postId, unknown: false, returned_at: null, destroyed_at: null, lost_at: null, lost_told: null, moved_at: now!.now });
      expect(await planOf(tx, forGood.mediaIds)).toEqual([`in ${first}`, `in ${second}`].sort());
      await moved(tx, first, "large");
      expect(await planOf(tx, forGood.mediaIds)).toEqual([`in ${second}`]);
      expect(await asBool(tx, "media_quarantined", first)).toBe(true);
      expect(await custody(tx, forGood.sealActionId)).toEqual({ files: 4, moved: 2, moved_at: true, to_return: 0, files_left: 0, lost: 0 });
      // A file found in neither place and recorded as lost (a run with --lost): its row has no digest, and for an image
      // sealed for good its author is owed nothing (lost_told none). Once both files are accounted for, the image leaves the plan.
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, lost_at) values (${second}::uuid, ${storedImageName(second, "small")}, '2001-01-01')`);
      await moved(tx, second, "large");
      const lostRow = (await quarantineRows(tx, [second])).find((r) => r.file.endsWith("small.webp"))!;
      expect(lostRow).toMatchObject({ size: null, sha256: null, lost_at: now!.now, lost_told: "none" });
      expect(await planOf(tx, forGood.mediaIds)).toEqual([]);
      expect(await asBool(tx, "media_lost", second)).toBe(true);
      expect(await custody(tx, forGood.sealActionId)).toEqual({ files: 4, moved: 3, moved_at: true, to_return: 0, files_left: 0, lost: 1 });
    });
  });

  test("the CHECKs: one of the image's two names, a digest and a size together and both over nothing, at most one end, a release only on a destroyed file", async () => {
    const [id, other] = forGood.mediaIds as [string, string];
    const refused = async (query: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => {
      let code: string | undefined;
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        code = raised(await tx.execute(query).then(() => null, (err: unknown) => err))?.code;
      });
      return code;
    };
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256) values (${id}::uuid, ${storedImageName(other, "small")}, 1, ${"a".repeat(64)})`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256) values (${id}::uuid, ${`files/${id.slice(0, 2)}/${id}/medium.webp`}, 1, ${"a".repeat(64)})`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256) values (${id}::uuid, ${storedImageName(id, "small")}, 0, ${"a".repeat(64)})`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256) values (${id}::uuid, ${storedImageName(id, "small")}, 1, 'not hex')`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size) values (${id}::uuid, ${storedImageName(id, "small")}, 1)`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file) values (${id}::uuid, ${storedImageName(id, "small")})`)).toBe("23514");
    let ends: string | undefined;
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await moved(tx, id, "small");
      ends = raised(await tx.execute(sql`update public.quarantine_files set returned_at = now(), lost_at = now() where media_id = ${id}::uuid`).then(() => null, (err: unknown) => err))?.code;
    });
    expect(ends).toBe("23514");
    let release: string | undefined;
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await moved(tx, id, "small");
      release = raised(await tx.execute(sql`update public.quarantine_files set release_id = gen_random_uuid() where media_id = ${id}::uuid`).then(() => null, (err: unknown) => err))?.code;
    });
    expect(release).toBe("23514");
  });

  test("the update keeps a file's identity and the digest it was moved with, and stamps each end and a move again with the record's time", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const id = forGood.mediaIds[0]!;
      const file = storedImageName(id, "small");
      await moved(tx, id, "small", "c".repeat(64));
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.quarantine_files set post_id = gen_random_uuid(), unknown = true, sha256 = ${"d".repeat(64)}, size = 99, returned_at = '2001-01-01' where media_id = ${id}::uuid`);
      const [now] = await tx.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`);
      expect((await quarantineRows(tx, [id]))[0]).toMatchObject({ file, post_id: forGood.postId, unknown: false, sha256: "c".repeat(64), size: 1234, returned_at: now!.now });
      // Moved again: the row is kept, its return cleared and its move stamped anew.
      await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { media: id }, "1 day");
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.quarantine_files set returned_at = null where media_id = ${id}::uuid`);
      expect((await quarantineRows(tx, [id]))[0]).toMatchObject({ returned_at: null, moved_at: now!.now });
    });
  });

  test("an image of a lifted seal is out until its files are back: being restored for its author, a 404 with an info line for everyone, the counts' oldest from the reversal", async () => {
    const id = lifted.mediaIds[0]!;
    expect(await planOf(migrateDb, [id])).toEqual([`out ${id}`]);
    expect(await custody(apiDb, lifted.sealActionId)).toEqual({ files: 2, moved: 2, moved_at: true, to_return: 2, files_left: 0, lost: 0 });
    expect(await asBool(apiDb, "media_quarantined", id)).toBe(true);
    const c = await counts(apiDb);
    expect(c.due_out).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    const h = await mediaHarness(apiDb);
    try {
      const logged: { level: string; msg: string }[] = [];
      const log = { info: (_o: unknown, msg: string) => logged.push({ level: "info", msg }), error: (_o: unknown, msg: string) => logged.push({ level: "error", msg }), warn: () => undefined } as unknown as Logger;
      const deps = { ...h.deps, log };
      expect((await status(deps, lifted.authorId, id))).toMatchObject({ id, status: "ready", restoring: true });
      expect(await serve(deps, { id, size: "small", ifNoneMatch: undefined, viewer: async () => null })).toEqual({ kind: "not_found" });
      expect(logged).toEqual([{ level: "info", msg: "media: a visible image's files are not in the store: being restored, or lost" }]);
      // An image of the post sealed for good says nothing of the kind: it is sealed, and its status holds no blurhash.
      expect(await status(deps, forGood.authorId, forGood.mediaIds[0]!)).toEqual({ id: forGood.mediaIds[0]!, status: "ready", width: 1200, height: 800 });
      // Once its files are back in the store, nothing is said either.
      h.worker.ready(id, { width: 1200, height: 800 });
      expect(await status(deps, lifted.authorId, id)).toEqual({ id, status: "ready", width: 1200, height: 800, blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL" });
    } finally {
      h.cleanup();
    }
  });

  test("a file of a lifted seal recorded as lost: the plan lets it go, its status says lost, and its author is mailed image_lost once", async () => {
    const id = lifted.mediaIds[0]!;
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.quarantine_files set lost_at = now() where media_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await quarantineRows(migrateDb, [id])).map((row) => row.lost_told)).toEqual(["pending", "pending"]);
    expect(await planOf(migrateDb, [id])).toEqual([]);
    expect(await asBool(apiDb, "media_lost", id)).toBe(true);
    expect(await custody(apiDb, lifted.sealActionId)).toEqual({ files: 2, moved: 0, moved_at: false, to_return: 0, files_left: 0, lost: 2 });
    const h = await mediaHarness(apiDb);
    try {
      expect(await status(h.deps, lifted.authorId, id)).toMatchObject({ id, status: "ready", lost: true });
      expect(await status(h.deps, lifted.authorId, id)).not.toHaveProperty("restoring");
    } finally {
      h.cleanup();
    }
    // The dispatch round's notices: one mail for the image, with its post's time, and the outcome recorded; then nothing.
    const sent: { userId: string; message: unknown }[] = [];
    const auth = { mailAccount: async (userId: string, message: unknown) => (sent.push({ userId, message }), "sent") } as unknown as AuthForModeration;
    const deps = moderationDeps(apiDb, { auth });
    const [post] = await apiDb.execute<{ ms: string }>(sql`select floor(extract(epoch from created_at) * 1000)::bigint::text as ms from posts where id = ${lifted.postId}::uuid`);
    expect(await lostImageNotices(deps, new Date())).toBe(1);
    expect(sent).toEqual([{ userId: lifted.authorId, message: { template: "image_lost", postCreatedAt: new Date(Number(post!.ms)) } }]);
    expect((await quarantineRows(migrateDb, [id])).map((row) => row.lost_told)).toEqual(["sent", "sent"]);
    expect(await lostImageNotices(deps, new Date())).toBe(0);
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(1);
    // lost_told changes only from pending.
    await apiDb.execute(sql`select public.lost_told(${id}::uuid, 'failed')`);
    expect((await quarantineRows(migrateDb, [id])).map((row) => row.lost_told)).toEqual(["sent", "sent"]);
  });

  test("a file whose image row is gone is to destroy; a file of an image the database does not know is the operator's, never destroyed or returned; an imported row keeps its time", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const id = p.mediaIds[0]!;
      await moved(tx, id, "small");
      // A visible image on a post, not sealed: its file goes back.
      expect(await planOf(tx, [id])).toEqual([`out ${id}`]);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from post_media where id = ${id}::uuid`);
      expect(await planOf(tx, [id])).toEqual([`destroy ${id}`]);
      // A file the inventory found for an image the database does not know.
      const unknown = randomUUID();
      await moved(tx, unknown, "large");
      expect((await quarantineRows(tx, [unknown]))[0]).toMatchObject({ unknown: true, post_id: null });
      expect(await planOf(tx, [unknown])).toEqual([`operator ${unknown}`]);
      // A row written again after a restore keeps a time that is not after the clock, and only then.
      const imported = randomUUID();
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256, moved_at, imported_at, post_id) values (${imported}::uuid, ${storedImageName(imported, "small")}, 5, ${"e".repeat(64)}, '2026-01-02 03:04:05+00', now(), ${p.postId}::uuid)`);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.quarantine_files (media_id, file, size, sha256, moved_at, imported_at) values (${imported}::uuid, ${storedImageName(imported, "large")}, 5, ${"e".repeat(64)}, now() + interval '1 day', now())`);
      const rowsOf = await quarantineRows(tx, [imported]);
      const [now] = await tx.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`);
      expect(rowsOf.map((r) => [r.file.split("/")[3], r.moved_at, r.post_id])).toEqual([
        ["large.webp", now!.now, null],
        ["small.webp", "2026-01-02 03:04:05+00", p.postId],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("quarantineNames: a line a file, a post whose rows differ from its seal left out and named, and a post with an erased image row listed", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const mine = (names: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof quarantineNames>>) => names.lines.filter((line) => forGood.mediaIds.includes(line.mediaId));
      const listed = await quarantineNames(tx);
      expect(mine(listed).map((line) => [line.direction, line.mediaId, line.postId, line.files])).toEqual(
        [...forGood.mediaIds].sort().map((id) => ["in", id, forGood.postId, MEDIA_SIZES.map((size) => storedImageName(id, size))]),
      );
      expect(listed.mismatched.map((post) => post.postId)).not.toContain(forGood.postId);
      // One file already moved: only the other is named.
      await moved(tx, forGood.mediaIds[0]!, "small");
      expect(mine(await quarantineNames(tx)).find((line) => line.mediaId === forGood.mediaIds[0])!.files).toEqual([storedImageName(forGood.mediaIds[0]!, "large")]);
      // An image row erased (an R4 redaction before the seal) still counts against the seal, and its files are not listed.
      await tx.execute(sql`update post_media set erased_at = now() where id = ${forGood.mediaIds[1]!}::uuid`);
      const erased = await quarantineNames(tx);
      expect(mine(erased).map((line) => line.mediaId)).toEqual([forGood.mediaIds[0]]);
      expect(erased.mismatched.map((post) => post.postId)).not.toContain(forGood.postId);
      // The seal recorded another number of image rows: the post gets no line and is named.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.seal_posts set images = 3 where action_id = ${forGood.sealActionId}::uuid`);
      const left = await quarantineNames(tx);
      expect(mine(left)).toEqual([]);
      expect(left.mismatched.filter((post) => post.postId === forGood.postId)).toEqual([{ postId: forGood.postId, rows: 2, images: [3] }]);
    });
  });

  test("quarantine_due: daily from the day the oldest move became due until the move is recorded, with the count and the oldest time", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'quarantine_due'`);
      const dueRows = async () => (await tx.execute<{ step: number; facts: { count: number; oldestAt: string } }>(sql`select step, facts from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'quarantine_due' order by step`)).map((row) => ({ ...row }));
      // Every move this file made due is younger than the threshold: no alert.
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect(await dueRows()).toEqual([]);
      const almost = `${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours - 1} hours`;
      await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { decision: forGood.decisionId }, almost);
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect(await dueRows()).toEqual([]);
      await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { decision: forGood.decisionId }, "2 hours");
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      const c = await counts(tx);
      const [oldest] = await tx.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select public.alert_time(oldest) as at from public.quarantine_counts()`);
      expect(await dueRows()).toEqual([{ step: 0, facts: { count: c.due_in + c.due_out, oldestAt: oldest!.at } }]);
      // Daily: not again the same day, again the next.
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect(await dueRows()).toHaveLength(1);
      await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { alerts: "quarantine_due" }, `${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours + 1} hours`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect((await dueRows()).map((row) => row.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
      // Once every due move is recorded, the alert stops.
      for (const id of forGood.mediaIds) for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) await moved(tx, id, size);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.quarantine_files set returned_at = now() where media_id = ${lifted.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid and lost_at is null`);
      const after = await counts(tx);
      await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { alerts: "quarantine_due" }, `${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours + 1} hours`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect((await dueRows()).length).toBe(after.due_in + after.due_out === 0 ? 2 : 3);
    });
  });

  test("this file left nothing behind: its seals, cases, records and quarantine rows are removed, and the tables hold what they held before", async () => {
    await removeCustody(migrateDb, media(), startedAt);
    await removeRecords(migrateDb, [...authors, admin.id]);
    await removeDecided(migrateDb, posts, [admin.id]);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, authors);
    posts.length = 0;
    authors.length = 0;
    expect(await quarantineCount(migrateDb)).toBe(quarantineBefore);
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, [...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```
