### Create `apps/api/test/lab/automation/30-proto.sql`

```sql
-- GENERATED by make_proto.py. Do not edit.
-- LAB 3d prototype, tables and plain functions (run inside 30-proto.sql, one transaction, as korbat_migrate, on 0017).
ALTER TYPE public.intake_kind ADD VALUE 'automated';
ALTER TYPE public.intake_channel ADD VALUE 'system';

-- A decider that is not a person.
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ALTER COLUMN decided_by DROP NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ADD CONSTRAINT decisions_decider
  CHECK ((decided_by IS NULL) = (automated_decision = 'fully') AND (decided_by IS NOT NULL OR kind::text = 'interim'));
ALTER TABLE public.decisions DROP CONSTRAINT decisions_restricted;
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ADD CONSTRAINT decisions_restricted
  CHECK (outcome::text <> 'restricted' OR (ground IS NOT NULL AND (decided_by IS NULL OR (facts_digest IS NOT NULL AND reason_digest IS NOT NULL))));
ALTER TABLE public.intakes DROP CONSTRAINT intakes_finding;
ALTER TABLE public.intakes ADD CONSTRAINT intakes_finding
  CHECK ((kind::text = 'finding') = (finding_by IS NOT NULL) AND (kind::text = 'finding') = (channel::text = 'staff')
     AND (kind::text = 'automated') = (channel::text = 'system'));
ALTER TABLE public.intakes DROP CONSTRAINT intakes_r2_finding_only;
ALTER TABLE public.intakes ADD CONSTRAINT intakes_r2_finding_only
  CHECK (rule_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'R2' OR kind::text IN ('finding', 'automated'));
ALTER TABLE public.intakes ADD CONSTRAINT intakes_automated
  CHECK (kind::text <> 'automated' OR (automated_processing AND rule_id IN ('R1', 'R2') AND NOT alleges_illegal AND NOT csam
     AND reporter_id IS NULL AND contact_id IS NULL AND finding_by IS NULL));

CREATE TABLE public.automated_signals (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('r1_score', 'known_match')),
  media_id uuid NOT NULL,
  decision_id uuid REFERENCES public.decisions(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE public.automated_signals ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY automated_signals_api ON public.automated_signals FOR ALL TO korbat_api USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
REVOKE ALL ON public.automated_signals FROM korbat_api;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON public.automated_signals TO korbat_api;
GRANT UPDATE (decision_id) ON public.automated_signals TO korbat_api;

CREATE FUNCTION public.automation_rules() RETURNS TABLE (decisions_per_hour integer, decisions_per_day integer)
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT 5, 50 $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.automation_rules() FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.automation_rules() TO korbat_api;

-- The release: the record, the mark keyed on seal_posts' key, the clause in the seal arm.
CREATE TABLE public.releases (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  seal_action_id uuid,
  post_ids uuid[] NOT NULL,
  basis text NOT NULL CHECK (basis IN ('answer', 'period')),
  answer text,
  their_reference text,
  released_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  replay_of uuid,
  CONSTRAINT releases_replay_once UNIQUE (replay_of)
);
CREATE TABLE public.seal_releases (
  action_id uuid NOT NULL,
  post_id uuid NOT NULL,
  release_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.releases(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (action_id, post_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (action_id, post_id) REFERENCES public.seal_posts(action_id, post_id)
);
ALTER TABLE public.releases ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.seal_releases ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY releases_api ON public.releases FOR SELECT TO korbat_api USING (true);
CREATE POLICY seal_releases_api ON public.seal_releases FOR SELECT TO korbat_api USING (true);
REVOKE ALL ON public.releases, public.seal_releases FROM korbat_api;
GRANT SELECT ON public.releases, public.seal_releases TO korbat_api;

-- Stand-in for 3f's record of the report (authority_notifications) and its seal_report, as F 6.5 specifies them.
CREATE TABLE public.lab_notifications (seal_action_id uuid, case_id uuid, account_id uuid, state text, answer text, their_reference text, answered_at timestamptz);
REVOKE ALL ON public.lab_notifications FROM korbat_api;
CREATE FUNCTION public.seal_report(action uuid) RETURNS TABLE (reported boolean, their_reference text, answered_at timestamptz)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT n.state = 'sent', n.their_reference, n.answered_at
    FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id
    JOIN public.lab_notifications n ON n.case_id = d.case_id AND n.account_id = a.subject_account_id
   WHERE a.id = seal_report.action
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.seal_report(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.frozen_for(post uuid, author uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.cases c
      JOIN public.intake_items i ON i.case_id = c.id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL
      WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND c.target_type = 'post' AND c.target_id = frozen_for.post)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.cases c
      JOIN public.intake_items i ON i.case_id = c.id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL
      WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND c.target_type = 'account' AND c.target_id = frozen_for.author)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_posts s
      JOIN public.measures_in_force m ON m.id = s.action_id
      WHERE s.post_id = frozen_for.post
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_releases r WHERE r.action_id = s.action_id AND r.post_id = s.post_id))
$$;

-- The release itself (the admin's confirmed action calls it; the audit tie is not prototyped here).
CREATE FUNCTION public.seal_release(action uuid, basis text) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  rep record; word text; rid uuid; posts uuid[];
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = seal_release.action AND m.kind = 'seal_media' AND m.decision_kind = 'final';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_open' USING DETAIL = 'Only a seal for good that is in force is released.'; END IF;
  SELECT r.* INTO rep FROM public.seal_report(seal_release.action) r;
  IF rep.reported IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_reported'; END IF;
  SELECT n.answer INTO word FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id
    JOIN public.lab_notifications n ON n.case_id = d.case_id AND n.account_id = a.subject_account_id WHERE a.id = seal_release.action;
  IF seal_release.basis = 'answer' AND word IS DISTINCT FROM 'illegal' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_for_answer'; END IF;
  IF seal_release.basis = 'period' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_period_unset'; END IF;
  SELECT array_agg(s.post_id ORDER BY s.post_id) INTO posts FROM public.seal_posts s WHERE s.action_id = seal_release.action
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_releases r WHERE r.action_id = s.action_id AND r.post_id = s.post_id);
  IF posts IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_open' USING DETAIL = 'Already released.'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.releases (seal_action_id, post_ids, basis, answer, their_reference, released_at)
  VALUES (seal_release.action, posts, seal_release.basis, word, rep.their_reference, now()) RETURNING id INTO rid;
  INSERT INTO public.seal_releases (action_id, post_id, release_id) SELECT seal_release.action, p, rid FROM unnest(posts) p;
  UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = now() WHERE m.post_id = ANY(posts) AND m.erased_at IS NULL;
  RETURN rid;
END $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.seal_release(uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.seal_release(uuid, text) TO korbat_api;

-- The replay after a restore: one recorded release, applied to every seal in force that lists one of its posts,
-- whenever that seal was taken; a post no seal lists is erased all the same. Idempotent by replay_of.
CREATE FUNCTION public.release_replay(original uuid, posts uuid[], basis text, answer text, their_reference text, released_at timestamptz) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  rid uuid; marks integer; rows integer;
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.releases r WHERE r.id = original OR r.replay_of = original) THEN RETURN 'present'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.releases (post_ids, basis, answer, their_reference, released_at, replay_of)
  VALUES (posts, basis, answer, their_reference, released_at, original) RETURNING id INTO rid;
  INSERT INTO public.seal_releases (action_id, post_id, release_id)
  SELECT s.action_id, s.post_id, rid FROM public.seal_posts s JOIN public.measures_in_force m ON m.id = s.action_id
   WHERE s.post_id = ANY(posts) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS marks = ROW_COUNT;
  UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = now() WHERE m.post_id = ANY(posts) AND m.erased_at IS NULL;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS rows = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN format('replayed: %s marks, %s image rows', marks, rows);
END $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.release_replay(uuid, uuid[], text, text, text, timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."decisions_record"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  c public.cases;
  -- The decision a correction or a review is about.
  reviewed public.decisions;
  pending_appeal uuid;
  snapshot public.evidence_snapshots;
  subject uuid;
  reporters uuid[];
  considers_suspect boolean;
  considers_illegal boolean;
  considers_r5 boolean;
  from_notice boolean;
  from_user boolean;
  decider_role text;
  frozen boolean;
  per_hour integer;
  per_day integer;
  in_hour integer;
  in_day integer;
  reason_kind public.staff_text_kind;
  ends_interim boolean := false;
  target_deleted boolean;
  considers_automated boolean;
  considers_match boolean;
  automated_rule boolean;
BEGIN
  NEW.decided_at := now();
  NEW.xact := pg_current_xact_id();
  NEW.puid := replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '');
  NEW.informed_at := NEW.decided_at;
  NEW.answers_from_seq := NULL;
  NEW.automated_detection := NEW.decided_by IS NULL;
  NEW.automated_decision := CASE WHEN NEW.decided_by IS NULL THEN 'fully' ELSE 'not_automated' END;
  NEW.territorial_scope := 'worldwide';
  NEW.author_mail_at := NULL;
  -- Only the erasure of a later migration marks a decision redacted.
  NEW.redacted_at := NULL;
  -- Only a review names an appeal, and step 2 forces which.
  NEW.appeal_id := NULL;

  -- 1.
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = NEW.case_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'a decision names a case that does not exist' USING ERRCODE = '23503';
  END IF;
  IF c.state_version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.seen_state_version THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
  END IF;

  -- 2.
  IF NEW.decided_by IS NULL AND (NEW.kind <> 'interim' OR NEW.ground IS DISTINCT FROM 'incompatible'
       OR NEW.rule_id IS NULL OR NEW.rule_id NOT IN ('R1', 'R2')
       OR NEW.facts_digest IS NOT NULL OR NEW.reason_digest IS NOT NULL OR NEW.legal_reference_digest IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An automated decision is taken while deciding, under R1 or R2, with no text.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'interim' THEN
    IF NEW.outcome <> 'restricted' OR c.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An interim decision restricts, on an open case.';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'final' THEN
    IF NEW.outcome NOT IN ('restricted', 'no_violation', 'not_evident') OR c.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A final decision restricts or finds no breach, on an open case.';
    END IF;
    IF NOT (c.answered_seq < NEW.through_seq AND NEW.through_seq <= c.intake_seq) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
    END IF;
    NEW.answers_from_seq := c.answered_seq + 1;
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'correction' THEN
    SELECT d.* INTO reviewed FROM public.decisions d
     WHERE d.id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND d.case_id = NEW.case_id AND d.kind IN ('interim', 'final') AND d.outcome = 'restricted';
    IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.outcome NOT IN ('partly_reversed', 'reversed') OR NEW.category <> reviewed.category
       OR NEW.rules_version <> reviewed.rules_version OR NEW.reason_digest IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A correction reverses a restricting decision of its case, with that decision''s category and rules version and a reason.';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'review' THEN
    SELECT d.* INTO reviewed FROM public.decisions d
     WHERE d.id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND d.case_id = NEW.case_id AND d.kind = 'final' AND d.outcome = 'restricted';
    IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.outcome NOT IN ('kept', 'partly_reversed', 'reversed') OR NEW.category <> reviewed.category
       OR NEW.rules_version <> reviewed.rules_version OR NEW.reason_digest IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A review keeps or reverses a final restriction of its case, with that decision''s category and rules version and a reason.';
    END IF;
    -- A statement of its own after the case's lock: it sees an appeal, and an answer to one, that committed while the lock waited.
    SELECT a.id INTO pending_appeal FROM public.appeals a WHERE a.decision_id = reviewed.id AND a.answered_by IS NULL;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
    END IF;
    NEW.appeal_id := pending_appeal;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision is interim, final, a correction or a review.';
  END IF;

  -- 3.
  SELECT s.* INTO snapshot FROM public.evidence_snapshots s WHERE s.id = NEW.snapshot_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR snapshot.case_id <> NEW.case_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot_mismatch';
  END IF;
  IF snapshot.erased_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot_erased';
  END IF;
  IF snapshot.digest IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.snapshot_digest THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot_mismatch';
  END IF;

  -- 4. A read: decisions_apply confirms the texts, and refuses when one is gone by then.
  reason_kind := CASE WHEN NEW.kind IN ('review', 'correction') THEN 'review_reason' ELSE 'reason' END;
  IF (NEW.facts_digest IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_texts t WHERE t.digest = NEW.facts_digest AND t.case_id = NEW.case_id AND t.author_id = NEW.decided_by
           AND t.kind = 'facts' AND t.confirmed_at IS NULL AND t.erased_at IS NULL))
     OR (NEW.reason_digest IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_texts t WHERE t.digest = NEW.reason_digest AND t.case_id = NEW.case_id AND t.author_id = NEW.decided_by
           AND t.kind = reason_kind AND t.confirmed_at IS NULL AND t.erased_at IS NULL))
     OR (NEW.legal_reference_digest IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_texts t WHERE t.digest = NEW.legal_reference_digest AND t.case_id = NEW.case_id AND t.author_id = NEW.decided_by
           AND t.kind = 'legal_reference' AND t.confirmed_at IS NULL AND t.erased_at IS NULL)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'text_not_found';
  END IF;

  -- 5. What the decision considers: a final decision the items it answers, an interim one every unanswered item, a
  -- correction or a review the items its reviewed decision answered (for a corrected interim decision, every unanswered
  -- item). One statement after the case's lock reads every fact the steps below need of them.
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    SELECT p.author_id INTO subject FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
  ELSE
    subject := c.target_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT i.reporter_account_id) FILTER (WHERE i.reporter_account_id IS NOT NULL), '{}'::uuid[]),
         coalesce(bool_or(i.suspect), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(i.alleges_illegal), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(n.rule_id = 'R5'), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind = 'user' AND i.alleges_illegal), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind = 'user'), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind::text = 'automated'), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind::text = 'automated' AND n.rule_id = 'R2'), false),
         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind::text = 'automated' AND n.rule_id = NEW.rule_id), false)
    INTO reporters, considers_suspect, considers_illegal, considers_r5, from_notice, from_user,
         considers_automated, considers_match, automated_rule
    FROM public.intake_items i JOIN public.intakes n ON n.id = i.intake_id
   WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id
     AND CASE WHEN NEW.kind = 'final' THEN i.seq BETWEEN NEW.answers_from_seq AND NEW.through_seq
              WHEN NEW.kind IN ('correction', 'review') AND reviewed.kind = 'final' THEN i.answered_by = reviewed.id
              ELSE i.answered_by IS NULL END;
  IF NEW.decided_by IS NULL AND NOT automated_rule THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An automated decision rests on an unanswered automated finding under its rule.';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.decided_by IS NOT NULL AND public.staff_party_conflict(NEW.decided_by, array_remove(ARRAY[subject], NULL) || reporters, CASE WHEN c.target_type = 'post' THEN c.target_id END) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'staff_recused';
  END IF;
  -- The decision being inserted is not stored yet, so every decision of the case this reads is an earlier one.
  IF NEW.kind = 'review' AND (
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.case_id = NEW.case_id AND x.decided_by = NEW.decided_by)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i JOIN public.intakes n ON n.id = i.intake_id
                   WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND n.finding_by = NEW.decided_by)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reviewer_conflict';
  END IF;

  -- 6.
  SELECT u.role::text INTO decider_role FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = NEW.decided_by FOR SHARE;
  PERFORM public.account_is_staff(subject);
  NEW.suspect := CASE WHEN NEW.kind IN ('correction', 'review') THEN reviewed.suspect ELSE considers_suspect END;
  NEW.unseen := false;
  IF NEW.kind = 'final' AND c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    -- Read now, before decisions_apply answers anything: frozen through a suspect item of this case, through the author's
    -- account's case, or through a seal in force.
    SELECT public.post_frozen(c.target_id) INTO frozen;
    NEW.unseen := coalesce(frozen, false);
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'final' AND NEW.suspect AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL AND i.seq > NEW.through_seq) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.rule_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'R2' AND NOT NEW.suspect THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A decision under R2 rests on a suspect item: a finding citing R2 is opened first.';
  END IF;
  NEW.needs_admin := CASE NEW.kind
                       WHEN 'final' THEN NEW.suspect OR considers_r5 OR coalesce(NEW.rule_id IN ('R2', 'R5'), false)
                       WHEN 'correction' THEN reviewed.needs_admin
                       WHEN 'review' THEN public.review_needs_admin(NEW.reviews_decision_id)
                       ELSE false END;
  IF NEW.needs_admin AND decider_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.decided_by IS NOT NULL AND NEW.kind IN ('interim', 'final') THEN
    NEW.automated_detection := considers_automated;
    NEW.automated_decision := CASE WHEN considers_match AND NEW.suspect AND NEW.outcome = 'restricted' THEN 'partially' ELSE 'not_automated' END;
  ELSIF NEW.decided_by IS NOT NULL THEN
    NEW.automated_detection := reviewed.automated_detection;
  END IF;

  -- 7. A one-bigint key: the social module's pair locks use the two-key space, so the two never meet.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('korbat.decision_cap:' || coalesce(NEW.decided_by::text, 'system'), 0));
  SELECT l.decisions_per_hour, l.decisions_per_day INTO per_hour, per_day FROM public.moderation_limits l WHERE l.id = 1;
  IF NEW.decided_by IS NULL THEN
    SELECT r.decisions_per_hour, r.decisions_per_day INTO per_hour, per_day FROM public.automation_rules() r;
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 hour'), count(*) INTO in_hour, in_day
    FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.decided_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.decided_by AND d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 day';
  IF in_hour >= coalesce(per_hour, 60) OR in_day >= coalesce(per_day, 300) THEN
    IF NEW.decided_by IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'automation_capped'; END IF;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_cap';
  END IF;

  -- 8.
  IF (NEW.ground IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'illegal' OR NEW.outcome = 'not_evident') AND NOT considers_illegal THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The ground of the law, and "illegality not evident", need a considered item that alleges illegality.';
  END IF;

  -- 9.
  NEW.source := CASE WHEN NEW.kind IN ('correction', 'review') THEN reviewed.source
                     WHEN from_notice THEN 'notice'::public.decision_source
                     WHEN from_user THEN 'report'::public.decision_source
                     ELSE 'own_initiative'::public.decision_source END;

  -- 10. Both reads come after the case's lock and after the subject's profile lock, which the deciding transaction takes
  -- first and the author's deletion and the purge take too, so the target cannot be deleted before the commit.
  IF NEW.kind = 'final' AND NEW.through_seq = c.intake_seq THEN
    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = m.decision_id
                    WHERE m.case_id = NEW.case_id AND m.decision_kind = 'interim' AND m.kind <> 'seal_media' AND d.author_mail <> 'none')
      INTO ends_interim;
  END IF;
  NEW.ended_interim := ends_interim;
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    SELECT p.state = 'deleted_by_author' INTO target_deleted FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
  ELSE
    SELECT p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL INTO target_deleted FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
  END IF;
  NEW.author_mail := CASE
                       WHEN NEW.ended_interim THEN 'pending'
                       WHEN NEW.kind = 'interim' AND NOT coalesce(target_deleted, false) THEN 'pending'
                       WHEN NEW.kind = 'final' AND NEW.outcome = 'restricted' THEN 'pending'
                       WHEN NEW.kind = 'correction' AND reviewed.author_mail <> 'none' THEN 'pending'
                       WHEN NEW.kind = 'review' THEN 'pending'
                       ELSE 'none' END::public.delivery_state;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."decision_holds"(decision uuid) RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  d public.decisions;
  a public.audit_log;
  params jsonb;
  expected jsonb;
  recorded jsonb;
  held jsonb;
  differing text;
  measures integer;
  reversals integer;
  in_force integer;
  n_signals integer;
  sig public.automated_signals;
BEGIN
  -- The row as it stands now: later triggers of its transaction may have marked it since its insert.
  SELECT x.* INTO d FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = decision_holds.decision;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  SELECT l.* INTO a FROM public.audit_head h JOIN public.audit_log l ON l.chain_seq = h.seq WHERE h.id = 1;
  IF NOT FOUND OR a.metadata ->> 'decisionId' IS DISTINCT FROM d.id::text THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'decisionId: the transaction''s last audit row does not name this decision.';
  END IF;
  IF d.decided_by IS NULL THEN
    IF a.step_up IS NOT NULL OR a.key_id IS NOT NULL OR a.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid OR a.action IS DISTINCT FROM 'automated_decided' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'system: an automated decision stands with the system actor''s row automated_decided and no confirmation.';
    END IF;
    SELECT count(*) INTO n_signals FROM public.automated_signals s WHERE s.decision_id = d.id;
    SELECT s.* INTO sig FROM public.automated_signals s WHERE s.decision_id = d.id LIMIT 1;
    IF n_signals <> 1 OR a.metadata ->> 'signalId' IS DISTINCT FROM sig.id::text
       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.post_media m JOIN public.cases k ON k.id = d.case_id
                       WHERE m.id = sig.media_id AND k.target_type = 'post' AND m.post_id = k.target_id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'signal: an automated decision rests on exactly one signal, about an image of its case''s post, that the audit row names.';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF a.step_up IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'stepUp: the audit row carries no confirmation.';
    END IF;
    IF a.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.decided_by THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'actor: the audit row was written by another account than the decision''s.';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF d.kind = 'review' THEN
    IF a.action IS DISTINCT FROM 'appeals_reviewed' OR a.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision' OR a.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.reviews_decision_id::text THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'target: the audit row is not appeals_reviewed on the reviewed decision.';
    END IF;
    expected := jsonb_build_object('stateVersion', d.seen_state_version, 'appealId', d.appeal_id, 'snapshotId', d.snapshot_id,
      'snapshotDigest', d.snapshot_digest, 'outcome', d.outcome, 'rulesVersion', d.rules_version, 'redressVersion', d.redress_version,
      'category', d.category, 'reasonDigest', d.reason_digest);
  ELSE
    IF a.action IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN d.decided_by IS NULL THEN 'automated_decided' ELSE 'case_decided' END)
       OR a.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'case' OR a.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.case_id::text THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'target: the audit row is not case_decided on the decision''s case.';
    END IF;
    expected := jsonb_build_object('kind', d.kind, 'stateVersion', d.seen_state_version, 'throughSeq', d.through_seq,
      'reviewsDecisionId', d.reviews_decision_id, 'snapshotId', d.snapshot_id, 'snapshotDigest', d.snapshot_digest, 'outcome', d.outcome,
      'ground', d.ground, 'ruleId', d.rule_id, 'rulesVersion', d.rules_version, 'redressVersion', d.redress_version, 'category', d.category,
      'categoryKeyword', d.category_keyword, 'factsDigest', d.facts_digest, 'reasonDigest', d.reason_digest,
      'legalReferenceDigest', d.legal_reference_digest);
  END IF;
  params := a.metadata -> 'params';
  IF params IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(params) <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'params: the audit row carries none.';
  END IF;
  IF (params - 'actions') IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN
    SELECT string_agg(x.key, ', ' ORDER BY x.key) INTO differing
      FROM (SELECT coalesce(e.key, p.key) AS key
              FROM jsonb_each(expected) e FULL JOIN jsonb_each(params - 'actions') p ON p.key = e.key
             WHERE e.value IS DISTINCT FROM p.value) x;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = format('params: %s differ from the decision.', differing);
  END IF;
  recorded := params -> 'actions';
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', x.kind, 'mediaId', x.media_id)), '[]'::jsonb),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio')),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind NOT IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio'))
    INTO held, measures, reversals
    FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id;
  IF recorded IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(recorded) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'actions: the audit row''s params list none.';
  END IF;
  IF NOT ((held) @> (recorded) AND (recorded) @> (held)) OR jsonb_array_length(held) <> jsonb_array_length(recorded) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'actions: the decision''s measures and reversals are not those the audit row''s params list.';
  END IF;

  IF d.decided_by IS NULL AND (measures <> 1 OR reversals <> 0 OR NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x
        WHERE x.decision_id = d.id
          AND ((sig.kind = 'r1_score' AND d.rule_id = 'R1' AND x.kind = 'withhold_media' AND x.media_id = sig.media_id)
            OR (sig.kind = 'known_match' AND d.rule_id = 'R2' AND x.kind = 'seal_media')))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'measure: an automated decision holds one measure: the scored image withheld, or the matched post''s images sealed.';
  END IF;
  IF d.outcome = 'restricted' AND measures = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'restricted: a restriction holds at least one measure.';
  END IF;
  IF d.outcome IN ('no_violation', 'not_evident') AND measures > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'no action: a decision that finds no breach holds no measure.';
  END IF;
  IF d.outcome = 'kept' AND measures + reversals > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'kept: a review that keeps the decision holds no measure and no reversal.';
  END IF;
  IF d.outcome IN ('reversed', 'partly_reversed') THEN
    IF reversals = 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'reversed: a reversing decision holds at least one reversal.';
    END IF;
    SELECT count(*) INTO in_force FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.decision_id = d.reviews_decision_id;
    IF d.outcome = 'reversed' AND in_force > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'reversed: a measure of the reviewed decision is still in force.';
    END IF;
    IF d.outcome = 'partly_reversed' AND in_force = 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'partly_reversed: no measure of the reviewed decision is left in force.';
    END IF;
  END IF;
END $$;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/automation/30-tables.sql`

```sql
-- LAB 3d prototype, tables and plain functions (run inside 30-proto.sql, one transaction, as korbat_migrate, on 0017).
ALTER TYPE public.intake_kind ADD VALUE 'automated';
ALTER TYPE public.intake_channel ADD VALUE 'system';

-- A decider that is not a person.
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ALTER COLUMN decided_by DROP NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ADD CONSTRAINT decisions_decider
  CHECK ((decided_by IS NULL) = (automated_decision = 'fully') AND (decided_by IS NOT NULL OR kind::text = 'interim'));
ALTER TABLE public.decisions DROP CONSTRAINT decisions_restricted;
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ADD CONSTRAINT decisions_restricted
  CHECK (outcome::text <> 'restricted' OR (ground IS NOT NULL AND (decided_by IS NULL OR (facts_digest IS NOT NULL AND reason_digest IS NOT NULL))));
ALTER TABLE public.intakes DROP CONSTRAINT intakes_finding;
ALTER TABLE public.intakes ADD CONSTRAINT intakes_finding
  CHECK ((kind::text = 'finding') = (finding_by IS NOT NULL) AND (kind::text = 'finding') = (channel::text = 'staff')
     AND (kind::text = 'automated') = (channel::text = 'system'));
ALTER TABLE public.intakes DROP CONSTRAINT intakes_r2_finding_only;
ALTER TABLE public.intakes ADD CONSTRAINT intakes_r2_finding_only
  CHECK (rule_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'R2' OR kind::text IN ('finding', 'automated'));
ALTER TABLE public.intakes ADD CONSTRAINT intakes_automated
  CHECK (kind::text <> 'automated' OR (automated_processing AND rule_id IN ('R1', 'R2') AND NOT alleges_illegal AND NOT csam
     AND reporter_id IS NULL AND contact_id IS NULL AND finding_by IS NULL));

CREATE TABLE public.automated_signals (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('r1_score', 'known_match')),
  media_id uuid NOT NULL,
  decision_id uuid REFERENCES public.decisions(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE public.automated_signals ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY automated_signals_api ON public.automated_signals FOR ALL TO korbat_api USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
REVOKE ALL ON public.automated_signals FROM korbat_api;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON public.automated_signals TO korbat_api;
GRANT UPDATE (decision_id) ON public.automated_signals TO korbat_api;

CREATE FUNCTION public.automation_rules() RETURNS TABLE (decisions_per_hour integer, decisions_per_day integer)
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT 5, 50 $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.automation_rules() FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.automation_rules() TO korbat_api;

-- The release: the record, the mark keyed on seal_posts' key, the clause in the seal arm.
CREATE TABLE public.releases (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  seal_action_id uuid,
  post_ids uuid[] NOT NULL,
  basis text NOT NULL CHECK (basis IN ('answer', 'period')),
  answer text,
  their_reference text,
  released_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  replay_of uuid,
  CONSTRAINT releases_replay_once UNIQUE (replay_of)
);
CREATE TABLE public.seal_releases (
  action_id uuid NOT NULL,
  post_id uuid NOT NULL,
  release_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.releases(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (action_id, post_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (action_id, post_id) REFERENCES public.seal_posts(action_id, post_id)
);
ALTER TABLE public.releases ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.seal_releases ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY releases_api ON public.releases FOR SELECT TO korbat_api USING (true);
CREATE POLICY seal_releases_api ON public.seal_releases FOR SELECT TO korbat_api USING (true);
REVOKE ALL ON public.releases, public.seal_releases FROM korbat_api;
GRANT SELECT ON public.releases, public.seal_releases TO korbat_api;

-- Stand-in for 3f's record of the report (authority_notifications) and its seal_report, as F 6.5 specifies them.
CREATE TABLE public.lab_notifications (seal_action_id uuid, case_id uuid, account_id uuid, state text, answer text, their_reference text, answered_at timestamptz);
REVOKE ALL ON public.lab_notifications FROM korbat_api;
CREATE FUNCTION public.seal_report(action uuid) RETURNS TABLE (reported boolean, their_reference text, answered_at timestamptz)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT n.state = 'sent', n.their_reference, n.answered_at
    FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id
    JOIN public.lab_notifications n ON n.case_id = d.case_id AND n.account_id = a.subject_account_id
   WHERE a.id = seal_report.action
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.seal_report(uuid) FROM PUBLIC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.frozen_for(post uuid, author uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.cases c
      JOIN public.intake_items i ON i.case_id = c.id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL
      WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND c.target_type = 'post' AND c.target_id = frozen_for.post)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.cases c
      JOIN public.intake_items i ON i.case_id = c.id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL
      WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND c.target_type = 'account' AND c.target_id = frozen_for.author)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_posts s
      JOIN public.measures_in_force m ON m.id = s.action_id
      WHERE s.post_id = frozen_for.post
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_releases r WHERE r.action_id = s.action_id AND r.post_id = s.post_id))
$$;

-- The release itself (the admin's confirmed action calls it; the audit tie is not prototyped here).
CREATE FUNCTION public.seal_release(action uuid, basis text) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  rep record; word text; rid uuid; posts uuid[];
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = seal_release.action AND m.kind = 'seal_media' AND m.decision_kind = 'final';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_open' USING DETAIL = 'Only a seal for good that is in force is released.'; END IF;
  SELECT r.* INTO rep FROM public.seal_report(seal_release.action) r;
  IF rep.reported IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_reported'; END IF;
  SELECT n.answer INTO word FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id
    JOIN public.lab_notifications n ON n.case_id = d.case_id AND n.account_id = a.subject_account_id WHERE a.id = seal_release.action;
  IF seal_release.basis = 'answer' AND word IS DISTINCT FROM 'illegal' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_for_answer'; END IF;
  IF seal_release.basis = 'period' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_period_unset'; END IF;
  SELECT array_agg(s.post_id ORDER BY s.post_id) INTO posts FROM public.seal_posts s WHERE s.action_id = seal_release.action
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_releases r WHERE r.action_id = s.action_id AND r.post_id = s.post_id);
  IF posts IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_open' USING DETAIL = 'Already released.'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.releases (seal_action_id, post_ids, basis, answer, their_reference, released_at)
  VALUES (seal_release.action, posts, seal_release.basis, word, rep.their_reference, now()) RETURNING id INTO rid;
  INSERT INTO public.seal_releases (action_id, post_id, release_id) SELECT seal_release.action, p, rid FROM unnest(posts) p;
  UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = now() WHERE m.post_id = ANY(posts) AND m.erased_at IS NULL;
  RETURN rid;
END $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.seal_release(uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.seal_release(uuid, text) TO korbat_api;

-- The replay after a restore: one recorded release, applied to every seal in force that lists one of its posts,
-- whenever that seal was taken; a post no seal lists is erased all the same. Idempotent by replay_of.
CREATE FUNCTION public.release_replay(original uuid, posts uuid[], basis text, answer text, their_reference text, released_at timestamptz) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  rid uuid; marks integer; rows integer;
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.releases r WHERE r.id = original OR r.replay_of = original) THEN RETURN 'present'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.releases (post_ids, basis, answer, their_reference, released_at, replay_of)
  VALUES (posts, basis, answer, their_reference, released_at, original) RETURNING id INTO rid;
  INSERT INTO public.seal_releases (action_id, post_id, release_id)
  SELECT s.action_id, s.post_id, rid FROM public.seal_posts s JOIN public.measures_in_force m ON m.id = s.action_id
   WHERE s.post_id = ANY(posts) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS marks = ROW_COUNT;
  UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = now() WHERE m.post_id = ANY(posts) AND m.erased_at IS NULL;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS rows = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN format('replayed: %s marks, %s image rows', marks, rows);
END $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.release_replay(uuid, uuid[], text, text, text, timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/automation/31-helpers.sql`

```sql
-- LAB 3d helpers, as korbat_migrate after 30-proto.sql. SECURITY INVOKER: called by korbat_api they run the statements
-- the API would run, in the caller's transaction, so triggers, locks and deferred checks are the real ones.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_salt() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS $$ SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(gen_random_uuid()::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') $$;
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_digest(salt text, body text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
  SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to('korbat.text.v1', 'UTF8') || decode('0a', 'hex') || decode(salt, 'hex') || convert_to(body, 'UTF8')), 'hex') $$;
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_ref() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS $$ SELECT 'N-' || translate(upper(substr(public.lab_salt(), 1, 10)), '0189', 'GHIJ') $$;
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_params(d public.decisions, acts jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind', d.kind, 'stateVersion', d.seen_state_version, 'throughSeq', d.through_seq,
    'reviewsDecisionId', d.reviews_decision_id, 'snapshotId', d.snapshot_id, 'snapshotDigest', d.snapshot_digest, 'outcome', d.outcome,
    'ground', d.ground, 'ruleId', d.rule_id, 'rulesVersion', d.rules_version, 'redressVersion', d.redress_version, 'category', d.category,
    'categoryKeyword', d.category_keyword, 'factsDigest', d.facts_digest, 'reasonDigest', d.reason_digest,
    'legalReferenceDigest', d.legal_reference_digest, 'actions', acts) $$;

-- The open case of a post (opened when there is none), with the author's profile locked first, as the API does.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_case(post uuid) RETURNS public.cases LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE c public.cases; author uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT q.author_id INTO author FROM public.posts q WHERE q.id = post;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = author FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.target_type = 'post' AND k.target_id = post AND k.closed_at IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN INSERT INTO public.cases (target_type, target_id, opened_at) VALUES ('post', post, now()) RETURNING * INTO c; END IF;
  RETURN c;
END $$;
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_snapshot(c public.cases, post uuid) RETURNS public.evidence_snapshots LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE s text := public.lab_salt(); e public.evidence_snapshots;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, taken_at, author_handle, body, salt, digest)
  VALUES (c.id, 'post', post, now(), 's', 'b', s, public.lab_digest(s, 'snap')) RETURNING * INTO e;
  RETURN e;
END $$;

-- The automated step: finding (automated, system), signal, automated interim decision with one measure, the system's audit row.
-- act: 'on' takes the measure; 'off' is the fallback (finding and signal only). tamper injects one fault.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_auto(post uuid, media uuid, rule text, act text DEFAULT 'on', tamper text DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  c public.cases; e public.evidence_snapshots; d public.decisions; iid uuid; sid uuid; author uuid;
  measure text := CASE WHEN rule = 'R2' THEN 'seal_media' ELSE 'withhold_media' END; acts jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT q.author_id INTO author FROM public.posts q WHERE q.id = post;
  c := public.lab_case(post);
  INSERT INTO public.intakes (kind, ref, channel, rule_id, category, automated_processing, received_at)
  VALUES ('automated', public.lab_ref(), 'system', CASE WHEN tamper = 'finding_r3' THEN 'R3' ELSE rule END,
          CASE WHEN rule = 'R2' THEN 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' ELSE 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE' END, true, now()) RETURNING id INTO iid;
  INSERT INTO public.intake_items (intake_id, position, target_type, target_id, case_id, lane, created_at)
  VALUES (iid, 1, 'post', post, c.id, CASE WHEN rule = 'R2' THEN 0 ELSE 2 END, now());
  INSERT INTO public.automated_signals (kind, media_id) VALUES (CASE WHEN rule = 'R2' THEN 'known_match' ELSE 'r1_score' END, media) RETURNING id INTO sid;
  IF act = 'off' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = c.id;
  e := public.lab_snapshot(c, post);
  IF tamper = 'measure_remove' THEN measure := 'remove_media'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.decisions (case_id, kind, seen_state_version, through_seq, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
  VALUES (c.id, CASE WHEN tamper = 'final' THEN 'final'::public.decision_kind ELSE 'interim' END, c.state_version,
          CASE WHEN tamper = 'final' THEN c.intake_seq ELSE 0 END, 'restricted', 'incompatible', CASE WHEN tamper = 'rule_r3' THEN 'R3' ELSE rule END, 2, 1,
          CASE WHEN rule = 'R2' THEN 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' ELSE 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE' END, 'own_initiative',
          e.id, e.digest, NULL, now(), pg_current_xact_id(), 'x', now(), false, false, false) RETURNING * INTO d;
  acts := jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind', measure, 'mediaId', CASE WHEN measure = 'seal_media' THEN NULL ELSE media END));
  INSERT INTO public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, media_id, subject_account_id, created_at)
  VALUES (d.id, measure::public.action_kind, CASE WHEN measure = 'seal_media' THEN NULL ELSE media END, author, now());
  IF tamper = 'two_measures' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, subject_account_id, created_at) VALUES (d.id, 'withhold', author, now());
    acts := acts || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind', 'withhold', 'mediaId', NULL));
  END IF;
  IF tamper IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_signal' THEN UPDATE public.automated_signals SET decision_id = d.id WHERE id = sid; END IF;
  IF tamper = 'no_audit' THEN RETURN d.id; END IF;
  IF tamper = 'staff_audit' THEN
    PERFORM public.append_confirmed_audit('00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000bb', 'case_decided', 'case', c.id::text,
      jsonb_build_object('decisionId', d.id, 'signalId', sid, 'params', public.lab_params(d, acts)),
      gen_random_uuid(), repeat('a', 64), '{}'::jsonb, 'lab', (extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint + 60000);
    RETURN d.id;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, request_id)
  VALUES ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'automated_decided', 'case', c.id::text,
          jsonb_build_object('decisionId', d.id, 'signalId', sid, 'params', public.lab_params(d, acts)), 'lab');
  RETURN d.id;
END $$;

-- A person's finding citing a rule (R2 makes the item suspect), as POST /api/staff/findings.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_finding(post uuid, staff uuid, rule text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE c public.cases; iid uuid;
BEGIN
  c := public.lab_case(post);
  INSERT INTO public.intakes (kind, ref, channel, finding_by, rule_id, category, received_at)
  VALUES ('finding', public.lab_ref(), 'staff', staff, rule, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', now()) RETURNING id INTO iid;
  INSERT INTO public.intake_items (intake_id, position, target_type, target_id, case_id, lane, created_at) VALUES (iid, 1, 'post', post, c.id, 0, now());
  RETURN c.id;
END $$;

-- A person's decision on a post's open case: kind interim, final or correction (of decision corrects), with its actions.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_person(post uuid, decider uuid, key uuid, kind text, outcome text, rule text, acts jsonb, corrects uuid DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  c public.cases; e public.evidence_snapshots; d public.decisions; author uuid; s text; fd text; rd text; a jsonb; o public.decisions;
  cat text := CASE WHEN rule = 'R2' THEN 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' ELSE 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE' END;
BEGIN
  SELECT q.author_id INTO author FROM public.posts q WHERE q.id = post;
  c := public.lab_case(post);
  IF corrects IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT x.* INTO o FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = corrects;
    SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = o.case_id;
    cat := o.category;
  END IF;
  e := public.lab_snapshot(c, post);
  IF outcome = 'restricted' THEN
    s := public.lab_salt(); fd := public.lab_digest(s, 'facts');
    INSERT INTO public.staff_texts (case_id, author_id, kind, text, salt, digest, created_at) VALUES (c.id, decider, 'facts', 'facts', s, fd, now());
  END IF;
  IF outcome = 'restricted' OR kind = 'correction' THEN
    s := public.lab_salt(); rd := public.lab_digest(s, 'reason');
    INSERT INTO public.staff_texts (case_id, author_id, kind, text, salt, digest, created_at)
    VALUES (c.id, decider, CASE WHEN kind = 'correction' THEN 'review_reason'::public.staff_text_kind ELSE 'reason' END, 'reason', s, rd, now());
  END IF;
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = c.id;
  INSERT INTO public.decisions (case_id, kind, reviews_decision_id, seen_state_version, through_seq, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, facts_digest, reason_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
  VALUES (c.id, kind::public.decision_kind, corrects, c.state_version, CASE WHEN kind = 'final' THEN c.intake_seq ELSE 0 END, outcome::public.decision_outcome,
          CASE WHEN outcome = 'restricted' THEN 'incompatible'::public.decision_ground END, CASE WHEN outcome = 'restricted' THEN rule END,
          CASE WHEN corrects IS NOT NULL THEN o.rules_version ELSE 2 END, 1, cat, 'own_initiative',
          e.id, e.digest, fd, rd, decider, now(), pg_current_xact_id(), 'x', now(), false, false, false) RETURNING * INTO d;
  FOR a IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(acts) LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, media_id, subject_account_id, created_at)
    VALUES (d.id, (a ->> 'kind')::public.action_kind, (a ->> 'mediaId')::uuid, author, now());
  END LOOP;
  SELECT x.* INTO d FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = d.id;
  PERFORM public.append_confirmed_audit(decider, key, 'case_decided', 'case', c.id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('decisionId', d.id, 'params', public.lab_params(d, acts)),
    gen_random_uuid(), repeat('a', 64), '{}'::jsonb, 'lab', (extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint + 60000);
  RETURN d.id;
END $$;

-- What a test prints of a post: its images' states, the freeze, the measures in force.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_state(post uuid) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT format('level=%s images=[%s] frozen=%s in_force=[%s]',
    (SELECT q.moderation_level FROM public.posts q WHERE q.id = post),
    (SELECT string_agg(m.moderation_state::text || CASE WHEN m.erased_at IS NOT NULL THEN '(erased)' ELSE '' END, ',' ORDER BY m.position) FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.post_id = post),
    public.post_frozen(post),
    (SELECT string_agg(f.decision_kind::text || ':' || f.kind::text, ',' ORDER BY f.kind::text, f.decision_kind::text)
       FROM public.measures_in_force f JOIN public.cases k ON k.id = f.case_id WHERE k.target_id = post))
$$;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/automation/RUN.txt`

```text
LAB 3d, run 2026-10-09 between about 19:30 and 19:50 local time (the outputs' times are UTC).

Where it ran. One throwaway container, korbat3d-lab-1, from the local image postgres:18 (no pull, no build):
"PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu", trust authentication, no published port, every
statement through `docker exec ... psql`. No other container was touched. The container was removed at the end
(docker rm -f korbat3d-lab-1).

Schema. Roles as research-3e/lab-3f/00-roles.sql (copied here). Migrations 0000 to 0017 of the scratch clone at HEAD
aab8345, each with `psql -U korbat_migrate -d lab -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -1` (39 tables). 0018 (retention) is in the
clone's working tree, uncommitted, and was NOT applied; 3e's 0019 to 0023 and 3f's 0024 to 0029 are not built. Then
30-proto.sql in ONE transaction (python make_proto.py 0016.sql 0017.sql 30-tables.sql > 30-proto.sql): the two enum
values (intake_kind 'automated', intake_channel 'system'), the changed CHECKs, automated_signals, automation_rules(),
releases, seal_releases, the clause in frozen_for, seal_release, release_replay, a stand-in for 3f's record of a report
(lab_notifications, seal_report), and 3c's own decisions_record (0017) and decision_holds (0016) patched by exact text
replacement. 31-helpers.sql stands in for the API's statements (SECURITY INVOKER, called as korbat_api); 32-seed.sql.

Commands (C = korbat3d-lab-1):
  sh reset.sh                                                         -> lab3d from the template lab
  A: docker exec -i C psql -U korbat_api -d lab3d -X -q < a-system.sql   > out-A.txt   (fresh reset)
  C: sh reset.sh ; psql -U postgres -d lab3d < c1-seal.sql > out-C.txt ; CREATE DATABASE labq TEMPLATE lab3d ;
     psql -U postgres -d lab3d < c2-final.sql >> out-C.txt ; CREATE DATABASE labr TEMPLATE lab3d
  D: psql -U postgres -d lab3d < d1-release.sql > out-D.txt (writes the release's record, tail.jsonl) ;
     psql -U postgres -d labr -v rec=<tail.jsonl> < d2-replay.sql ; the same on labq ; psql -d labq < d3-again.sql ;
     psql -d labq < d4-bypost.sql                                                       > out-D2.txt
  E: sh reset.sh ; CREATE DATABASE labe TEMPLATE lab3d ; psql -U postgres -d labe < e-counts.sql > out-E.txt
The scripts that run as postgres switch to the API's role with SET ROLE korbat_api for every statement the API would run.

Reading the outputs. "WARNING: there is no transaction in progress" follows each COMMIT that a deferred check refused
(the script's ROLLBACK after it finds nothing to roll back). "unterminated quoted string" is psql's \echo meeting an
apostrophe in a caption; it is not a statement. In out-D2.txt the first "permission denied for table release_posts"
is the lab's own fault (the table was created by the superuser, and gate K reads as korbat_migrate); the grant and
the repeated delete follow it.

Not measured: lock contention (one session at a time); the lock order of the automated step against a concurrent
post, deletion or decision; the audit tie of the release (seal_release is a plain definer function here);
audit-verify on an automated decision; anything of the worker, the files, the quarantine's one-shot service, the
edge, Valkey's sketches or a timestamp authority; 3e's and 3f's functions (the prototype sits on 0017, so the real
decisions_record and decision_holds that 3d replaces will carry 3e's and 3f's branches too); a refusal of a second
seal while one is in force (the database accepts it: C3, C4); the edition on real decisions.
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/automation/d1-release.sql`

```sql
-- LAB D, part 1: the release on the answer "illegal" (b02), the clause in the seal arm, gate K afterwards, the cost.
\set VERBOSITY terse
\pset format unaligned
\pset tuples_only on
SET ROLE korbat_api;
\set seal '(SELECT m.id FROM public.measures_in_force m JOIN public.cases k ON k.id = m.case_id WHERE k.target_id = \'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02\' AND m.decision_kind = \'final\')'
\echo == D2 the release
SELECT public.seal_release(:seal, 'answer') IS NOT NULL;
SELECT public.lab_state('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02');
SELECT format('release: basis=%s answer=%s reference=%s posts=%s; marks=%s', r.basis, r.answer, r.their_reference, cardinality(r.post_ids), (SELECT count(*) FROM public.seal_releases)) FROM public.releases r;
\echo -- a second release of the same seal
SELECT public.seal_release(:seal, 'answer');
\echo == D3 gate K after the release: the API role deletes the image rows of b02 (rows deleted, rows left)
WITH gone AS (DELETE FROM public.post_media WHERE post_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02' RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM gone;
SELECT count(*) FROM public.post_media WHERE post_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02';
\echo == D4 a new suspect item about the released post freezes it again through the first arm (b02), and a write of marks by the API role
BEGIN; SELECT public.lab_finding('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', 'R2') IS NOT NULL; COMMIT;
SELECT public.lab_state('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02');
INSERT INTO public.seal_releases (action_id, post_id, release_id) SELECT s.action_id, s.post_id, (SELECT id FROM public.releases LIMIT 1) FROM public.seal_posts s LIMIT 1;
UPDATE public.post_media SET erased_at = now() WHERE id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000d01';
RESET ROLE;
\echo == D5 the record a keeper's copy would carry (one line)
\pset format unaligned
SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', r.id, 'posts', r.post_ids, 'basis', r.basis, 'answer', r.answer, 'reference', r.their_reference, 'at', r.released_at)::text FROM public.releases r \g tail.jsonl.tmp
\echo == D6 the cost of the clause: 20000 calls each, ms a call (old body, new body)
CREATE FUNCTION public.frozen_for_old(post uuid, author uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cases c JOIN public.intake_items i ON i.case_id = c.id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL
                  WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND c.target_type = 'post' AND c.target_id = frozen_for_old.post)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cases c JOIN public.intake_items i ON i.case_id = c.id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL
                WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND c.target_type = 'account' AND c.target_id = frozen_for_old.author)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_posts s JOIN public.measures_in_force m ON m.id = s.action_id WHERE s.post_id = frozen_for_old.post) $$;
DO $$
DECLARE t0 timestamptz; p uuid; lbl text; a uuid := '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'; x boolean; old_ms numeric; new_ms numeric;
BEGIN
  FOR lbl, p IN VALUES ('a post nobody reported (b10)', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b0a'::uuid), ('a sealed post, seal while deciding (b07)', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b07'::uuid) LOOP
    t0 := clock_timestamp(); FOR i IN 1..20000 LOOP x := public.frozen_for_old(p, NULL); END LOOP; old_ms := extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp() - t0) * 1000 / 20000;
    t0 := clock_timestamp(); FOR i IN 1..20000 LOOP x := public.frozen_for(p, NULL); END LOOP; new_ms := extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp() - t0) * 1000 / 20000;
    RAISE NOTICE '%: old % ms, new % ms, answer %', lbl, round(old_ms, 4), round(new_ms, 4), x;
  END LOOP;
END $$;
EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_posts s JOIN public.measures_in_force m ON m.id = s.action_id
 WHERE s.post_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b07' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_releases r WHERE r.action_id = s.action_id AND r.post_id = s.post_id);
```

```sql
-- LAB D, part 2: the replay of the recorded release on a restored database. As postgres (the command line is the migrator).
-- labr: the backup was taken after the seal for good. labq: before it (only the automatic seal while deciding exists).

\pset format unaligned
\pset tuples_only on
SELECT 'before: ' || public.lab_state('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02');
SELECT public.release_replay((j ->> 'id')::uuid, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(j -> 'posts')::uuid), j ->> 'basis', j ->> 'answer', j ->> 'reference', (j ->> 'at')::timestamptz)
  FROM (SELECT :'rec'::jsonb AS j) x;
SELECT 'after:  ' || public.lab_state('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02');
\echo -- run again (idempotent)
SELECT public.release_replay((j ->> 'id')::uuid, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(j -> 'posts')::uuid), j ->> 'basis', j ->> 'answer', j ->> 'reference', (j ->> 'at')::timestamptz)
  FROM (SELECT :'rec'::jsonb AS j) x;
SELECT format('releases=%s marks=%s (of seals: %s)', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.releases), (SELECT count(*) FROM public.seal_releases),
  (SELECT string_agg(d.kind::text || CASE WHEN d.decided_by IS NULL THEN ' by system' ELSE ' by staff' END, ', ') FROM public.seal_releases r JOIN public.decision_actions a ON a.id = r.action_id JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id));
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/automation/d4-bypost.sql`

```sql
-- LAB D, part 4, on labq after part 3: the same clause keyed on the post alone (the model's choice after part 3).
\set VERBOSITY terse
\pset format unaligned
\pset tuples_only on
CREATE TABLE public.release_posts (post_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, release_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.releases(id));
GRANT SELECT ON public.release_posts TO korbat_api;
INSERT INTO public.release_posts SELECT DISTINCT ON (p) p, r.id FROM public.releases r, unnest(r.post_ids) p ORDER BY p, r.released_at;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.frozen_for(post uuid, author uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.cases c
      JOIN public.intake_items i ON i.case_id = c.id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL
      WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND c.target_type = 'post' AND c.target_id = frozen_for.post)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.cases c
      JOIN public.intake_items i ON i.case_id = c.id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL
      WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND c.target_type = 'account' AND c.target_id = frozen_for.author)
    OR (EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_posts s
      JOIN public.measures_in_force m ON m.id = s.action_id
      WHERE s.post_id = frozen_for.post)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.release_posts r WHERE r.post_id = frozen_for.post))
$$;
SELECT 'b02, sealed for good again after the replay: ' || public.lab_state('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02');
SELECT 'b07, sealed and not released: ' || public.lab_state('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b07');
SET ROLE korbat_api;
WITH gone AS (DELETE FROM public.post_media WHERE post_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02' RETURNING 1) SELECT 'rows of b02 the API role deletes: ' || count(*) FROM gone;
RESET ROLE;
DO $$
DECLARE t0 timestamptz; x boolean; ms numeric;
BEGIN
  t0 := clock_timestamp(); FOR i IN 1..20000 LOOP x := public.frozen_for('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b0a', NULL); END LOOP;
  ms := extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp() - t0) * 1000 / 20000; RAISE NOTICE 'by post, a post nobody reported: % ms a call, answer %', round(ms, 4), x;
  t0 := clock_timestamp(); FOR i IN 1..20000 LOOP x := public.frozen_for('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b07', NULL); END LOOP;
  ms := extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp() - t0) * 1000 / 20000; RAISE NOTICE 'by post, a sealed post: % ms a call, answer %', round(ms, 4), x;
END $$;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/automation/e-counts.sql`

```sql
-- LAB E: the counts' queries with the delay and the small-number rule, on synthetic decisions (no real data).
-- As postgres on a copy (labe) of the reset database; triggers off for the bulk insert only.
\set VERBOSITY terse
\pset format aligned
\pset tuples_only off
SET session_replication_role = replica;

SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'final', 0, 'restricted', CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN 'illegal'::public.decision_ground ELSE 'incompatible' END, r, 2, 1, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', 'report',
       gen_random_uuid(), repeat('a', 64), repeat('b', 64), repeat('c', 64), CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN repeat('d', 64) END, '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b',
       make_timestamptz(y, 1 + (g % 12), 1 + (g % 28), 12, 0, 0, 'UTC'), '1'::xid8, md5(random()::text || g), now(), false, false, false, coalesce(r = 'R1' AND g % 3 = 0, false)
  FROM (VALUES (2025, 'R1', 61), (2025, 'R3', 94), (2025, 'R4', 35), (2025, 'R5', 12), (2025, 'R6', 7), (2025, 'R2', 3), (2025, NULL, 4),
               (2026, 'R1', 40), (2026, 'R3', 55), (2026, 'R2', 1)) AS v(y, r, n), generate_series(1, v.n) g;
INSERT INTO public.decisions (case_id, kind, seen_state_version, outcome, rules_version, redress_version, category, source, snapshot_id, snapshot_digest,
                              decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'final', 0, 'no_violation', 2, 1, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', 'report', gen_random_uuid(), repeat('a', 64), '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b',
       make_timestamptz(2025, 1 + (g % 12), 5, 12, 0, 0, 'UTC'), '1'::xid8, md5(random()::text || g), now(), false, false, false FROM generate_series(1, 143) g;
SET session_replication_role = origin;
CREATE TABLE public.lab_orders (id serial PRIMARY KEY, effected_at timestamptz, hold_until timestamptz);
INSERT INTO public.lab_orders (effected_at, hold_until) VALUES ('2025-05-02 10:00+00', NULL), ('2025-11-20 10:00+00', '2027-01-01 00:00+00');

CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_band(n bigint) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
  SELECT CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN '0' WHEN n < 10 THEN '1 to 9' ELSE 'about ' || (round(n / 10.0) * 10)::bigint END $$;
-- One table of an edition: decisions that restricted, by ground, for a closed year after the delay; rows under ten folded.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_figures(y integer, at timestamptz) RETURNS TABLE (label text, exact bigint, published text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
BEGIN
  IF at < make_timestamptz(y + 1, 3, 1, 0, 0, 0, 'UTC') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'edition_not_due'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH raw AS (
    SELECT coalesce(d.rule_id, 'law') AS label, count(*) AS n FROM public.decisions d
     WHERE d.kind::text = 'final' AND d.outcome::text = 'restricted'
       AND d.decided_at >= make_timestamptz(y, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 'UTC') AND d.decided_at < make_timestamptz(y + 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 'UTC')
     GROUP BY 1),
  folded AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN r.n < 10 THEN 'other grounds' ELSE r.label END AS label, sum(r.n)::bigint AS n FROM raw r GROUP BY 1)
  SELECT f.label, f.n, public.lab_band(f.n) FROM folded f
  UNION ALL SELECT 'all restrictions', sum(r.n)::bigint, public.lab_band(sum(r.n)::bigint) FROM raw r
  ORDER BY 1;
END $$;
\echo == E1 the raw cells of 2025 (never published)
SELECT coalesce(rule_id, 'law') AS ground, count(*) FROM public.decisions WHERE kind = 'final' AND outcome = 'restricted' AND decided_at >= '2025-01-01+00' AND decided_at < '2026-01-01+00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
\echo == E2 the edition of 2025 as computed on 2026-10-09
SELECT * FROM public.lab_figures(2025, '2026-10-09 12:00+00');
\echo == E3 the edition of 2025 asked for on 2026-02-28, and the open year 2026 asked for today
SELECT * FROM public.lab_figures(2025, '2026-02-28 12:00+00');
SELECT * FROM public.lab_figures(2026, '2026-10-09 12:00+00');
\echo == E4 subtraction: the published total minus the published rows leaves a range, not a number
SELECT string_agg(published, ' + ' ORDER BY label) FILTER (WHERE label <> 'all restrictions') AS rows_published, max(published) FILTER (WHERE label = 'all restrictions') AS total_published
  FROM public.lab_figures(2025, '2026-10-09 12:00+00');
\echo == E5 orders of 2025 countable on 2026-03-01: one of the two is under a hold until 2027
SELECT public.lab_band(count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.hold_until IS NULL OR o.hold_until <= '2026-03-01+00')) AS counted, count(*) AS exact_in_database FROM public.lab_orders o
 WHERE o.effected_at >= '2025-01-01+00' AND o.effected_at < '2026-01-01+00';
\echo == E6 the rate rule: found by automated means under R1 in 2025, and the share a person then restricted, printed only when the base is ten or more
SELECT public.lab_band(count(*) FILTER (WHERE automated_detection)) AS r1_found_by_program, public.lab_band(count(*)) AS r1_all FROM public.decisions
 WHERE rule_id = 'R1' AND kind = 'final' AND decided_at >= '2025-01-01+00' AND decided_at < '2026-01-01+00';
\echo == E7 cost on 20000 more decisions
SET session_replication_role = replica;
INSERT INTO public.decisions (case_id, kind, seen_state_version, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, source, snapshot_id, snapshot_digest,
                              facts_digest, reason_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'final', 0, 'restricted', 'incompatible', 'R' || (1 + g % 6), 2, 1, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', 'report', gen_random_uuid(), repeat('a', 64),
       repeat('b', 64), repeat('c', 64), '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', make_timestamptz(2024, 1 + (g % 12), 1 + (g % 28), 12, 0, 0, 'UTC'), '1'::xid8, md5(random()::text || g), now(), false, false, false
  FROM generate_series(1, 20000) g;
SET session_replication_role = origin;
ANALYZE public.decisions;
\timing on
SELECT count(*) AS rows_of_edition_2024 FROM public.lab_figures(2024, '2026-10-09 12:00+00');
\timing off
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/automation/make_proto.py`

```python
"""Builds 30-proto.sql: the lab prototype of 3d's automated decision, run in ONE transaction on a database at 0017.

It copies decisions_record (0017) and decision_holds (0016) of the scratch clone and patches them by exact text
replacement, so the lab measures 3c's own trigger code with 3d's branches. The two new enum values are named as
literals only inside PL/pgSQL bodies; CHECKs compare kind::text and channel::text.
Usage: python make_proto.py <0016.sql> <0017.sql> <30-tables.sql> > 30-proto.sql
"""
import re
import sys

src16 = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read().replace("--> statement-breakpoint", "")
src17 = open(sys.argv[2], encoding="utf-8").read().replace("--> statement-breakpoint", "")
tables = open(sys.argv[3], encoding="utf-8").read()


def fn(src, name):
    m = re.search(r'CREATE (OR REPLACE )?FUNCTION "public"\."' + name + r'"\(.*?(END \$\$;|\n\$\$;)', src, re.S)
    assert m, name
    t = m.group(0)
    return t if t.startswith("CREATE OR REPLACE") else t.replace("CREATE FUNCTION", "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION", 1)


def sub(text, old, new):
    assert text.count(old) == 1, (old, text.count(old))
    return text.replace(old, new)


SYSTEM = "'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid"

# ---- decisions_record (0017)
rec = fn(src17, "decisions_record")
rec = sub(rec, "  target_deleted boolean;\nBEGIN",
          "  target_deleted boolean;\n  considers_automated boolean;\n  considers_match boolean;\n  automated_rule boolean;\nBEGIN")
rec = sub(rec, "  NEW.automated_detection := false;\n  NEW.automated_decision := 'not_automated';\n",
          "  NEW.automated_detection := NEW.decided_by IS NULL;\n"
          "  NEW.automated_decision := CASE WHEN NEW.decided_by IS NULL THEN 'fully' ELSE 'not_automated' END;\n")
rec = sub(rec, "  -- 2.\n  IF NEW.kind = 'interim' THEN",
          "  -- 2.\n  IF NEW.decided_by IS NULL AND (NEW.kind <> 'interim' OR NEW.ground IS DISTINCT FROM 'incompatible'\n"
          "       OR NEW.rule_id IS NULL OR NEW.rule_id NOT IN ('R1', 'R2')\n"
          "       OR NEW.facts_digest IS NOT NULL OR NEW.reason_digest IS NOT NULL OR NEW.legal_reference_digest IS NOT NULL) THEN\n"
          "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An automated decision is taken while deciding, under R1 or R2, with no text.';\n"
          "  END IF;\n"
          "  IF NEW.kind = 'interim' THEN")
rec = sub(rec, "         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind = 'user'), false)\n"
               "    INTO reporters, considers_suspect, considers_illegal, considers_r5, from_notice, from_user\n",
          "         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind = 'user'), false),\n"
          "         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind::text = 'automated'), false),\n"
          "         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind::text = 'automated' AND n.rule_id = 'R2'), false),\n"
          "         coalesce(bool_or(n.kind::text = 'automated' AND n.rule_id = NEW.rule_id), false)\n"
          "    INTO reporters, considers_suspect, considers_illegal, considers_r5, from_notice, from_user,\n"
          "         considers_automated, considers_match, automated_rule\n")
rec = sub(rec, "  IF public.staff_party_conflict(NEW.decided_by,",
          "  IF NEW.decided_by IS NULL AND NOT automated_rule THEN\n"
          "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An automated decision rests on an unanswered automated finding under its rule.';\n"
          "  END IF;\n"
          "  IF NEW.decided_by IS NOT NULL AND public.staff_party_conflict(NEW.decided_by,")
rec = sub(rec, "  IF NEW.needs_admin AND decider_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';\n  END IF;\n",
          "  IF NEW.needs_admin AND decider_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';\n  END IF;\n"
          "  IF NEW.decided_by IS NOT NULL AND NEW.kind IN ('interim', 'final') THEN\n"
          "    NEW.automated_detection := considers_automated;\n"
          "    NEW.automated_decision := CASE WHEN considers_match AND NEW.suspect AND NEW.outcome = 'restricted' THEN 'partially' ELSE 'not_automated' END;\n"
          "  ELSIF NEW.decided_by IS NOT NULL THEN\n"
          "    NEW.automated_detection := reviewed.automated_detection;\n"
          "  END IF;\n")
rec = sub(rec, "  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('korbat.decision_cap:' || NEW.decided_by::text, 0));\n"
               "  SELECT l.decisions_per_hour, l.decisions_per_day INTO per_hour, per_day FROM public.moderation_limits l WHERE l.id = 1;\n",
          "  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('korbat.decision_cap:' || coalesce(NEW.decided_by::text, 'system'), 0));\n"
          "  SELECT l.decisions_per_hour, l.decisions_per_day INTO per_hour, per_day FROM public.moderation_limits l WHERE l.id = 1;\n"
          "  IF NEW.decided_by IS NULL THEN\n"
          "    SELECT r.decisions_per_hour, r.decisions_per_day INTO per_hour, per_day FROM public.automation_rules() r;\n"
          "  END IF;\n")
rec = sub(rec, "    FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.decided_by = NEW.decided_by AND d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 day';\n"
               "  IF in_hour >= coalesce(per_hour, 60) OR in_day >= coalesce(per_day, 300) THEN\n"
               "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_cap';\n",
          "    FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.decided_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.decided_by AND d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 day';\n"
          "  IF in_hour >= coalesce(per_hour, 60) OR in_day >= coalesce(per_day, 300) THEN\n"
          "    IF NEW.decided_by IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'automation_capped'; END IF;\n"
          "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_cap';\n")

# ---- decision_holds (0016)
hold = fn(src16, "decision_holds")
hold = sub(hold, "  in_force integer;\nBEGIN", "  in_force integer;\n  n_signals integer;\n  sig public.automated_signals;\nBEGIN")
hold = sub(hold,
           "  IF a.step_up IS NULL THEN\n"
           "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'stepUp: the audit row carries no confirmation.';\n"
           "  END IF;\n"
           "  IF a.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.decided_by THEN\n"
           "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'actor: the audit row was written by another account than the decision''s.';\n"
           "  END IF;\n",
           "  IF d.decided_by IS NULL THEN\n"
           "    IF a.step_up IS NOT NULL OR a.key_id IS NOT NULL OR a.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM " + SYSTEM + " OR a.action IS DISTINCT FROM 'automated_decided' THEN\n"
           "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'system: an automated decision stands with the system actor''s row automated_decided and no confirmation.';\n"
           "    END IF;\n"
           "    SELECT count(*) INTO n_signals FROM public.automated_signals s WHERE s.decision_id = d.id;\n"
           "    SELECT s.* INTO sig FROM public.automated_signals s WHERE s.decision_id = d.id LIMIT 1;\n"
           "    IF n_signals <> 1 OR a.metadata ->> 'signalId' IS DISTINCT FROM sig.id::text\n"
           "       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.post_media m JOIN public.cases k ON k.id = d.case_id\n"
           "                       WHERE m.id = sig.media_id AND k.target_type = 'post' AND m.post_id = k.target_id) THEN\n"
           "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'signal: an automated decision rests on exactly one signal, about an image of its case''s post, that the audit row names.';\n"
           "    END IF;\n"
           "  ELSE\n"
           "    IF a.step_up IS NULL THEN\n"
           "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'stepUp: the audit row carries no confirmation.';\n"
           "    END IF;\n"
           "    IF a.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.decided_by THEN\n"
           "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'actor: the audit row was written by another account than the decision''s.';\n"
           "    END IF;\n"
           "  END IF;\n")
hold = sub(hold, "    IF a.action IS DISTINCT FROM 'case_decided' OR a.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'case' OR a.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.case_id::text THEN",
           "    IF a.action IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN d.decided_by IS NULL THEN 'automated_decided' ELSE 'case_decided' END)\n"
           "       OR a.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'case' OR a.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.case_id::text THEN")
hold = sub(hold, "  IF d.outcome = 'restricted' AND measures = 0 THEN",
           "  IF d.decided_by IS NULL AND (measures <> 1 OR reversals <> 0 OR NOT EXISTS (\n"
           "       SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x\n"
           "        WHERE x.decision_id = d.id\n"
           "          AND ((sig.kind = 'r1_score' AND d.rule_id = 'R1' AND x.kind = 'withhold_media' AND x.media_id = sig.media_id)\n"
           "            OR (sig.kind = 'known_match' AND d.rule_id = 'R2' AND x.kind = 'seal_media')))) THEN\n"
           "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'measure: an automated decision holds one measure: the scored image withheld, or the matched post''s images sealed.';\n"
           "  END IF;\n"
           "  IF d.outcome = 'restricted' AND measures = 0 THEN")

print("-- GENERATED by make_proto.py. Do not edit.")
print(tables)
print(rec)
print(hold)
```
