### Create `apps/api/test/quarantine/custody-store.ts`

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { MEDIA_SIZES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { main, runQuarantine, storedName, type QuarantineOptions } from "../../src/quarantine";

export const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
export const sha256 = (data: Buffer) => createHash("sha256").update(data).digest("hex");

/** What one run of the mover printed and answered. */
export interface MoverRun {
  code: number;
  /** Standard output: the receipt. */
  lines: string[];
  /** Standard error: what the operator reads. */
  errors: string[];
}

/**
 * The fixture of 3d's section 12, `custodyStore()` (Task 1): two temporary directories laid out as the image store and the
 * quarantine, filled with harmless files that are not images (a few bytes of text under the store's names), and a runner
 * of the mover's program on a list, which passes the two roots as the program's two arguments, as the Compose service's
 * command does. `remove()` deletes both.
 */
export function custodyStore() {
  const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-custody-"));
  const store = path.join(root, "store");
  const quarantine = path.join(root, "quarantine");
  mkdirSync(store, { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(quarantine, { recursive: true });
  const at = (base: string, name: string) => path.join(base, ...name.split("/"));

  /** The bytes a fixture writes for one stored file: text, never an image. */
  const bytesOf = (name: string) => Buffer.from(`not an image: ${name} ${"x".repeat(name.endsWith("large.webp") ? 300 : 40)}`, "utf8");

  return {
    root,
    store,
    quarantine,
    /** Writes both sizes of these images under one root (the store unless said), and answers their names. */
    put(ids: readonly string[], where: "store" | "quarantine" = "store"): string[] {
      const names: string[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) {
          const name = storedName(id, size);
          const file = at(where === "store" ? store : quarantine, name);
          mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
          writeFileSync(file, bytesOf(name));
          names.push(name);
        }
      }
      return names;
    },
    /** Writes other bytes at a name, under one root. */
    write(name: string, where: "store" | "quarantine", data: Buffer): void {
      const file = at(where === "store" ? store : quarantine, name);
      mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
      writeFileSync(file, data);
    },
    bytesOf,
    /** Whether a name is in the store, in the quarantine, in both or in neither. */
    place(name: string): "store" | "quarantine" | "both" | "neither" {
      const s = existsSync(at(store, name));
      const q = existsSync(at(quarantine, name));
      return s && q ? "both" : s ? "store" : q ? "quarantine" : "neither";
    },
    read(name: string, where: "store" | "quarantine"): Buffer {
      return readFileSync(at(where === "store" ? store : quarantine, name));
    },
    /** One list line for each name, in the direction given: "<direction> <id> <file>". */
    list(direction: string, names: readonly string[]): string {
      return names.map((name) => `${direction} ${name.split("/")[2]} ${name}`).join(LF) + LF;
    },
    /**
     * Runs the program as the service does, with the two roots as its arguments and the flags after them, on the list as
     * its standard input; the hooks of QuarantineOptions are for the tests that make a step fail.
     */
    async run(input: string, flags: readonly string[] = [], hooks: Pick<QuarantineOptions, "writeCopy" | "syncDirectory" | "beforeUnlink"> = {}): Promise<MoverRun> {
      const lines: string[] = [];
      const errors: string[] = [];
      const io = { log: (line: string) => lines.push(line), error: (line: string) => errors.push(line), input: async () => input };
      const code = Object.keys(hooks).length === 0 ? await main([store, quarantine, ...flags], io) : await runWithHooks(store, quarantine, input, flags, io, hooks);
      return { code, lines, errors };
    },
    remove: () => rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }),
  };
}

/** The same run below main, so that a test can hand the program a failing step. */
function runWithHooks(
  store: string,
  quarantine: string,
  input: string,
  flags: readonly string[],
  io: { log: (line: string) => void; error: (line: string) => void },
  hooks: Pick<QuarantineOptions, "writeCopy" | "syncDirectory" | "beforeUnlink">,
): Promise<number> {
  return runQuarantine({ store, quarantine, input, lost: flags.includes("--lost"), inventory: flags.includes("--inventory"), log: io.log, error: io.error, ...hooks });
}

export type CustodyStore = ReturnType<typeof custodyStore>;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/quarantine/mover.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { MEDIA_SIZES, QUARANTINE_DIRECTIONS, QUARANTINE_WORDS } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { isStoredName as handoverIsStoredName, storedName as handoverStoredName } from "../../src/handover";
import { storedImageName } from "../../src/media";
import { MOVER_DIRECTIONS, MOVER_WORDS, isStoredName, parseQuarantineArgs, storedName } from "../../src/quarantine";
import { LF, custodyStore, sha256, type CustodyStore } from "./custody-store";

/**
 * The mover of the quarantine (3d design, sections 5 and 7.1; 12.1 row 13), as a unit, against custodyStore(): two
 * temporary directories laid out as the store and the quarantine, with harmless files that are not images. It never loses
 * or invents a file, a crash leaves a file in one place or in both, and one bad line never stops a run.
 */
describe("the quarantine's mover (3d Task 1)", () => {
  const stores: CustodyStore[] = [];
  const made = () => {
    const s = custodyStore();
    stores.push(s);
    return s;
  };
  afterEach(() => {
    for (const s of stores.splice(0)) s.remove();
  });
  const receipt = (direction: string, name: string, data: Buffer, word: string) => `${direction} ${name.split("/")[2]} ${name} ${data.length} ${sha256(data)} ${word}`;

  test("the store's naming rule in its three copies (the media module's, the hand-over's and the mover's) gives the same names, and the mover's words are the contracts'", () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
      const id = randomUUID();
      for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) {
        const name = storedImageName(id, size);
        expect(storedName(id, size)).toBe(name);
        expect(handoverStoredName(id, size)).toBe(name);
        expect(isStoredName(name, id)).toBe(true);
        expect(handoverIsStoredName(name)).toBe(true);
        // A name of another image is outside the layout for this one.
        expect(isStoredName(name, randomUUID())).toBe(false);
      }
    }
    for (const outside of ["files/aa/../../etc/passwd", "/files/ab/x/small.webp", "files/ab/not-an-id/small.webp", `files/zz/${randomUUID()}/small.webp`, `files/${"a".repeat(2)}/${randomUUID()}/medium.webp`]) {
      expect(isStoredName(outside), outside).toBe(false);
    }
    expect([...MOVER_DIRECTIONS]).toEqual([...QUARANTINE_DIRECTIONS]);
    expect(MOVER_WORDS).toEqual({ move: [...QUARANTINE_WORDS.move], destroy: [...QUARANTINE_WORDS.destroy], have: QUARANTINE_WORDS.have });
  });

  test("in, then out: each file is copied, compared, renamed and only then unlinked, and the receipt names its bytes and digest", async () => {
    const s = made();
    const [a, b] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    const names = s.put([a, b]);
    const bytes = new Map(names.map((name) => [name, s.read(name, "store")]));
    const moved = await s.run(s.list("in", names));
    expect([moved.code, moved.errors]).toEqual([0, []]);
    expect(moved.lines).toEqual(names.map((name) => receipt("in", name, bytes.get(name)!, "done")));
    for (const name of names) expect(s.place(name), name).toBe("quarantine");
    // No temporary copy is left behind.
    expect(readdirSync(path.join(s.quarantine, ...names[0]!.split("/").slice(0, -1))).sort()).toEqual(["large.webp", "small.webp"]);

    const back = await s.run(s.list("out", names.slice(0, 2)));
    expect([back.code, back.lines]).toEqual([0, names.slice(0, 2).map((name) => receipt("out", name, bytes.get(name)!, "done"))]);
    for (const name of names.slice(0, 2)) {
      expect(s.place(name)).toBe("store");
      expect(s.read(name, "store")).toEqual(bytes.get(name));
    }
    for (const name of names.slice(2)) expect(s.place(name)).toBe("quarantine");
  });

  test("a crash after the copy and before the unlink leaves the file in both places, and the next run finishes it as already", async () => {
    const s = made();
    const names = s.put([randomUUID()]);
    const data = s.read(names[0]!, "store");
    await expect(
      s.run(s.list("in", names), [], {
        beforeUnlink: async () => {
          throw new Error("the host went down");
        },
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow("the host went down");
    expect(s.place(names[0]!)).toBe("both");
    const again = await s.run(s.list("in", names));
    expect(again.code).toBe(0);
    expect(again.lines).toEqual([receipt("in", names[0]!, data, "already"), receipt("in", names[1]!, s.read(names[1]!, "quarantine"), "done")]);
    for (const name of names) expect(s.place(name)).toBe("quarantine");
  });

  test("a copy whose digest differs is removed and its source kept, a name outside the layout is skipped, and the lines after each are still done, with exit 1 at the end", async () => {
    const s = made();
    const [a, b] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    const [aSmall, aLarge, bSmall, bLarge] = s.put([a, b]);
    const forged = `files/${a.slice(0, 2)}/${a}/../../../../outside.webp`;
    const input = [`in ${a} ${aSmall}`, `in ${a} ${forged}`, `in ${b} ${aLarge}`, `in ${b} ${bSmall}`, "not a line at all", `in ${b} ${bLarge}`].join(LF);
    let writes = 0;
    const run = await s.run(input, [], {
      // The first copy is written with one byte changed, as a failing disk would.
      writeCopy: async (file, data) => {
        writes++;
        await file.writeFile(writes === 1 ? Buffer.concat([data.subarray(1), Buffer.from("!")]) : data);
      },
    });
    expect(run.code).toBe(1);
    expect(run.lines).toEqual([
      `in ${a} ${aSmall} refused`,
      `in ${a} ${forged} refused`,
      // The id the line names must be the file's own.
      `in ${b} ${aLarge} refused`,
      receipt("in", bSmall!, s.read(bSmall!, "quarantine"), "done"),
      receipt("in", bLarge!, s.read(bLarge!, "quarantine"), "done"),
    ]);
    expect(run.errors).toEqual([
      `quarantine: ${aSmall}: the copy's digest differs; the copy is removed and the source kept`,
      `quarantine: skipped: ${forged} is outside the layout`,
      `quarantine: skipped: ${aLarge} is outside the layout`,
      "quarantine: line 5 is not a line of quarantine-list; skipped",
    ]);
    expect(s.place(aSmall!)).toBe("store");
    expect(readdirSync(path.join(s.quarantine, ...aSmall!.split("/").slice(0, -1)))).toEqual([]);
    expect(s.place(aLarge!)).toBe("store");
  });

  test("a file in neither place prints missing and the run goes on; only with --lost does it print lost", async () => {
    const s = made();
    const [gone, here] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    const goneNames = [storedName(gone, "small"), storedName(gone, "large")];
    const names = s.put([here]);
    const input = s.list("in", [goneNames[0]!, ...names]);
    const first = await s.run(input);
    expect(first.code).toBe(1);
    expect(first.lines).toEqual([`in ${gone} ${goneNames[0]} missing`, ...names.map((name) => receipt("in", name, s.read(name, "quarantine"), "done"))]);
    const lost = await s.run(s.list("out", goneNames), ["--lost"]);
    expect([lost.code, lost.lines]).toEqual([0, goneNames.map((name) => `out ${gone} ${name} lost`)]);
  });

  test("destroy takes the digest before the unlink, removes the file in the quarantine and in the store, and prints where it found it", async () => {
    const s = made();
    const [q, st, both, none] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID(), randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    s.put([q], "quarantine");
    s.put([st], "store");
    s.put([both], "store");
    s.put([both], "quarantine");
    const names = [storedName(q, "small"), storedName(st, "small"), storedName(both, "large"), storedName(none, "small")];
    const before = names.slice(0, 3).map((name) => (s.place(name) === "store" ? s.read(name, "store") : s.read(name, "quarantine")));
    const run = await s.run(s.list("destroy", names));
    expect(run.code).toBe(0);
    expect(run.lines).toEqual([
      receipt("destroy", names[0]!, before[0]!, "quarantine"),
      receipt("destroy", names[1]!, before[1]!, "store"),
      receipt("destroy", names[2]!, before[2]!, "both"),
      `destroy ${none} ${names[3]} already`,
    ]);
    for (const name of names) expect(s.place(name), name).toBe("neither");
    // The other size of each image is left alone: a destroy line names one file.
    expect(s.place(storedName(q, "large"))).toBe("quarantine");
  });

  test("an operator line is left alone, and --inventory prints every file the quarantine holds and moves none", async () => {
    const s = made();
    const [a, b] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    const names = s.put([a, b], "quarantine");
    const op = await s.run(s.list("operator", [names[0]!]));
    expect([op.code, op.lines, op.errors]).toEqual([0, [], [`quarantine: ${names[0]} is an operator line; left alone (the README, Restoring)`]]);
    // A file of another kind in the quarantine is reported for the operator and left where it is.
    s.write(`files/${a.slice(0, 2)}/${a}/notes.txt`, "quarantine", Buffer.from("x"));
    const have = await s.run("in whatever the list says", ["--inventory"]);
    expect(have.code).toBe(1);
    expect(have.lines.sort()).toEqual(names.map((name) => `have ${name.split("/")[2]} ${name} ${s.read(name, "quarantine").length} ${sha256(s.read(name, "quarantine"))}`).sort());
    expect(have.errors).toEqual([`quarantine: files/${a.slice(0, 2)}/${a}/notes.txt is outside the layout; left where it is`]);
    for (const name of names) expect(s.place(name)).toBe("quarantine");
  });

  test("the program refuses to start without its two roots, with a root that is no directory, or with any other flag", async () => {
    const s = made();
    expect(parseQuarantineArgs([])).toEqual({ problem: "quarantine: refused: name the image store's root and the quarantine's root, in that order" });
    expect(parseQuarantineArgs([s.store])).toHaveProperty("problem");
    expect(parseQuarantineArgs([s.store, s.quarantine, "--lost", "--inventory"])).toHaveProperty("problem");
    expect(parseQuarantineArgs([s.store, s.quarantine, "--force"])).toHaveProperty("problem");
    expect(parseQuarantineArgs([s.store, s.quarantine, "--lost"])).toEqual({ store: s.store, quarantine: s.quarantine, lost: true, inventory: false });
    const { main } = await import("../../src/quarantine");
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const io = { log: () => undefined, error: (line: string) => errors.push(line), input: async () => "" };
    expect(await main([s.store], io)).toBe(2);
    expect(await main([s.store, path.join(s.root, "not-mounted")], io)).toBe(2);
    expect(errors.at(-1)).toBe(`quarantine: refused: ${path.join(s.root, "not-mounted")} is not a directory`);
  });

  test("the directory's sync is skipped only where the platform refuses it (EPERM); any other error ends the run with every file in one place or in both", async () => {
    const s = made();
    const names = s.put([randomUUID(), randomUUID()]);
    const refused = await s.run(s.list("in", names.slice(0, 2)), [], {
      syncDirectory: async () => {
        throw Object.assign(new Error("operation not permitted"), { code: "EPERM" });
      },
    });
    // The program's own sync takes EPERM as the platform's refusal; a hook stands for the sync itself, so EPERM from it
    // is a failure like any other: only the program's default skips it.
    expect(refused.code).toBe(1);
    expect(refused.errors[0]).toMatch(/the directory could not be synced [(]EPERM[)]; the run stops here/);
    const failing = await s.run(s.list("in", names.slice(2)), [], {
      syncDirectory: async () => {
        throw Object.assign(new Error("i/o error"), { code: "EIO" });
      },
    });
    expect(failing.code).toBe(1);
    expect(failing.lines).toEqual([]);
    expect(failing.errors).toEqual([expect.stringMatching(/the directory could not be synced [(]EIO[)]; the run stops here, and every file is in one place or in both$/)]);
    // The first file was renamed into place before the sync failed, and its source was kept; the second was not touched.
    expect(s.place(names[2]!)).toBe("both");
    expect(s.place(names[3]!)).toBe("store");
    // The program's own sync, on this platform, either syncs or meets EPERM and goes on.
    const plain = await s.run(s.list("in", names));
    expect(plain.code).toBe(0);
    for (const name of names) expect(s.place(name)).toBe("quarantine");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/app/test/image-fault.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { cloneElement, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import type { MediaStatusResponse, MediaView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { IMAGE_LOST_NOTICE } from "@korbat/rules";
import { ImageFaultView, faultAsker, imageFaultOf } from "../src/components/social/ImageFault";
import { MediaGrid } from "../src/components/social/MediaGrid";
import { MediaViewerContent } from "../src/components/social/MediaViewer";
import { IMAGE_FAULT_WORDS } from "../src/lib/moderation-words";

/**
 * An image of the reader's own post being restored or lost (3d design, sections 7.1 and 9.6; Task 1): after a failed
 * load of their own image, and only of their own, the component asks the image's status once and prints [image.restoring]
 * or [image.lost] in its place; anyone else sees what a missing image shows. A static render cannot fail a load, so it
 * shows which images would ask (the mock marks an image given a handler for its failed load), and the asking and the
 * words are tested by themselves.
 */
vi.mock("expo-router", () => ({
  Link: ({ href, children }: { href: string; children: ReactElement }) => cloneElement(children, { href } as object),
  router: { push: () => undefined },
}));
vi.mock("@/lib/session", () => ({ useSession: () => ({ state: { status: "signed-out" }, refresh: async () => ({ status: "signed-out" }) }) }));
vi.mock("expo-image", async () => {
  const { createElement } = await import("react");
  return {
    Image: ({ source, accessibilityLabel, onError }: { source: { uri: string }; accessibilityLabel: string; onError?: () => void }) =>
      createElement("img", { "data-uri": source.uri, alt: accessibilityLabel, "data-asks": onError === undefined ? "no" : "yes" }),
  };
});
vi.mock("react-native-reanimated", () => ({ useReducedMotion: () => false }));

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const textOf = (markup: string): string => markup.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/&#x27;/g, "'").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
const asking = (markup: string): string[] => [...markup.matchAll(/data-asks="([a-z]+)"/g)].map((match) => match[1]!);
const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
const image = (n: number): MediaView => ({ id: id(n), width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "LEHV6nWB2yk8", alt: `picture ${n}`, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp` });
const ready = (extra: Partial<Extract<MediaStatusResponse, { status: "ready" }>> = {}): MediaStatusResponse => ({ id: id(1), status: "ready", width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "LEHV6nWB2yk8", ...extra });

describe("an image of the reader's own post being restored or lost (3d Task 1)", () => {
  test("the status names the fault: restoring, lost, or none for every other answer", () => {
    expect(imageFaultOf(ready({ restoring: true }))).toBe("restoring");
    expect(imageFaultOf(ready({ lost: true }))).toBe("lost");
    expect(imageFaultOf(ready())).toBeNull();
    expect(imageFaultOf({ id: id(1), status: "processing" })).toBeNull();
    expect(imageFaultOf({ id: id(1), status: "failed", error: "processing_failed" })).toBeNull();
  });
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  ALERT_KINDS,
  CaseDecision,
  MediaStatusResponse,
  QUARANTINE_DIRECTIONS,
  QUARANTINE_RULES,
  QUARANTINE_WORDS,
  QuarantineCounts,
  SealCustody,
  StaffOverview,
  renderAlert,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * 3d Task 1, the quarantine (design, sections 6.1, 7.1, 8.1, 10.1 to 10.3 and W.7): the home screen's counts, a seal's
 * custody, the owner's status of an image being restored or lost, the words of the mover's receipt, and the two alerts.
 * Every answer holds counts, times and booleans, never a file's name or digest.
 */
describe("the quarantine's contracts (3d Task 1)", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-18T12:00:00.000Z");

  test("StaffOverview carries the four values of quarantine_counts() and nothing else", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(StaffOverview.shape.quarantine.shape).sort()).toEqual(["dueIn", "dueOut", "oldest", "undestroyed"]);
    expect(QuarantineCounts.parse({ dueIn: 2, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 1, oldest: "2026-10-17T08:00:00.000Z" })).toEqual({ dueIn: 2, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 1, oldest: "2026-10-17T08:00:00.000Z" });
    expect(QuarantineCounts.parse({ dueIn: 0, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 0, oldest: null }).oldest).toBeNull();
    expect(QuarantineCounts.safeParse({ dueIn: -1, dueOut: 0, undestroyed: 0, oldest: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a seal's custody is six counts and one time, and only a decision may carry it", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(SealCustody.shape).sort()).toEqual(["files", "filesLeft", "lost", "moved", "movedAt", "toReturn"]);
    const custody = { files: 4, moved: 2, movedAt: "2026-10-17T08:00:00.000Z", toReturn: 0, filesLeft: 0, lost: 0 };
    expect(SealCustody.parse(custody)).toEqual(custody);
    expect(SealCustody.safeParse({ ...custody, movedAt: "yesterday" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecision.shape.custody.safeParse(undefined).success).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseDecision.shape.custody.safeParse(custody).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the owner's status of a ready image says restoring or lost, never both, and never for another status", () => {
    const ready = { id: "6f0c7c55-4f0e-4b8e-9d55-0c1d0f6c2b10", status: "ready", width: 10, height: 10, blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL" } as const;
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.parse({ ...ready, restoring: true })).toEqual({ ...ready, restoring: true });
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.parse({ ...ready, lost: true })).toEqual({ ...ready, lost: true });
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.safeParse({ ...ready, restoring: true, lost: true }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.safeParse({ ...ready, restoring: false }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.parse({ id: ready.id, status: "processing", restoring: true })).toEqual({ id: ready.id, status: "processing" });
  });

  test("the directions of the list and the words of the receipt are section 10.1's closed lists", () => {
    expect([...QUARANTINE_DIRECTIONS]).toEqual(["in", "out", "destroy", "operator"]);
    expect([...QUARANTINE_WORDS.move]).toEqual(["done", "already", "missing", "lost", "refused"]);
    expect([...QUARANTINE_WORDS.destroy]).toEqual(["quarantine", "store", "both", "already", "refused"]);
    expect(QUARANTINE_WORDS.have).toBe("have");
  });

  test("quarantine_due and quarantine_lost: a push and a sentence to every staff account, as W.7 words them", () => {
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.quarantine_due).toMatchObject({ priority: 3, scope: "all", legs: ["push", "mail"], mail: "sentence", facts: ["count", "oldestAt"] });
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.quarantine_lost).toMatchObject({ priority: 3, scope: "all", legs: ["push", "mail"], mail: "sentence", facts: ["count", "at"] });
    expect(renderAlert("quarantine_due", { count: 3, oldestAt: "2026-10-17T08:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Sealed files are waiting to be moved",
      sentence: `3 images have waited more than ${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours} hours to be moved into the quarantine or back, the oldest since 2026-10-17 08:05 UTC.`,
      todo: "Whoever has the server runs the README's steps under Quarantine. This repeats daily until the move is recorded.",
    });
    expect(QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours).toBe(24);
    expect(renderAlert("quarantine_lost", { count: 2, at: "2026-10-18T11:40:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Sealed files are lost",
      sentence: "2 files that were to be kept apart are recorded as lost at 11:40 UTC: they are in neither the image store nor the quarantine.",
      todo: "Whoever has the server reads the README's section Quarantine, on a file in neither place. An image whose seal was lifted cannot be shown again, and its author is told; a file kept for an authority cannot be handed over, and the operator tells the authority.",
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The console's browser check (3a design, section 12). It builds the console, serves the build with the routes and headers
 * of Caddy's console site read from infra/caddy/Caddyfile, answers /api/staff/* from fixtures whose user-written strings
 * are hostile (markup, javascript: URLs, a direction override, the longest names allowed), and drives Chromium through
 * playwright-core with a CDP virtual authenticator over every screen: the console switched off, enrolment (a synced
 * passkey refused, then a device-bound key that verifies its user, whose success page signs in with that key), home, a
 * session revoked with the key, step-up options that bind another action refused before the key is asked, the audit log,
 * an address the console does not have, the ended session, a second key enrolled while signed in, whose success page
 * asks that key and no other, sign-out, and sign-in options that carry a step-up challenge refused before the key is
 * asked. For moderation cases (3c design, section 8) it walks the home screen's overview, the queue with a finding, a
 * case with its images shown on request, an image the API refuses, a case whose images cannot be opened, an account's
 * case with a fresh snapshot, a reveal, and a save that the API answers with the digest of another text. For deciding
 * (sections 7.5 and 8) it lifts a measure taken while deciding, meets step-up options that bind another decision before
 * the key is asked, confirms a final decision whose texts were saved when their fields lost focus, seals an account's
 * images with the fixed drafts through a session that ended and a sign-in, records a choice not to seal, answers a report
 * of child sexual abuse material without a measure as an admin, meets a case that another staff member decided meanwhile,
 * brings a draft's saved texts back after a reload (one of them answered with other words under its digest, and dropped),
 * and reads the home screen's three lists of the path. Each step fails on any policy report through any channel
 * console-lab.md names, any page error and any dialog. It needs no database and writes nothing but a temporary build.
 *
 * It never downloads a browser. By default it drives the Chromium build playwright-core 1.63.0 names (chromium-1243 under
 * ms-playwright), which must already be installed; KORBAT_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome drives the machine's own Chrome instead,
 * as CI does with the runner's.
 */
const CHANNEL = process.env.KORBAT_BROWSER_CHANNEL || "chromium";

/** 3e: what the two runs of Task 1 type: the facts of a removal that gives a strike, and the reason of a review that overrules one. */
const STRIKE_FACTS = `The post sells followers again ${HOSTILE.img}`;
const OVERRULE_REASON = `The post quotes the offer to report it ${HOSTILE.quote}`;

let out = "";
let site: ConsoleSiteServer | undefined;
let browser: Browser | undefined;
let context: BrowserContext;
let page: Page;
let watcher: Watcher;
let fixtures: FixtureApi;
let origin = "";
/** The device-bound authenticator that holds the first staff key enrolled. */
let staffAuthenticator = "";
/** Every device-bound authenticator the walk enrolled a staff key on. */
const staffAuthenticators: string[] = [];
/** Every person-written string the walk has found shown as text. */
const seen = new Set<string>();
/** The headers each static file was served with, by path. */
const served = new Map<string, Record<string, string>>();

/** The text of every element holding a person-written string or an action, kept in `seen`. */
async function texts(): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await userTexts(page);
  for (const text of found) seen.add(text);
  return found;
}

/** Waits for a locator to show, failing with what it looked for. */
async function shown(locator: Locator, timeout = 15_000): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await locator.first().waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`not shown within ${timeout} ms: ${locator.toString()}`);
  }
}

/** A virtual CTAP2 authenticator that verifies its user: a security key on USB, or a platform one whose passkeys sync. */
async function addAuthenticator(kind: "device-bound security key" | "synced platform passkey"): Promise<string> {
  const synced = kind === "synced platform passkey";
  const { authenticatorId } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator", {
    options: {
      protocol: "ctap2",
      transport: synced ? "internal" : "usb",
      hasResidentKey: true,
      hasUserVerification: true,
      isUserVerified: true,
      automaticPresenceSimulation: true,
      // The flags a password manager's passkey reports, and a security key never does.
      defaultBackupEligibility: synced,
      defaultBackupState: synced,
    },
  });
  return authenticatorId;
}

/** How many times an authenticator's keys have signed: the virtual authenticator counts every signature. */
async function signaturesOf(authenticatorId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { credentials } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.getCredentials", { authenticatorId });
  return credentials.reduce((sum, credential) => sum + credential.signCount, 0);
}

/** How many times every staff key of the walk has signed. */
async function signatures(): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const id of staffAuthenticators) sum += await signaturesOf(id);
  return sum;
}

/**
 * Waits until an expression is true in the page. The expression is plain text, sent as page.evaluate sends it: nothing
 * of the test runner's is put into the page, and nothing in the page evaluates it under the page's policy.
 */
async function until(expression: string, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries++) {
    if (await page.evaluate(expression)) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  }
  throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/**
 * Waits until the fixtures have seen something. A text is saved when its field loses focus, and the request arrives a
 * moment after the key press that moved the focus.
 */
async function arrived(check: () => boolean, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && !check(); tries++) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  if (!check()) throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/** The one image of the page: whether it is there, loaded as a real image of 2 by 2 pixels, from this address, drawn with this class. */
const imageIs = (src: string, className: string) =>
  `(() => { const all = document.querySelectorAll("img"); const i = all[0]; return all.length === 1 && i.getAttribute("src") === ${JSON.stringify(src)} && i.className === ${JSON.stringify(className)} && i.complete && i.naturalWidth === 2 && i.naturalHeight === 2; })()`;

/** The end of every step: no report, error or dialog on any channel, nothing in the page the console never writes, and no request the fixtures refused for the page's fault. */
async function clean(): Promise<void> {
  expect(watcher.take()).toEqual([]);
  expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
  expect(fixtures.state.problems).toEqual([]);
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  out = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-admin-browser-"));
  await buildConsole({ outdir: out });
  fixtures = createFixtureApi();
  site = await startConsoleSite({ dist: out, api: fixtures.handle });
  origin = site.origin;
  fixtures.state.origin = origin;
  browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: CHANNEL, headless: true });
  context = await browser.newContext({ timezoneId: "UTC", locale: "en-GB", viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
  page = await context.newPage();
  page.setDefaultTimeout(15_000);
  watcher = await watch(context, page, origin);
  await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.enable", { enableUI: false });
  page.on("response", (response) => {
    const url = new URL(response.url());
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith("/api/")) served.set(url.pathname, response.headers());
  });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await browser?.close();
  await site?.close();
  if (out) rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

describe("the staff console in Chromium, under the console site's policy", () => {
  test("the page, its script and its stylesheet come with the Caddyfile's console headers, the policy of section 3 among them", async () => {
    fixtures.state.off = true;

    const headersFor = consoleSiteHeadersFromCaddyfile();

    const assets = [...served.keys()].filter((p) => p.startsWith("/assets/"));
    expect(assets.map((p) => path.extname(p)).sort()).toEqual([".css", ".js"]);
    // The page is index.html answered for "/", which names no file; the script and the stylesheet are files of the build.

      const sent = served.get(p)!;
      for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(headersFor(p, p !== "/"))) expect(sent[name.toLowerCase()], `${p} ${name}`).toBe(value);
    }
    expect(served.get("/")!["cache-control"]).toBe("no-store, no-transform");
    for (const p of assets) expect(served.get(p)!["cache-control"]).toBe("public, max-age=31536000, immutable");

    await shown(page.getByText(`Signed in until ${clockTime(new Date(current.createdAt + 12 * 60 * 60_000).toISOString())}.`));
    await shown(page.locator("ul.signins"));
    await shown(page.locator("ul.keys"));
    await shown(page.getByRole("cell", { name: "This session" }));

    expect(await page.locator("table tbody tr").count()).toBe(3);
    expect(await page.locator("ul.keys li").count()).toBe(EXISTING_KEY_NAMES.length + 1);
    const shownTexts = await texts();
    for (const text of [PERSON_HANDLE, CURRENT_BROWSER, ...OTHER_BROWSERS, ...EXISTING_KEY_NAMES, TYPED_KEY_NAME]) expect(shownTexts, text).toContain(text);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a session revoked with the key: the step-up's options check out, the key signs once, and the session goes", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();

    const row = page.locator("table tbody tr").filter({ hasText: OTHER_BROWSERS[0] });

  test("step-up options that bind another action are refused before the key is asked", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const optionsBefore = fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed;

    await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign out that session" }).click();

    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "DELETE").length).toBe(deletes);
    expect(await row.count()).toBe(1);

  test("a decision whose step-up options bind other params is refused before the key is asked; the draft stays, and confirmed again it is recorded without its texts being saved twice", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const sent = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path.endsWith("/decisions")).length;
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome this person may decide on the case; the page opens on a restriction.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.restricted, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    // A restriction needs a measure, its facts and its reason before anything can be confirmed.
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure));
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);

    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);

    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);

    });

    expect(await composer.getByText(`${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.toAuthor, { exact: false }).count()).toBe(0);
    // Nothing was done while deciding on this case, so the answer is told to nobody, and the page says so in the preview's place.
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement));
    expect(await composer.locator(".frame.preview").count()).toBe(0);
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("Nothing in the report or in the post supports it.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason and the facts saved when their fields lost focus");
    const written = (kind: string) => fixtures.state.texts.slice(saved).find((text) => text.kind === kind)!;
    expect(written("facts")).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_ADMIN, text: TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    await clean();

    await confirm.click();
    // The answer reaches the newest report of child sexual abuse material: the rule report that arrived after it stays open.
    await shown(page.getByText(`${COMPOSER.recorded} ${COMPOSER.leftForLater(1)}`));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_ADMIN,
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 3, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [], factsDigest: written("facts").digest, reasonDigest: written("reason").digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The case as the answer gave it: the answer with its facts, for staff, and a composer for the report left open.
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 4", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    const after = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    expect(await after.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(1);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.not_evident, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked);
    expect(await page.locator("img").count()).toBe(0);
    // The steps that follow are a moderator's again: each opens its page anew, and reads who is signed in.
    fixtures.state.role = "moderator";
    await clean();
  });

  test("a case that another staff member decided meanwhile: a save that failed is worded under its field and made again by the confirmation, the refusal is worded in place, the case is read again with the draft kept, and confirmed again the decision is recorded without a text saved twice", async () => {

    // The refusal's words stay, the reason's own refusal is gone now that it is saved, and the draft is as its person left it.

  test("a draft's texts come back after a reload: each was saved when its field lost focus, a refused save is worded under its field with the text kept, a saved text is restored with its digest, one answered with other words under its digest is dropped, and the decision names the text saved before the reload", async () => {
    const [before, options] = [await signatures(), fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed];
    const QUOTING = 'The reporter wrote "this account spams one link everywhere".';
    const REASON = "The post repeats one link, which the rule names.";
    const saves = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}/texts`).map((r) => r.status);
    const mine = () => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_DRAFTS);
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "facts", text: TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS });
    // A text that quotes what someone wrote about the case is refused where it was written, and nothing of it is lost.
    fixtures.state.refuseNextSave = "text_quotes_user";
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(QUOTING);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("text_quotes_user") }));
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(QUOTING);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422]);
    expect(mine()).toHaveLength(1);
    // Written again in the person's own words, the refusal's words go, and the text is saved when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await composer.getByRole("alert").waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: "reason", text: REASON });
    // No key was asked for any of it.
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options);
    await clean();

    // A reload before any confirmation: the case's answer brings the saved texts back. This one answers the reason with
    // other words under the digest of what was saved: the page holds each text to its digest, and drops that one.
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = { caseId: CASE_DRAFTS, kind: "reason" };
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const again = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await shown(again);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);

  test("a review with the key: the appellant's statement as text on the case, Keep, Reverse in part and Reverse, the reason saved as a review reason, the preview the review's statement, the key confirming exactly that review, and the appeal answered", async () => {
    await page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").nth(1).getByRole("link", { name: "Open the case" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    await shown(page.getByText("not answered yet", { exact: false }));
    // What the appellant wrote is text in a frame of its own.
    expect(await texts()).toContain(HOSTILE.img);
    const before = await signatures();
    const decisionsBefore = fixtures.state.decisions.length;
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel }).click();
    const review = page.getByRole("region", { name: COMPOSER.reviewLabel });
    await shown(review);
    const confirm = review.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // "Keep" is chosen and lifts nothing; nothing is confirmed without a reason.
    expect(await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.kept, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await review.getByLabel("Reason of the review").fill(TYPED_REVIEW_REASON);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // A decision with one measure cannot be reversed in part: whatever is ticked, the answer does not stand.
    await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.partly_reversed, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await review.getByLabel(MEASURES.restore.label).check();
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    // "Reverse" lifts everything that is still in force, and says so by its ticked box.
    await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.reversed, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await review.getByLabel(MEASURES.restore.label).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // The preview is the statement its author will receive: the review's lead, and what was typed as its reason.
    const preview = review.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.reviewed("2026-10-01 09:00 UTC", "reversed"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`Why korbat changed it: ${TYPED_REVIEW_REASON}`);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.reviewed));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    const reason = fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)!;
    expect(reason).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_APPEALED, kind: "review_reason", text: TYPED_REVIEW_REASON });
    // What the key confirmed is the review the page showed: of that decision, answering that appeal, with that reversal
    // and the digest of the saved reason. No decision on the case was sent in its place.
    expect(fixtures.state.reviews).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(fixtures.state.reviews[0]).toMatchObject({
      decisionId: DECISION_APPEALED,
      params: { stateVersion: 3, appealId: APPEAL_ONE, outcome: "reversed", rulesVersion: 2, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }], reasonDigest: reason.digest },
    });
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(decisionsBefore);
    // The case as the answer gave it: the next version, the removal lifted, the appeal answered, and nothing left to review.
    await shown(page.getByText("version 4", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByText("answered: reversed", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByText(`${MEASURES.remove.label}: lifted by the decision of`, { exact: false }));
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_REVIEW_REASON);
    // The appeals screen no longer lists it.
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Appeals" }).click();
    await shown(page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").first());
    expect(await page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").count()).toBe(1);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a post decision signs the strike the case answer says is due: the author's standing in bands above the evidence, the strike line under Restrict, the preview's strike, and the key confirming the removal with its strike", async () => {

    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_STRIKE).length === 2, "both texts saved when their fields lost focus");
    // The preview tells the strike as its author will read it: the third active strike, the band's two and this one.

      params: { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }], unfounded: [], replaced: false },
    });

    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

  test("3f: at 360 by 740 px, home shows the block Authorities above the lanes: [home.contact] with its link to Contact point, and [home.channel]", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });

    const since = new Date(Date.now() - 6 * 60_000).toISOString();
    fixtures.state.authorities = {
      contact: { open: 2, oldestAt: oldest, dueAt: new Date(Date.parse(oldest) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000).toISOString() },
      alerts: { channel: "down", since },
    };
    await page.goto(`${origin}/`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Authorities" }));
    const words = ORDER_WORDS.home.contact(bothTimes(oldest), 2);
    const lines = page.locator(".authorities p");

    expect(await lines.nth(0).textContent()).toBe(`${words.before}${words.link}${words.after}`);
    // Task 2: the nearest deadline, the message's, with its minutes left, a link to Orders.
    const due = new Date(Date.parse(oldest) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000).toISOString();
    expect((await lines.nth(1).textContent())!.startsWith(`The nearest deadline is ${bothTimes(due)}: `)).toBe(true);
    expect(await lines.nth(2).textContent()).toBe(ORDER_WORDS.home.channel(bothTimes(since)));
    expect(await page.locator(".authorities a").nth(0).getAttribute("href")).toBe("/contact");
    expect(await page.locator(".authorities a").nth(1).getAttribute("href")).toBe("/orders");
    // The block stands above the lanes.
    const authorities = await page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Authorities" }).boundingBox();
    const cases = await page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Cases" }).boundingBox();
    expect(authorities!.y).toBeLessThan(cases!.y);
    // Every read the home screen started has finished: the whole screen is measured.
    await shown(page.locator("ul.signins"));
    await shown(page.locator("ul.keys"));
    await shown(page.getByText("This session", { exact: true }));
    await texts();
    await cleanOnPhone();
  });

  test("3f Task 6: at 360 by 740 px, Download since my last copy asks the key, records the copy only once the whole file has arrived, and a download cut short records nothing", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });
    const head = Math.max(...fixtures.state.audit.map((row) => row.seq));
    try {
      await page.goto(`${origin}/audit`);
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.downloadFirst(AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX), { exact: true }));
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.key, { exact: true }));
      const before = await signatures();
      const button = page.getByRole("button", { name: RECOVERY_WORDS.downloadButton });
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.done(1, head, head), { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
      expect(fixtures.state.exports.at(-1)).toEqual({ after: 0, through: head });
      expect(fixtures.state.marks).toEqual([{ through: head, hash: fixtures.state.audit.find((row) => row.seq === head)!.hash }]);
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.download(head, AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX), { exact: true }));
      // Nothing newer: no key is asked.
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.none(head), { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
      // Ten more rows, and a body that breaks off after three of them: the key confirmed it, nothing is marked.
      const newer = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({ ...fixtures.state.audit[0]!, seq: head + 10 - i, hash: (head + 10 - i).toString(16).padStart(64, "a"), actionHash: null, keyId: null, action: "staff_sign_in" }));
      fixtures.state.audit.unshift(...newer);
      fixtures.state.exportCut = 3;
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.broken, { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 2);
      expect(fixtures.state.exports.at(-1)).toEqual({ after: head, through: head + 10 });
      expect(fixtures.state.marks).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(fixtures.state.copyPlace).toBe(head);
      // Pressed again, the download starts at the same place and is recorded.
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.done(head + 1, head + 10, 10), { exact: true }));
      expect(fixtures.state.marks.at(-1)!.through).toBe(head + 10);
      await texts();
      await cleanOnPhone();
    } finally {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 900 });
    }
  });

      id: gapId(i + 1),
      class: cls,
      actedAt: at,
      action: cls === "order_effect" ? "order_effected" : cls === "record" ? "production_recorded" : "case_decided",
      caseId: cls === "order_effect" || cls === "record" ? null : CASE_POST,
      orderId: cls === "order_effect" ? order.id : null,
      itemId: cls === "order_effect" ? order.items[0]!.id : null,
      kinds: cls === "order_effect" ? ["disable_by_order"] : cls === "seal_final" || cls === "seal_interim" ? ["seal_media"] : cls === "standing" ? ["suspend"] : cls === "restriction" ? ["remove"] : cls === "reversal" ? ["restore"] : [],
      closedAt: null,
      disposition: null,
      closedByDecisionId: null,
    }));
    fixtures.state.restore = { importedAt: at, mayOpen: false, retentionMay: false, gaps, holds: [{ orderId: order.id, holdUntil: order.hold?.until ?? null }] };
    fixtures.state.restoreOverview = { open: gaps.length, measures: 5, importedAt: at };
    fixtures.state.copy = { newestAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 86_400_000 - 60_000).toISOString(), overdue: true };
    fixtures.state.role = "admin";
    try {
      await page.goto(`${origin}/`);
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.homeCopy(3), { exact: true }));
      const home = page.getByRole("link", { name: RECOVERY_WORDS.homeRestore(gaps.length, 5) });

      await shown(page.getByRole("link", { name: "After a restore", exact: true }));
      await texts();

      await home.click();
```

```ts
 * header on every write, the WebAuthn ceremonies' client data (type, challenge, origin) and the authenticator's flags

 * page's own fault is listed in `problems`. Signatures are not verified: the API's own tests do that with its library.
 *
 * A decision (3c design, section 7.5) is checked as far as the page's own part goes: the assertion was made over a
 * challenge bound to exactly the params the request carries, the snapshot it names is the case's newest with the digest
 * of what the page was shown, recomputed here, and each text it names is one the page saved on that case. The case is
 * then changed as the decision says, and answered as it now stands.
 *
 * A review (section 7.7) is checked the same way: the assertion was made over a challenge bound to exactly this review of
 * exactly this decision, its appeal is the decision's pending one, its snapshot the case's newest as shown, and its

 * reload brings them back. A step of the walk can have the next save refused, a case decided by another staff member

const AUDIT_ROWS = 160;
/** 3f Task 6: the staff key whose step-ups the audit log's revocations carry, which "This key" takes from a row. */
export const FIXTURE_KEY_ID = "4d5e6f70-8192-4a3b-9c4d-5e6f708192a3";
/** 3f Task 6: the body of "Not needed": its params and the key's assertion. */
const GapCloseBody = GapClosedParams.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON });
/** 3f Task 6: no import ever ran, unless a step sets one. */
export const NO_RESTORE: RestoreView = { importedAt: null, mayOpen: true, retentionMay: true, gaps: [], holds: [] };
/** 3f Task 6: the actor every line of the download names: the fixtures keep a handle per row, not an account. */
const LINE_ACTOR = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa";

/** The authenticator data's flags (WebAuthn L3, section 6.1). */
const FLAG_UV = 0x04;
const FLAG_BE = 0x08;
const FLAG_BS = 0x10;

const iso = (ms: number) => new Date(ms).toISOString();
const hex64 = () => randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
const b64url = (bytes: number) => randomBytes(bytes).toString("base64url");

interface KeyRecord extends StaffKey {
  /** The credential the browser made; null for the keys the person held before the walk, which no authenticator holds. */
  credentialId: string | null;
}

interface SessionRecord {
  handle: string;
  token: string;
  csrf: string;
  browser: string;
  createdAt: number;
  lastUsedAt: number;
  /** The credential of the key that opened it; null for the fixtures' other sessions. */
  credentialId: string | null;
}

export interface RequestRecord {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  status: number;
  activity: boolean;
}

/**
 * The audit log: places 1 to 160, one row every 97 minutes up to now, so the newest page, Load older and Go to place each
 * have rows to show, and the home screen's sign-ins reach back past 7 days. Actions, targets and actors take hostile
 * values in turn.
 */
function auditLog(now: number): AuditEntry[] {
  const rows: AuditEntry[] = [];
  for (let seq = AUDIT_ROWS; seq >= 1; seq--) {
    const kind = seq % 4 === 0 ? "revoked" : seq % 9 === 0 ? "hostile" : "signin";
    rows.push({
      seq,
      hash: hex64(),
      createdAt: iso(now - (AUDIT_ROWS - seq) * ROW_SPACING_MS),
      actorHandle: ACTOR_HANDLES[seq % ACTOR_HANDLES.length] ?? null,
      action: kind === "revoked" ? "staff_session_revoked" : kind === "hostile" ? HOSTILE.script : "staff_sign_in",
      targetType: kind === "revoked" ? "staff_session" : kind === "hostile" ? HOSTILE.quote : null,
      targetId: kind === "revoked" ? randomUUID() : kind === "hostile" ? HOSTILE.url : null,
      actionHash: kind === "revoked" ? hex64() : null,
      // 3f Task 6: the key a step-up confirmed a row with; a revocation is one, by the walk's own key.
      keyId: kind === "revoked" ? FIXTURE_KEY_ID : null,
    });
  }
  return rows;
}

/** The authenticator data inside a CBOR attestation object: the byte string under the text key "authData". */
function authDataOf(attestationObject: Buffer): Buffer | null {
  // A CBOR text string of 8 bytes (0x68) spelling authData, then the byte string (major type 2) it maps to.
  const key = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0x68]), Buffer.from("authData")]);
  const at = attestationObject.indexOf(key);
  if (at === -1) return null;
  let i = at + key.length;
  const head = attestationObject[i];
  if (head === undefined || head >> 5 !== 2) return null;
  let length = head & 0x1f;
  i += 1;
  // The length is in the head itself, or in the 1, 2 or 4 bytes after it.
  if (length === 24) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt8(i);
    i += 1;
  } else if (length === 25) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt16BE(i);
    i += 2;
  } else if (length === 26) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt32BE(i);
    i += 4;
  } else if (length > 23) {
    return null;
  }
  return attestationObject.subarray(i, i + length);
}

/** The flags byte of authenticator data, which follows the 32-byte hash of the relying party ID. */
const flagsOf = (authData: Buffer | null): number | null => (authData && authData.length > 32 ? authData[32]! : null);

/** The staff refusal for an authenticator's flags, or null: user verified, and neither backup-eligible nor backed up. */
function flagRefusal(flags: number | null): "staff_key_refused" | "staff_key_not_user_verified" | "staff_key_not_device_bound" | null {
  if (flags === null) return "staff_key_refused";
  if ((flags & FLAG_UV) === 0) return "staff_key_not_user_verified";
  if ((flags & (FLAG_BE | FLAG_BS)) !== 0) return "staff_key_not_device_bound";
  return null;
}

function cookies(req: IncomingMessage): Map<string, string> {
  const jar = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const part of (req.headers.cookie ?? "").split(";")) {
    const at = part.indexOf("=");
    if (at > 0) jar.set(part.slice(0, at).trim(), part.slice(at + 1).trim());
  }
  return jar;
}

/** The staff cookies as the API sets them: __Host- names, Secure, Path=/, SameSite=Strict, 12 hours, the session's HttpOnly. */
const COOKIE = "Path=/; Secure; SameSite=Strict";
const SESSION_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff";
const CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";
const CLEAR_COOKIES = [`${SESSION_COOKIE}=; ${COOKIE}; HttpOnly; Max-Age=0`, `${CSRF_COOKIE}=; ${COOKIE}; Max-Age=0`];

/**
 * The status the API answers each staff refusal with (apps/api/src/auth/staff/), so the console meets here what it meets
 * behind Caddy; a unit test (fixture-statuses.test.ts) checks it against the API's own source.
 */
export const REFUSAL_STATUS = {
  staff_enrollment_invalid: 400,
  staff_key_refused: 400,
  staff_key_invalid: 401,
  staff_session_required: 401,
  staff_key_not_user_verified: 403,
  staff_key_not_device_bound: 403,
  staff_key_suspended: 403,
  staff_step_up_required: 403,
  staff_step_up_invalid: 403,
  staff_key_limit: 409,
} as const satisfies Record<StaffErrorCode, number>;

class Refusal extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly code: string,
    readonly headers: Record<string, string | string[]> = {},
  ) {
    super(code);
  }
}

/** A staff refusal with the API's own status for its code. */
const refuse = (code: StaffErrorCode, headers: Record<string, string | string[]> = {}) => new Refusal(REFUSAL_STATUS[code], code, headers);

/**
 * A challenge in the other ceremonies' 58-byte layout (the contracts' CEREMONY_CHALLENGE), with the purpose's code, a
 * fresh nonce, `binding` (zeros for a sign-in, bound to nothing) and a random seal, since only this server reads it back.
 */
function ceremonyChallenge(purpose: "staff_signin" | "staff_register", binding: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(CEREMONY_CHALLENGE.bindingBytes)): string {
  const c = CEREMONY_CHALLENGE;
  const bytes = randomBytes(c.bytes);
  bytes[c.versionAt] = c.version;
  bytes[c.purposeAt] = CHALLENGE_PURPOSES[purpose];
  bytes.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000), c.expiryAt);
  binding.copy(bytes, c.bindingAt);
  return bytes.toString("base64url");
}

/**
 * The status the API answers each moderation refusal the fixtures use with (apps/api/src/moderation/context.ts); the
 * unit test that holds the staff statuses to the API's source holds these too.
 */
export const MODERATION_REFUSAL_STATUS = { text_not_found: 409, text_invalid: 422, text_quotes_user: 422, rate_limited: 429, image_refused: 404, staff_recused: 403, case_changed: 409, snapshot_mismatch: 409, reviewer_conflict: 403, strike_mismatch: 409 } as const;

/** The kinds of text a decision or a correction names: the ones a case's answer hands back as drafts while no decision has named them. */
const DRAFT_KINDS: readonly string[] = ["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason"];

/** What an item reads once a decision answered it. */
const ITEM_OUTCOMES = { restricted: { incompatible: "restricted_rule", illegal: "restricted_legal" }, no_violation: "no_violation", not_evident: "not_evident" } as const;

/**
 * 3e (design, sections 7.4 and 7.11): what the database holds a decision's strike and its overruling to, as a problem's
 * words or null. A final restriction under a korbat rule other than R2 that answers no suspect item gives a strike
 * exactly when the case's answer said one is due; a correction or a review overrules the strike of the decision it
 * reverses exactly when it reverses that decision whole, and never signs a strike.
 */
function strikeProblem(view: CaseView, kind: string, outcome: string, ground: string | null, ruleId: string | null, actions: readonly { kind: string }[], reviewed: CaseDecision | undefined): string | null {
  const strikes = actions.some((action) => action.kind === "strike");
  const overrules = actions.some((action) => action.kind === "overrule");
  if (kind === "correction" || kind === "review") {
    if (strikes) return "a strike signed with a reversal";
    const standing = reviewed?.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "strike" && action.inForce) ?? false;
    return overrules !== (standing && outcome === "reversed") ? "an overruling that the reversal does not bear out" : null;
  }
  if (overrules) return "an overruling signed with a decision that reverses nothing";
  const suspect = view.items.some((item) => item.outcome === null && item.suspect);
  const due = kind === "final" && outcome === "restricted" && ground === "incompatible" && ruleId !== "R2" && !suspect && (view.strikeDue?.due ?? false);
  return strikes !== due ? "a strike the case's answer did not say is due, or none where it said one is" : null;
}

/** The author's band of active strikes once a decision gave one more. */
const NEXT_BAND = { "0": "1", "1": "2", "2": "3_or_more", "3_or_more": "3_or_more" } as const;

/**
 * The case as a confirmed decision leaves it, changed in place: the decision with its measures in the case's list and
 * history, the next version, a lifted measure no longer in force, a seal with what the case reaches, and after a final
 * decision the items it answered, the measures taken while deciding ended, and the case closed when nothing is left open.
 */
function applyDecision(view: CaseView, params: CaseDecidedParams, written: { facts: string | null; reason: string | null; legalReference: string | null }, staffHandle: string): void {
  const at = new Date().toISOString();
  const id = randomUUID();
  const corrected = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === params.reviewsDecisionId);
  const actions: CaseDecision["actions"] = params.actions.map((action) => {
    const lifts: readonly string[] | null = MEASURES[action.kind].lifts;
    if (lifts !== null) {
      const lifted = corrected?.actions.find((held) => held.inForce && lifts.includes(held.kind) && held.mediaId === action.mediaId);
      if (lifted) {
        lifted.inForce = false;
        lifted.liftedBy = id;
        // 3e Task 4: a lift answers the measure's reply, and one before the start leaves a measure that never ran.
        if (lifted.reply && lifted.reply.answeredAt === null) lifted.reply = { ...lifted.reply, answeredAt: at, answeredBy: id };
        if (lifted.period && lifted.period.startsAt === null) lifted.period = { ...lifted.period, state: "never" };
        if (view.standing) view.standing = { ...view.standing, live: false };
      }
      const ground = "orderGround" in action && action.orderGround !== undefined ? { orderGround: action.orderGround } : {};
      return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect: null, inForce: false, reversesActionId: lifted?.id ?? null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null, ...NO_STANDING, ...ground };
    }
    // 3e Task 4: a suspension or a termination carries its days and whether it was announced; an announced one has no
    // start until its mail's outcome is known, and the account's measure is live from the decision on.
    if (action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate") {
      if (view.standing) view.standing = { ...view.standing, live: true };
      const period = action.announced ? { startsAt: null, endsAt: null, state: "unfixed" as const } : { startsAt: at, endsAt: action.days ? new Date(Date.parse(at) + action.days * 86_400_000).toISOString() : null, state: "running" as const };
      return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null, ...NO_STANDING, days: action.days ?? null, announced: action.announced ?? null, period };
    }
    const reach = view.suspicion?.reach ?? { posts: 0, images: 0 };
    const sealed = action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: reach.posts, images: reach.images, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] } : null;
    // 3e: a strike counts STANDING_RULES.strikeDays from its decision, and nothing rests on it yet.
    const strike = action.kind === "strike" ? { countsUntil: new Date(Date.parse(at) + STANDING_RULES.strikeDays * 86_400_000).toISOString(), restedOnBy: [] } : {};
    return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed, ...NO_STANDING, ...strike };
  });
  // 3e Task 4: a kept correction answers the corrected decision's reply; one filed before the start then fixes the start
  // at the later of now and the earliest start.
  if (params.kind === "correction" && params.outcome === "kept" && corrected) {
    for (const held of corrected.actions) {
      if (!held.reply || held.reply.answeredAt !== null) continue;
      held.reply = { ...held.reply, answeredAt: at, answeredBy: id };
      if (held.reply.onTime && held.period) {
        const start = new Date(Math.max(Date.parse(held.earliestStart ?? at), Date.parse(at))).toISOString();
        held.period = { startsAt: start, endsAt: held.days ? new Date(Date.parse(start) + held.days * 86_400_000).toISOString() : null, state: "announced" };
      }
    }
  }
  // 3e Task 5: a kept correction of a "No breach" decision withdraws all of its marks together.
  if (params.kind === "correction" && params.outcome === "kept" && corrected && corrected.outcome === "no_violation") {
    view.items = view.items.map((item) => (item.answeredBy === corrected.id && item.unfounded ? { ...item, unfounded: false, markWithdrawn: true } : item));
  }
  const suspect = view.items.some((item) => item.outcome === null && item.suspect);
  view.decisions = [
    ...view.decisions,
    {
      id,
      kind: params.kind,
      outcome: params.outcome,
      ground: params.ground,
      ruleId: params.ruleId,
      rulesVersion: params.rulesVersion,
      redressVersion: params.redressVersion,
      category: params.category,
      categoryKeyword: params.categoryKeyword,
      source: "report",
      decidedAt: at,
      staffHandle,
      throughSeq: params.throughSeq,
      answersFromSeq: params.kind === "final" ? view.answeredSeq + 1 : null,
      reviewsDecisionId: params.reviewsDecisionId,
      snapshotId: params.snapshotId,
      suspect,
      unseen: false,
      needsAdmin: false,
      endedInterim: false,
      facts: written.facts,
      reason: written.reason,
      legalReference: written.legalReference,
      actions,
    },
  ];
  view.history = [...view.history, { at, event: "decision", refId: id, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: params.kind, outcome: params.outcome, staffHandle, result: null }];
  view.stateVersion += 1;
  // 3e: the post now carries a strike that stands, and its author has one more.
  if (actions.some((action) => action.kind === "strike")) {
    view.strikeDue = { due: false, why: "already_struck" };
    if (view.authorStanding) view.authorStanding = { ...view.authorStanding, activeStrikes: NEXT_BAND[view.authorStanding.activeStrikes] };
  }
  if (actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media") && view.suspicion) view.suspicion = { ...view.suspicion, reach: { ...view.suspicion.reach, sealed: view.suspicion.reach.images, served: 0 } };
  if (params.kind !== "final" || (params.outcome !== "restricted" && params.outcome !== "no_violation" && params.outcome !== "not_evident")) return;
  const outcome = params.outcome === "restricted" ? ITEM_OUTCOMES.restricted[params.ground ?? "incompatible"] : ITEM_OUTCOMES[params.outcome];
  // 3e Task 5: the items it answers, each marked when the key signed its mark.
  view.items = view.items.map((item) => (item.outcome === null && item.seq <= params.throughSeq ? { ...item, outcome, answeredBy: id, unfounded: params.unfounded.includes(item.id) } : item));
  view.answeredSeq = params.throughSeq;
  if (view.items.some((item) => item.outcome === null)) return;
  // The case is closed: what was done while deciding has ended, and the post reads as the decision's measure left it.
  view.closedAt = at;
  for (const decided of view.decisions) if (decided.kind === "interim") for (const action of decided.actions) if (MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null) action.inForce = false;
  if (view.target.type === "post" && actions.some((action) => action.kind === "remove")) view.target = { ...view.target, state: "removed", level: "removed" };
}

/**
 * The case as a confirmed review leaves it, changed in place: the review with its reversals in the case's list and
 * history, the measures it lifts no longer in force, the appeal answered, the next version, and a post whose removal was
 * lifted shown again.
 */
function applyReview(view: CaseView, reviewed: CaseDecision, params: AppealsReviewedParams, reason: string, staffHandle: string): void {
  const at = new Date().toISOString();
  const id = randomUUID();
  const actions: CaseDecision["actions"] = params.actions.map((action) => {
    const lifts: readonly string[] = MEASURES[action.kind].lifts ?? [];
    const lifted = reviewed.actions.find((held) => held.inForce && lifts.includes(held.kind) && held.mediaId === action.mediaId);
    if (lifted) {
      lifted.inForce = false;
      lifted.liftedBy = id;
    }
    return { id: randomUUID(), kind: action.kind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect: null, inForce: false, reversesActionId: lifted?.id ?? null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null, ...NO_STANDING };
  });
  view.decisions = [
    ...view.decisions,
    {
      id,
      kind: "review",
      outcome: params.outcome,
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      rulesVersion: params.rulesVersion,
      redressVersion: params.redressVersion,
      category: params.category,
      categoryKeyword: null,
      source: reviewed.source,
      decidedAt: at,
      staffHandle,
      throughSeq: 0,
      answersFromSeq: null,
      reviewsDecisionId: reviewed.id,
      snapshotId: params.snapshotId,
      suspect: reviewed.suspect,
      unseen: false,
      needsAdmin: false,
      endedInterim: false,
      facts: null,
      reason,
      legalReference: null,
      actions,
    },
  ];
  view.appeals = view.appeals.map((appeal) => (appeal.id === params.appealId ? { ...appeal, answeredAt: at, result: params.outcome, answeredBy: id, reviewer: null, mayReview: false } : appeal));
  view.history = [
    ...view.history,
    { at, event: "decision", refId: id, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: "review", outcome: params.outcome, staffHandle, result: null },
    { at, event: "appeal_answered", refId: params.appealId, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: null, outcome: null, staffHandle: null, result: params.outcome },
  ];
  view.stateVersion += 1;
  if (view.target.type === "post" && actions.some((action) => action.kind === "restore")) view.target = { ...view.target, state: "visible", level: "visible" };
}

/** `raw` answers bytes of this type in place of JSON: an image. */
type Answer = { status: number; body?: unknown; raw?: { type: string; bytes: Buffer }; headers?: Record<string, string | string[]> };

export type FixtureApi = ReturnType<typeof createFixtureApi>;

/** 3f: a message at the contact point as the API lists it, nobody's yet. */
function contactMessage(id: string, receivedMs: number, folder: "inbox" | "junk", stale: boolean): ContactMessage {
  return { id, folder, receivedAt: iso(receivedMs), seenAt: iso(stale ? receivedMs + 5 * HOUR : receivedMs + 20_000), stale, disposition: null, handledAt: null, handledBy: null, orders: [] };
}

/** 3f: three stale messages an outage left, which the walk closes together. */
export function staleMessages(now: number): ContactMessage[] {
  return ["8f3c4d5e-6f70-4182-9394-a5b627c8d9e0", "904d5e6f-7081-4293-a4a5-b6c738d9e0f1", "a15e6f70-8192-43a4-b5b6-c7d849e0f102"].map((id, i) => contactMessage(id, now - (30 + i) * HOUR, "inbox", true));
}

/** 3f, Task 2: what a link of an order names, as the API's resolver tells them apart: a post, an account, or nothing korbat serves. */
function linkKindOf(link: string): OrderItemView["linkKind"] {
  if (/^https:[/][/]korbat[.]example[/]p[/][0-9a-z-]+$/.test(link)) return "post";
  if (/^https:[/][/]korbat[.]example[/]@[0-9a-z_]+$/.test(link)) return "account";
  return "other";
}

/** 3f: an item as the API answers it once its link is recorded: a post's author and preview are outsiders' words, nothing is done yet. */
function orderItem(link: string, position: number, addedAt: string): OrderItemView {
  const linkKind = linkKindOf(link);
  return {
    id: randomUUID(),
    position,
    link,
    linkKind,
    addedAt,
    unverified: true,
    postId: linkKind === "post" ? randomUUID() : null,
    post: linkKind === "post" ? { authorHandle: HOSTILE.img, state: "visible", images: 1, preview: HOSTILE.quote, createdAt: addedAt, deletedOn: null } : null,
    decisionId: null,
    caseId: null,
    inForce: false,
    disabledAt: null,
    noEffect: null,
    preserveUntil: null,
    preserveEndedAt: null,
    erasedAt: null,
    reinstatedAt: null,
    reinstatedGround: null,
    closedAt: null,
    closedReason: null,
    gap: false,
  };
}

/** 3f: a removal order's clock from its start: the hour, and the target five minutes before it; no deadline without a start. */
function runningClock(start: string | null, itemsOpen: number): NonNullable<OrderView["clock"]> {
  const deadline = start === null ? null : iso(Date.parse(start) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000);
  return { clockStart: start, stopped: false, stoppedAt: null, stopGround: null, deadlineAt: deadline, targetAt: deadline === null ? null : iso(Date.parse(deadline) - 5 * 60_000), itemsOpen, firstEffectAt: null, lastEffectAt: null, withinHour: null };
}

/** The six months and a day of a removal order's preservation, from a disabling (ORDER_RULES), as the database counts them. */
function preservedUntil(at: string): string {
  const until = new Date(at);
  until.setUTCMonth(until.getUTCMonth() + ORDER_RULES.preserveMonths);
  until.setUTCDate(until.getUTCDate() + ORDER_RULES.preserveMarginDays);
  return until.toISOString();
}

/**
 * 3f, Task 3: an order a step of the walk puts in place, as the API answers it once its links are recorded: of its kind,
 * with `posts` links that each name a post, told or held (Section C, with the hold's end), checked or not, and received
 * a few minutes ago, so that its hour runs.
 */
export function orderFixture(options: { reference: string; posts: number; kind?: "tco_removal" | "dsa_art9"; sectionC?: boolean; verified?: boolean; holdUntil?: string | null }): OrderView {
  const now = Date.now();
  const at = iso(now - 5 * 60_000);
  const kind = options.kind ?? "tco_removal";
  const tco = kind === "tco_removal";
  const sectionC = options.sectionC ?? false;
```
