    });

    test("an unconfirmed address gets one receipt in 24 hours: the next is folded, whichever contact names the address, and the one after the day is sent", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const first = await contact(h);
      const second = await contact(h, { email: first.email!.toUpperCase() });
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, second.id, receipt())).toBe("folded");
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt())).toBe("folded");
      // Another address has a day of its own.
      const other = await contact(h);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, other.id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      h.clock.advance(DAY - 1000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, second.id, receipt())).toBe("folded");
      h.clock.advance(2000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, second.id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(h.mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === first.email)).toHaveLength(2);
    });

    test("a confirmed address has no cap for the 30 days of its confirmation; a stopped one gets nothing until a confirmation lifts the stop", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const { id, email } = await contact(h);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      const token = tokenSentTo(h, email!);
      expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(true);
      for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      // The confirmation runs out after 30 days: the cap is back.
      h.clock.advance(30 * DAY + 1000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("folded");

      expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(true);
      h.clock.advance(2 * DAY);
      const sentBefore = h.mailer.sent.length;
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("suppressed");
      // Another contact of the same address is stopped with it.
      const again = await contact(h, { email });
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, again.id, receipt())).toBe("suppressed");
      expect(h.mailer.sent).toHaveLength(sentBefore);
      expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
    });

    test("refused when the relay says the address is bad; any other failure is thrown, leaves the day's one receipt unspent, and the retry carries the same page link", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const { id, email } = await contact(h);
      const failing = withMailer(h, async () => {
        throw new MailUnavailable("relay down");
      });
      await expect(mailNotifier(failing, id, receipt())).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(MailUnavailable);
      await expect(mailNotifier(failing, id, receipt())).rejects.not.toBeInstanceOf(MailRefused);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      const link = h.mailer.sent[0]!.data.pageUrl;
      h.clock.advance(DAY + 1000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(h.mailer.sent[1]!.data.pageUrl).toBe(link);

      const bad = await contact(h);
      const refusing = withMailer(h, async () => {
        throw new MailRefused("no such mailbox");
      });
      expect(await mailNotifier(refusing, bad.id, receipt())).toBe("refused");
      expect(h.mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === bad.email)).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(email).not.toBe(bad.email);
    });
  });

    test("no_address for a deleted account and for one that never was; refused and unavailable as for a notifier", async () => {

      expect(h.mailer.sent).toHaveLength(0);
      const { id } = await account(h);

  describe("the statement and the daily update, to an account", () => {

      // The address asked korbat to stop its report mails: a statement of reasons is no report mail.

      expect(h.mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.template === "moderation_decision")).toHaveLength(2);
      // A purged account has no address; a refusing relay and a failing one are told apart as for every mail.

      const refusing = withMailer(h, async () => {

      expect(await mailAccount(h.deps, id, { template: "notice_update", lines })).toBe("sent");
      expect(h.mailer.updates).toEqual([{ to: email, template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines, receipts: [], pages: [] } }]);
      const signedOut = await contact(h, { email });

  describe("mailNotifierUpdates: one update for each address", () => {
    const app = "http://localhost:8081";
    const pageOf = (h: FlowHarness, to: string, ref: string) => h.mailer.updates.findLast((m) => m.to === to)!.data.pages.find((page) => page.ref === ref)?.pageUrl;

    test("two notices that gave one address make one update: every line, and the page of each notice with that contact's own mail token; another address gets its own", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const first = await contact(h);
      const second = await contact(h, { email: first.email });
      const other = await contact(h);
      // The receipts' links carry each contact's mail token: the update's pages must be the same links.
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt("N-AAAAAAAA22"))).toBe("sent");
      const firstLink = h.mailer.sent.at(-1)!.data.pageUrl;
      h.clock.advance(DAY + 1000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, second.id, receipt("N-BBBBBBBB33"))).toBe("sent");
      const secondLink = h.mailer.sent.at(-1)!.data.pageUrl;
      expect(firstLink).not.toBe(secondLink);
      const results = await mailNotifierUpdates(h.deps, [
        { contactId: first.id, ref: "N-AAAAAAAA22", lines: [line("N-AAAAAAAA22", 1), line("N-AAAAAAAA22", 2)] },
        { contactId: second.id, ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", lines: [line("N-BBBBBBBB33", 1)] },
        { contactId: other.id, ref: "N-CCCCCCCC44", lines: [line("N-CCCCCCCC44", 1)] },
      ]);
      expect([...results]).toEqual([
        [first.id, "sent"],
        [second.id, "sent"],
        [other.id, "sent"],
      ]);
      expect(h.mailer.updates).toHaveLength(2);
      const shared = h.mailer.updates.find((m) => m.to === first.email)!;
      expect(shared.data.signedIn).toBe(false);
      expect(shared.data.lines.map((each) => `${each.ref} ${each.item}`)).toEqual(["N-AAAAAAAA22 1", "N-AAAAAAAA22 2", "N-BBBBBBBB33 1"]);
      expect(shared.data.pages).toEqual([
        { ref: "N-AAAAAAAA22", pageUrl: firstLink },
        { ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", pageUrl: secondLink },
      ]);
      expect(shared.data.receipts).toEqual([]);
      expect(pageOf(h, other.email!, "N-CCCCCCCC44")).toMatch(new RegExp(`^${app}/notice/N-CCCCCCCC44#t=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`));
      // Neither a confirmation nor the day's cap holds an update back: a second one goes the same day, to an address nobody confirmed.
      expect([...(await mailNotifierUpdates(h.deps, [{ contactId: other.id, ref: "N-CCCCCCCC44", lines: [line("N-CCCCCCCC44", 1)] }]))]).toEqual([[other.id, "sent"]]);
    });

    test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link and the terms' address, and its notice gets no second page; a receipt alone makes an update of receipts", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const first = await contact(h);
      const folded = await contact(h, { email: first.email });
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt("N-AAAAAAAA22"))).toBe("sent");
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, folded.id, receipt("N-BBBBBBBB33"))).toBe("folded");
      const carried = { ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", receivedAt: new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.123Z"), items: ["http://localhost:8081/u/ada"] };
      const results = await mailNotifierUpdates(h.deps, [
        { contactId: first.id, ref: "N-AAAAAAAA22", lines: [line("N-AAAAAAAA22", 1)] },
        { contactId: folded.id, ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", lines: [line("N-BBBBBBBB33", 1)], receipt: carried },
      ]);
      expect([...results.values()]).toEqual(["sent", "sent"]);
      const update = h.mailer.updates.at(-1)!.data;
      expect(update.receipts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(update.receipts[0]).toMatchObject({ ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", time: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", items: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" });
      expect(update.receipts[0]!.pageUrl).toMatch(new RegExp(`^${app}/notice/N-BBBBBBBB33#t=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`));
      // The carried receipt's notice has its page with the receipt; only the other notice gets a page paragraph.
      expect(update.pages.map((page) => page.ref)).toEqual(["N-AAAAAAAA22"]);
      expect(update.termsUrl).toBe(`${app}/terms`);
      // A contact that is owed nothing but its folded receipt: an update of receipts alone.
      const alone = await contact(h);
      expect([...(await mailNotifierUpdates(h.deps, [{ contactId: alone.id, ref: "N-DDDDDDDD55", lines: [], receipt: { ...carried, ref: "N-DDDDDDDD55" } }]))]).toEqual([[alone.id, "sent"]]);
      expect(h.mailer.updates.at(-1)!.data).toMatchObject({ lines: [], pages: [], receipts: [{ ref: "N-DDDDDDDD55" }] });
    });

    test("it answers for each contact: suppressed, no_address, forgotten, refused when the relay refuses the address, unavailable when it cannot take the mail", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const [stopped, nameOnly, fine, bad, down] = [await contact(h), await contact(h, { name: "Bob", email: undefined }), await contact(h), await contact(h), await contact(h)];
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, stopped.id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, stopped.id, tokenSentTo(h, stopped.email!))).toBe(true);
      const gone = randomUUID();
      const part = (contactId: string, ref: string) => ({ contactId, ref, lines: [line(ref, 1)] });
      const scripted = withMailer(h, async (message) => {
        if (message.to === bad.email) throw new MailRefused("no such mailbox");
        if (message.to === down.email) throw new MailUnavailable("relay down");
        await h.mailer.send(message);
      });
      const results = await mailNotifierUpdates(scripted, [part(stopped.id, "N-AAAAAAAA22"), part(nameOnly.id, "N-BBBBBBBB33"), part(gone, "N-CCCCCCCC44"), part(fine.id, "N-DDDDDDDD55"), part(bad.id, "N-EEEEEEEE66"), part(down.id, "N-FFFFFFFF77")]);
      expect(Object.fromEntries(results)).toEqual({ [stopped.id]: "suppressed", [nameOnly.id]: "no_address", [gone]: "forgotten", [fine.id]: "sent", [bad.id]: "refused", [down.id]: "unavailable" });
      // Nothing was thrown though one address could not be mailed, and only the one that could was.
      expect(h.mailer.updates.map((m) => m.to)).toEqual([fine.email]);
    });

    test("a contact it cannot read is answered unavailable and logged with its id, never an address, while every other address's update is still sent", async () => {
      const old = flowHarness(repo);
      const unreadable = await contact(old);
      // The key was rotated without keeping the old one: what the old key encrypted no configured key opens.
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      h.deps.config.notifierKey = parseVersionedKey(`v2:${Buffer.alloc(32, 9).toString("base64")}`);
      h.deps.config.notifierPreviousKeys = [];
      const readable = await contact(h);
      const logged: unknown[] = [];
      const deps: AuthDeps = { ...h.deps, log: { ...h.deps.log, error: (...args: unknown[]) => void logged.push(args) } as AuthDeps["log"] };
      const results = await mailNotifierUpdates(deps, [
        { contactId: unreadable.id, ref: "N-AAAAAAAA22", lines: [line("N-AAAAAAAA22", 1)] },
        { contactId: readable.id, ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", lines: [line("N-BBBBBBBB33", 1)] },
      ]);
      expect(Object.fromEntries(results)).toEqual({ [unreadable.id]: "unavailable", [readable.id]: "sent" });
      expect(h.mailer.updates.map((m) => m.to)).toEqual([readable.email]);
      expect(logged).toHaveLength(1);
      const text = JSON.stringify(logged[0], (_key, value: unknown) => (value instanceof Error ? value.message : value));
      expect(text).toContain(unreadable.id);
      expect(text).not.toContain(unreadable.email!);
    });
  });

  describe("mailStaff: an alert to every live staff account", () => {
    test("goes to every moderator and admin, to no user and to no deleted staff account, and answers how many addresses the relay took", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const [moderator, admin, gone] = [await newStaffAccount(db, repo, "moderator"), await newStaffAccount(db, repo, "admin"), await newStaffAccount(db, repo, "moderator")];
      await repo.markDeleted(gone.user.id, h.clock.now());
      const user = await repo.createUser({ email: newTestEmail("plain"), termsVersion: "test", now: h.clock.now() });
      const accepted = await mailStaff(h.deps, { template: "moderation_urgent", count: 2, oldest: new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.123Z"), phones: true });
      // Other suites leave staff accounts in the shared database: every one of them is mailed too.
      expect(accepted).toBe(h.mailer.sent.length);
      const recipients = h.mailer.sent.map((m) => m.to);
      expect(recipients).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([moderator.user.email, admin.user.email]));
      expect(recipients).not.toContain(gone.user.email);
      expect(recipients).not.toContain(user.email);
      expect(new Set(recipients).size).toBe(recipients.length);
      for (const sent of h.mailer.sent) {
        expect(sent.template).toBe("moderation_urgent");
        expect(sent.data).toEqual({ count: "2", oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", phones: "on" });
      }
    });

    test("the alerts of deciding and of the dispatch hand the templates their data as text: a burst, a decision that lifted the protection of reported images, and cases that wait", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const { user } = await newStaffAccount(db, repo, "moderator");
      const at = new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.123Z");
      const dataOf = () => h.mailer.sent.findLast((m) => m.to === user.email)!;
      await mailStaff(h.deps, { template: "moderation_burst", handle: "mod_anna", count: 20 });
      expect(dataOf()).toMatchObject({ template: "moderation_burst", data: { handle: "mod_anna", count: "20" } });
      await mailStaff(h.deps, { template: "moderation_csam_lifted", handle: "mod_anna", at, what: "dismissed" });
      expect(dataOf()).toMatchObject({ template: "moderation_csam_lifted", data: { handle: "mod_anna", time: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", what: "dismissed" } });
      // A lane's pair is there only for a lane with a case past its time, and the measures' count only when it is not 0.
      await mailStaff(h.deps, { template: "moderation_waiting", lanes: [{ lane: 0, count: 2, oldest: at }, { lane: 2, count: 1, oldest: at }], interim: 0, phones: true });
      expect(dataOf().data).toEqual({ phones: "on", lane0Count: "2", lane0Oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", lane2Count: "1", lane2Oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC" });
      // 3f's review (people4): with the phone alerts off the mail says so.
      await mailStaff(h.deps, { template: "moderation_waiting", lanes: [], interim: 3, phones: false });
      expect(dataOf().data).toEqual({ phones: "off", interimCount: "3" });
    });

    test("is best effort: a relay that takes no mail gives 0 and nothing is thrown; one that takes some gives their number", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      await newStaffAccount(db, repo, "moderator");
      await newStaffAccount(db, repo, "admin");
      const message = { template: "moderation_urgent", count: 1, oldest: h.clock.now(), phones: true } as const;
      expect(
        await mailStaff(
          withMailer(h, async () => {
            throw new MailUnavailable("relay down");
          }),
          message,
        ),
      ).toBe(0);
      let sends = 0;
      const everyOther = withMailer(h, async () => {
        if (++sends % 2 === 0) throw new MailRefused("no such mailbox");
      });
      const accepted = await mailStaff(everyOther, message);
      expect(sends).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
      expect(accepted).toBe(Math.ceil(sends / 2));
    });
  });

  describe("what staff may know of a contact, and what only its mail token does", () => {
    test("notifierFacts: whether a name and an address were given, and whether the address is confirmed or stopped; an id without a row is not found", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const [both, named, addressed] = [await contact(h, { name: "Ada" }), await contact(h, { name: "Bob", email: undefined }), await contact(h)];
      const missing = randomUUID();
      const none = { found: false, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false };
      let facts = await notifierFacts(h.deps, [both.id, named.id, addressed.id, missing]);
      expect(Object.fromEntries(facts)).toEqual({
        [both.id]: { found: true, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: false },
        [named.id]: { found: true, named: true, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false },
        [addressed.id]: { found: true, named: false, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: false },
        [missing]: none,
      });
      await mailNotifier(h.deps, both.id, receipt());
      await mailNotifier(h.deps, addressed.id, receipt());
      await confirmNotifier(h.deps, both.id, tokenSentTo(h, both.email!));
      await stopNotifier(h.deps, addressed.id, tokenSentTo(h, addressed.email!));
      facts = await notifierFacts(h.deps, [both.id, addressed.id]);
      expect(facts.get(both.id)).toMatchObject({ confirmed: true, suppressed: false });
      expect(facts.get(addressed.id)).toMatchObject({ confirmed: false, suppressed: true });
      // A confirmation lasts 30 days.
      h.clock.advance(30 * DAY + 1000);
      expect((await notifierFacts(h.deps, [both.id])).get(both.id)!.confirmed).toBe(false);
      expect(await notifierFacts(h.deps, [])).toEqual(new Map());
    });

    test("notifierName answers the name that was given, or null", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const [named, unnamed] = [await contact(h, { name: "Ada Lovelace" }), await contact(h)];
      expect(await notifierName(h.deps, named.id)).toBe("Ada Lovelace");
      expect(await notifierName(h.deps, unnamed.id)).toBeNull();
      expect(await notifierName(h.deps, randomUUID())).toBeNull();
    });

    test("only the contact's own mail token matches, confirms or stops: not another contact's, not a guess, and nothing for a contact without an address", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const [mine, other, named] = [await contact(h), await contact(h), await contact(h, { name: "Ada", email: undefined })];
      await mailNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, receipt());
      await mailNotifier(h.deps, other.id, receipt());
      const [token, othersToken] = [tokenSentTo(h, mine.email!), tokenSentTo(h, other.email!)];
      expect(token).not.toBe(othersToken);
      expect(await notifierMailTokenMatches(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      for (const wrong of [othersToken, "A".repeat(43), "", token.slice(0, 42)]) {
        expect(await notifierMailTokenMatches(h.deps, mine.id, wrong), wrong).toBe(false);
        expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, wrong), wrong).toBe(false);

        expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(false);

      expect((await notifierFacts(h.deps, [mine.id])).get(mine.id)).toMatchObject({ confirmed: false, suppressed: false });
      // Stopping twice, and confirming twice, is each done once.
      expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect((await notifierFacts(h.deps, [mine.id])).get(mine.id)).toMatchObject({ confirmed: true, suppressed: false });
    });
  });

      const h = flowHarness(repo);

      const untouched = await forgetAfterOf(kept.id);

      await forgetNotifierAfter(h.deps, [one.id, two.id, randomUUID()], at);
      await forgetNotifierAfter(h.deps, [], at);
      for (const id of [one.id, two.id]) expect(await forgetAfterOf(id)).toBe(at.getTime());
      expect(await forgetAfterOf(kept.id)).toBe(untouched);
      const failure = await db.execute(sql`update auth.notifier_contacts set email_hash = 'x' where id = ${one.id}::uuid`).then(() => null, (err: unknown) => err);
      expect(String((failure as { cause?: unknown } | null)?.cause)).toMatch(/permission denied/);
    });

    test("findNotifierContacts answers the contacts of an address, however it is written, with their names; overdueContacts counts what the janitor should have taken a day ago", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const first = await contact(h, { name: "Ada" });
      const second = await contact(h, { email: first.email });
      const found = await findNotifierContacts(h.deps, ` ${first.email!.toUpperCase()} `);
      expect(found).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(found).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([{ id: first.id, name: "Ada" }, { id: second.id, name: null }]));
      expect(await findNotifierContacts(h.deps, newTestEmail("nobody"))).toEqual([]);

      const overdue = await overdueContacts(h.deps);
      // A contact due an hour ago is not overdue yet; one due two days ago is, and so is a confirmation that ran out two days ago.
      await forgetNotifierAfter(h.deps, [first.id], new Date(h.clock.ms() - HOUR));
      expect(await overdueContacts(h.deps)).toBe(overdue);
      await forgetNotifierAfter(h.deps, [second.id], new Date(h.clock.ms() - 2 * DAY));
      expect(await overdueContacts(h.deps)).toBe(overdue + 1);
      // A confirmation made now is not overdue; one made 32 days ago ran out two days ago, and is.
      await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt());
      await confirmNotifier(h.deps, first.id, tokenSentTo(h, first.email!));
      expect(await overdueContacts(h.deps)).toBe(overdue + 1);
      const past = flowHarness(repo);
      past.clock.advance(-32 * DAY);
      const old = await contact(past);
      await mailNotifier(past.deps, old.id, receipt());
      await confirmNotifier(past.deps, old.id, tokenSentTo(past, old.email!));
      expect(await overdueContacts(h.deps)).toBe(overdue + 2);
    });
  });

  describe("3d Task 1: the notice of a lost image, to an account", () => {
    test("image_lost goes to the account's address with its post's time as the notices print one; a stop of the address never holds it back, and a gone account has no address", async () => {

      // The address asked korbat to stop its report mails: the notice of a lost image is no report mail.
      const signedOut = await contact(h, { email });

      expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, signedOut.id, tokenSentTo(h, email))).toBe(true);
      expect(await mailAccount(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("suppressed");
      expect(await mailAccount(h.deps, id, lost)).toBe("sent");
      expect(await mailAccount(h.deps, randomUUID(), lost)).toBe("no_address");

    if (hashes.length > 0) {

      await db.execute(sql`delete from auth.notifier_suppressions where email_hash = any(${`{${hashes.join(",")}}`}::text[])`);
    }
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});

type Role = { is: "deleter" } | { is: "reader" } | { is: "neither"; why: string };
const METHODS: Record<keyof MediaRepo, Role> = {

/** What a deleter is run on: the repository on the test's transaction, and the frozen post with its author and images. */

        // The account's upload on no post is reached by no case: the owner's purge took it.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [upload])).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => p.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("once nothing freezes the post any more, the same deleters take its rows", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const { caseId } = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await w.repo.detachAll(w.tx, p.postId)).toEqual([]);
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect(sorted(await w.repo.detachAll(w.tx, p.postId))).toEqual(sorted(p.mediaIds));
      });
    });

    test("a hold that is released on a frozen post's image frees nothing: the freeze keeps the row whether a hold stands or not", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report about the post itself places its case's hold and freezes the post.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update media_holds set released_at = now() where media_id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        const [row] = await w.tx.execute<{ held: boolean }>(sql`select hold_until is not null as held from post_media where id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(row).toEqual({ held: false });
        await authorDeletes(w.tx, p.postId);
        for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(DELETERS)) {
          await run({ repo: w.repo, tx: w.tx, ownerId: ada.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds });
          expect(await existing(w.tx, p.mediaIds), name).toEqual(p.mediaIds);
        }
      }, migrateDb);
    });
  });

  describe("gate K through the flows: the author's deletion, the purge, the sweeper and the reconcile pass", () => {
    /** Each kind of reach through a real report of child sexual abuse material; it answers nothing, the post is frozen. */
    const REPORTS: Record<string, (w: World, post: { postId: string; ownerId: string; handle: string }) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      "its own item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(post.postId), "csam"),
      "its author's account's item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam"),
      "an item korbat added for a post that quotes it": async (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(await newPostRow(w.tx, (await newProfile(w.tx as unknown as Db)).id, { quoteOfId: post.postId })), "csam"),
    };

    test.each(Object.keys(REPORTS))("a post frozen through %s: its rows outlive every flow that deletes, no file of them is requested, and no reader shows them once the post is deleted", async (kind) => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const frozen = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        await REPORTS[kind]!(w, { postId: frozen.postId, ownerId: ada.id, handle: ada.handle });
        // A case about the account reaches every post of the account, so there the other post's image is kept too.
        const kept = kind === "its author's account's item" ? [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds] : frozen.mediaIds;
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => kept.includes(id));

        // The author deletes the post, through the flow: the post is a tombstone, and its image rows stay.
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId);
        expect(await rejection(getPost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId))).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // No reader shows a kept image of a deleted post, to its owner either, so the freeze tells the author nothing.
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) {
          for (const viewer of [ada.id, null]) expect((await ask(w, id, viewer)).kind, `serve ${String(viewer)}`).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.find(id)).toBeNull();
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.isExportable(ada.id, id)).toBe(false);
        }
        expect((await w.repo.forPosts([frozen.postId])).size).toBe(0);
        expect(await w.repo.readyImages(ada.id)).toEqual([...free.mediaIds, upload]);
        // The reconcile pass asks which ids have a row: the kept rows are seen, so their files are no orphans.
        expect(await w.repo.existing(frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(new Set(frozen.mediaIds));

        // The export names no image under the deleted post, holds no file of it, and lists none as missing.
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`, `media/${upload}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === frozen.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "", media: [] });
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === free.postId)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(free.mediaIds);
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);

        // The sweeper two days on, with its reconcile pass: every stored file is old by then, and none of the kept rows'
        // files is taken for an orphan.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The account is purged, by the request and then again by the job: the kept rows stay, unserved, and only the
        // files of the rows that went are requested.
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0, held: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds, upload])).toEqual(sorted(kept));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([...free.mediaIds, upload].filter((id) => !kept.includes(id))));
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, frozen.postId)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a purge whose transaction does not commit has asked for no file: a report that then freezes the account keeps rows whose files nobody was told to delete, neither the rerun nor the sweeper asks for them, and a seal lists images that are still there", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => own.mediaIds.includes(id));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The first run deletes the rows, and its transaction does not commit: the process stops, or the connection is lost.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        // The rows are back, and no file of them was asked for: the worker deletes whatever a request names.
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // Before the purge job's next round, a report on the protected path about the account: every image is frozen.
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId)).toBe(true);
        // The job's rerun keeps the frozen rows and asks for nothing of them.
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0, held: 0 });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper, which asks again for whatever a deleter still owes: a row that is still there is owed nothing,
        // at once or two days on, when the marker the failed run left is forgotten.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).filter((entry) => own.mediaIds.includes(entry.id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of own.mediaIds) expect(await w.h.files.imageRemains(id)).toBe(true);

        // An admin seals: the seal lists the rows, and their files are there for whoever they are released to.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const states = await w.tx.execute<{ moderation_state: string }>(sql`select moderation_state from post_media where id = any(${uuids(own.mediaIds)})`);
        expect(states.map((row) => row.moderation_state)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("a purge that commits and whose request for the files then fails still finishes: what it deleted stays owed, is counted as late, and the sweeper's next pass asks for exactly those files", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        const mine = [...own.mediaIds, upload];
        const requested = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const owed = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).map((entry) => entry.id).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The requests' directory cannot be written when the purge comes to ask.
        const failing: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          media: mediaForAccount({
            ...w.h.deps,
            files: {
              ...w.h.files,
              requestDeletion: async () => {
                throw new Error("EROFS: the uploads volume cannot be written");
              },
            },
          }),
        };
        await purge(failing, ada.id);
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await owed()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        // Ten minutes on, what is still owed counts among the late erasures of the staff's home screen.
        const drained = await mediaForCases(w.h.deps).overdueDeletions();
        const later = mediaForCases({ ...w.h.deps, now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 11 * 60_000) });
        expect((await later.overdueDeletions()) - drained).toBe(mine.length);

        // The sweeper's next pass, with the volume back: the files are asked for, and nothing is owed any more.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        expect(await owed()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await later.overdueDeletions()).toBe(drained);
      });
    });

    test("the account's purge end to end with open cases about it and a report it sent: a run that does not commit asks for nothing; the request's run and the job's keep what a case holds or a freeze keeps, ask for none of its files and forget her report; the cases then go on to their decisions, the disposal and the erasure of statements", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const second = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const other = await imagePost(w.tx, 0);
        // She reported someone else's post, signed in; someone reported a post of hers under a rule; and her account is
        // reported on the protected path. The take-down has marked her auth row.
        const hers = await intake(w.tx, ground.illegal(ada.id), aPost(other.postId));
        const rule = await report(w.tx, aPost(own.postId), "rule");
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        await authAccount(w.tx, ada.id, "0 seconds");
        const images = [...own.mediaIds, ...second.mediaIds];
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => images.includes(id));
        const base = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        const deps: typeof base = {
          ...base,
          moderation: {
            forgetAccount: async (userId) => void (await forgetReporter(w.tx, userId)),
            exportFor: () => Promise.reject(new Error("not exercised here")),
            takeDownDue: async () => ({ terminated: 0, failed: 0 }),
          },
        };

        // A first run whose transaction does not commit: nothing of it stands, and no file was asked for.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The request's run, and the job's after it.
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0, held: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        const [profile] = await w.tx.execute<{ display_name: string; bio: string; deleted: boolean; handle: string }>(sql`select display_name, bio, deleted_at is not null as deleted, handle from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...profile! }).toEqual({ display_name: "Deleted account", bio: "", deleted: true, handle: ada.handle });
        expect([...(await w.tx.execute<{ state: string; body: string }>(sql`select state, body from posts where author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid`))].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
        ]);
        // Every image row stays (the freeze keeps them all, the rule case holds one), and none of their files was asked for.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(sorted(images));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([true, true]);
        // Her report no longer names her, on the notice or on its items.
        const [forgotten] = await w.tx.execute<{ intake: boolean; items: boolean }>(
          sql`select n.reporter_id is null as intake, (select bool_and(i.reporter_account_id is null) from intake_items i where i.intake_id = n.id) as items from intakes n where n.id = ${hers.intakeId}::uuid`,
        );
        expect({ ...forgotten! }).toEqual({ intake: true, items: true });

        // The rule case is decided on its copy: the removal changes nothing, the post being deleted, and says so.
        const removal = await decideIn(w.tx, mod, rule.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
        // 3e: the strike it gives counts all the same (a strike never has a no_effect): what counts is the breach.
        expect((await actionsOf(w.tx, removal)).map((action) => [action.kind, action.no_effect])).toEqual([
          ["remove", "deleted"],
          ["strike", null],
        ]);
        expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(w.tx as unknown as Db, removal))!.statement)[0]).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.deletedPost);
        // Its mail finds nobody: the auth module answers no_address for an account that is gone.
        expect(await sendStatement({ apiDb: w.tx as unknown as Db, auth: { mailAccount: async () => "no_address" } as never, social: socialForModeration(w.tx as unknown as Db) }, removal)).toBe("no_address");

        // The admin answers the report about her account without a seal: the freeze ends, and the disposal takes the image
        // no case holds and keeps the one the rule case holds.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([false, false]);
        const gone = await w.cases.dropDisposable(w.tx);
        expect(gone.filter((id) => images.includes(id))).toEqual(second.mediaIds);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(own.mediaIds);

        // Thirteen months after her account was deleted, the removal's statement texts are due and erased.
        await ageCase(w.tx, rule.caseId, "13 months");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await dueStatements(w.tx, 12)).toContain(removal);
        expect(await eraseStatementTexts(w.tx, removal)).toBe(2);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a deleted post whose images a case holds, with no freeze: the same for every reader and for the export", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const held = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report under a rule: its case holds the post's images as evidence.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(held.postId), "rule");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, held.postId)).toBe(false);
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, held.postId);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of held.mediaIds) {
          expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
        }
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === held.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", media: [] });
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper's reconcile pass leaves the retained rows' files alone.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
      });
    });
  });

  describe("gates S and V: every reader, for a frozen post and for sealed images", () => {
    /** An author with an image post, a reply of their own with an image and a post Explore ranks, and a reader who follows them. */
    async function scene(w: World) {
      // Explore ranks as of a past this file has to itself, so no other suite's post is in the ranking read below.
      const asOf = new Date(Date.UTC(2019, 0, 10, 12));
      const [author, other, ...fans] = await accounts(w.tx as unknown as Db, asOf, 5);
      const top = await w.h.postWithImages(author!.id, 2);
      const strangerReply = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply by someone else", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const reply = await newPost(w.s.repo, author!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "a reply with an image", { replyToId: top.postId });
      const replyImage = await w.h.readyImage(author!.id);
      await w.tx.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${reply}::uuid, position = 0, alt_text = 'a reply image' where id = ${replyImage}::uuid`);
      const quoting = await newPost(w.s.repo, other!.id, w.s.clock.next(), "look at this", { quoteOfId: top.postId });
      const ranked = await newPostRow(w.tx, author!.id, { createdAt: sql`${earlier(asOf, 2 * HOUR).toISOString()}::timestamptz` });
      const rankedImage = await newImageRow(w.tx, author!.id, ranked, 0);
      await likedBy(w.s.repo, ranked, fans as { id: string }[], earlier(asOf, HOUR));
      // A round writes nothing while a ranking as new as its own time exists, and other suites leave theirs behind:
      // inside this transaction, which is rolled back, there is none.
      await w.tx.execute(sql`delete from explore_runs`);
      await rank(w.s.repo, asOf);
      for (const reader of [author!, other!]) {
        expect(await w.s.repo.like(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
        expect(await w.s.repo.bookmark(reader.id, top.postId, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(await w.s.repo.follow(other!.id, author!.id, w.s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
      return { author: author!, other: other!, top, strangerReply, reply, replyImage, quoting, ranked, rankedImage };
    }
    type Scene = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scene>>;
    type Listed = (MediaView | HiddenMedia)[] | undefined;

    /**
     * Every list a post's images are read through, each as the viewer gets it: the images of the named post in that list.
     * `signedIn` marks the lists only an account has; Following is read by the one who follows the author.
     */
    function lists(w: World, f: Scene): { name: string; images: string[]; signedIn?: boolean; onlyFor?: string; read: (viewer: string | null) => Promise<Listed> }[] {
      const top = [...f.top.mediaIds];
      const inItems = (items: { post: PostView }[], id: string) => items.find((item) => item.post.id === id)?.post.media;
      const inPosts = (items: PostView[], id: string) => items.find((post) => post.id === id)?.media;
      return [
        { name: "the single post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId)).media },
        { name: "a thread's own post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).post.media },
        { name: "a thread's ancestor", images: top, read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.strangerReply, page)).ancestors as PostView[], f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a thread's reply", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).replies.items, f.reply) },
        { name: "the Latest timeline", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await latestTimeline(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the Following timeline", images: top, signedIn: true, onlyFor: f.other.id, read: async (v) => inItems((await followingTimeline(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "Explore", images: [f.rankedImage], read: async (v) => inItems((await explorePage(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.ranked) },
        { name: "the profile's posts", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await profilePosts(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the profile's replies", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await profileReplies(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.reply) },
        { name: "likes", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await likedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "bookmarks", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await bookmarkedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a quote embed", images: top, read: async (v) => { const quote = (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.quoting)).quoteOf; return quote && "media" in quote ? quote.media : undefined; } },
      ];
    }
    /** Runs every list for every viewer it has, and hands each answer to `check`. */
    async function everyList(w: World, f: Scene, check: (answer: Listed, images: string[], viewer: string | null, label: string) => void) {
      for (const list of lists(w, f)) {
        for (const viewer of [f.author.id, f.other.id, null]) {
          if (viewer === null && list.signedIn) continue;
          if (list.onlyFor && viewer !== list.onlyFor) continue;
          check(await list.read(viewer), list.images, viewer, `${list.name}, read by ${viewer === f.author.id ? "the author" : viewer === null ? "nobody signed in" : "another account"}`);
        }
      }
    }
    test("a frozen post whose images are not sealed: staff are refused, and every other reader is unchanged", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {

        const other = await report(w.tx, aPost(plain.postId), "rule");

        const media = async (viewer: string | null) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, viewer, p.postId)).media;

        expect(await media(ada.id)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: first, moderation: "withheld", alt: "image 1", large: mediaPath(first, "large") }), whole(second), whole(third)]);
        for (const viewer of [bob.id, null]) expect(await media(viewer), String(viewer)).toEqual([{ id: first, hidden: true }, whole(second), whole(third)]);
        expect(await ask(w, first, ada.id)).toEqual({ kind: "file", cacheControl: "private, no-store" });

        expect(await ask(w, second, null)).toEqual({ kind: "file", cacheControl: "public, max-age=300" });

        await decideIn(w.tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove_media", second)] });

        for (const viewer of [bob.id, null]) expect(await media(viewer), String(viewer)).toEqual([whole(first), { id: second, hidden: true }, whole(third)]);

        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", ...p.mediaIds.map((id) => `media/${id}.webp`)].sort());
        // Staff may open a removed image: it is what they judge an appeal on.
        writeFileSync(w.h.files.store.image(second, "large"), webpBytes("VP8X", 2048, 1536));
        expect(await staffOpens(w, second)).toBe(true);
      });
    });
  });

    expect(await authCaseCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(authCounts);
  });
});

  posts: ["body", "state", "deleted_at", "like_count", "repost_count", "reply_count", "quote_count"],
  post_media: ["status", "error", "post_id", "position", "width", "height", "blurhash", "alt_text", "nsfw_score"],
};
const READ_ONLY = ["moderation_limits", "seal_posts"];

 * Migrations 0014 to 0017 (3c design, sections 6.1 to 6.3 and 6.5) against the real database: what the API role holds and
 * does not hold, which columns the database forces whatever an insert supplies, the CHECKs against the contracts'
 * constants, who owns and may call each function, and which functions alone name the freeze, write a seal's list and
 * write the moderation columns. Statements run as korbat_api, the role the running API
 * holds, unless a test says otherwise: what it cannot do is what a compromised API cannot do. Every test that writes a
 * row does it inside a transaction that is rolled back, each refused statement in a savepoint of it, so the file leaves
 * the database as it found it; its last test holds it to that.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the moderation tables, their grants and their checks", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    // The migrate role is not part of the API configuration; the test environment carries it.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });

  /** Runs one statement as the API role, in a transaction with a lock timeout, and returns its error or null. For statements that write no row. */
  const asApi = (statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => pgError(withLockTimeout(apiDb, (tx) => tx.execute(statement)));
  const asAuth = (statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => pgError(withLockTimeout(authDb, (tx) => tx.execute(statement)));
  /** The error of one step inside a transaction, which stays usable: the step runs in a savepoint. */
  const within = (tx: DbTx, fn: (sp: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>) => pgError(tx.transaction(fn));

  async function tablePrivileges(role: string, table: string): Promise<string[]> {
    const [schema, name] = table.split(".");
    const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ privilege: string; held: boolean }>(sql`
      select p as privilege, has_table_privilege(${role}::name, c.oid, p) as held
        from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace, unnest(array['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'MAINTAIN']) with ordinality as u(p, place)
       where n.nspname = ${schema} and c.relname = ${name}
       order by u.place`);

    return rows.filter((row) => row.held).map((row) => row.privilege);

       order by a.attnum`);

          [sql`update post_media set erased_at = now() where id = ${mediaId}::uuid`, /permission denied for table post_media/],
        ];
        for (const [statement, refusal] of refused) expect((await run(tx, statement))?.message, JSON.stringify(statement.queryChunks[0])).toMatch(refusal);
        // What the API writes today still works: a counter, the author's deletion and an upload's verdict.
        expect(await run(tx, sql`update posts set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = ${postId}::uuid`)).toBeNull();
        expect(await run(tx, sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${postId}::uuid`)).toBeNull();
        const upload = await newImageRow(tx, ada.id, null);
        expect(await run(tx, sql`update post_media set status = 'failed', error = 'processing_failed' where id = ${upload}::uuid`)).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("it can neither switch off nor replace a trigger of the moderation tables", async () => {
      const refusals: [ReturnType<typeof sql>, RegExp][] = [
        [sql`alter table public.post_media disable trigger post_media_keep`, /must be owner of table post_media/],
        [sql`alter table public.intake_items disable trigger all`, /must be owner of table intake_items/],
        [sql`drop trigger post_media_guard on public.post_media`, /must be owner of (table|relation) post_media/],
        [sql`create or replace function public.frozen_for(post uuid, author uuid) returns boolean language sql as 'select false'`, /permission denied|must be owner/],
        [sql`drop trigger intake_items_quote on public.intake_items`, /must be owner of (table|relation) intake_items/],
      ];
      for (const [statement, refusal] of refusals) expect((await asApi(statement))?.message, JSON.stringify(statement.queryChunks[0])).toMatch(refusal);
    });
  });

  describe("what the auth role holds on the new auth tables", () => {
    test("a contact is stored, read and deleted, and only its forget_after is ever updated", async () => {
      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_contacts")).toEqual(["SELECT", "INSERT", "DELETE"]);
      expect(await updatableColumns("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_contacts")).toEqual(["forget_after"]);
      await rolledBack(authDb, async (tx) => {
        const id = randomUUID();
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into auth.notifier_contacts (id, name_enc, email_enc, email_hash, forget_after) values (${id}::uuid, 'v1:n', 'v1:e', ${hex64()}, now() + interval '13 months')`);
        expect(await run(tx, sql`update auth.notifier_contacts set forget_after = now() + interval '6 months' where id = ${id}::uuid`)).toBeNull();
        // Never re-encrypted, renamed or pointed at another address.
        for (const column of ["name_enc", "email_enc", "email_hash", "mail_token_enc", "created_at"]) {
          const err = await run(tx, sql`update auth.notifier_contacts set ${sql.identifier(column)} = null where id = ${id}::uuid`);
          expect(err?.message, column).toMatch(/permission denied for table notifier_contacts/);
        }
        const gone = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`delete from auth.notifier_contacts where id = ${id}::uuid returning id`);
        expect(gone).toHaveLength(1);
      });
    });

    test("confirmations keep every default privilege; a suppression is inserted, read and deleted, never changed", async () => {
      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_confirmations")).toEqual(["SELECT", "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE"]);
      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_suppressions")).toEqual(["SELECT", "INSERT", "DELETE"]);
      expect(await updatableColumns("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_suppressions")).toEqual([]);
    });

    test("it holds nothing on the staff links, which only the migrator writes and reads", async () => {
      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_auth", "auth.staff_personal_accounts")).toEqual([]);
      expect((await asAuth(sql`select count(*) from auth.staff_personal_accounts`))?.message).toMatch(/permission denied for table staff_personal_accounts/);
      expect((await asAuth(sql`insert into auth.staff_personal_accounts (staff_user_id, personal_user_id) values (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${randomUUID()}::uuid)`))?.message).toMatch(
        /permission denied for table staff_personal_accounts/,
      );
    });
  });

  describe("the functions and who names them", () => {
    type Fn = { name: string; args: string; owner: string; definer: boolean; config: string[] | null; api: boolean; auth: boolean; pub: boolean; definition: string };
    /** Every function of the public and auth schemas with its definition, as the catalogue holds it. */
    const functions = () =>
      apiDb.execute<Fn>(sql`
        select p.pronamespace::regnamespace::text || '.' || p.proname as name, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as args, p.proowner::regrole::text as owner,
               p.prosecdef as definer, p.proconfig as config, has_function_privilege('korbat_api', p.oid, 'execute') as api,
               has_function_privilege('korbat_auth', p.oid, 'execute') as auth, has_function_privilege('public', p.oid, 'execute') as pub,
               pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition
          from pg_proc p
         where p.pronamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace) and p.prokind = 'f'
         order by 1`);

    /** Every other definition the database holds that could name a function: views, triggers, constraints, index predicates and policies. */
    const otherDefinitions = () =>
      apiDb.execute<{ kind: string; name: string; definition: string }>(sql`
        select 'view' as kind, c.relname::text as name, pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) as definition from pg_class c where c.relkind = 'v' and c.relnamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'trigger', t.tgname::text, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid where not t.tgisinternal and c.relnamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'constraint', n.conname::text, pg_get_constraintdef(n.oid) from pg_constraint n where n.connamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'index', i.indexrelid::regclass::text, pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) from pg_index i join pg_class c on c.oid = i.indrelid where c.relnamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'policy', p.polname::text, coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid), '') || ' ' || coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid), '') from pg_policy p`);

    test("the migrator owns every function of 0015, each with its search path pinned and EXECUTE taken from PUBLIC", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];
      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role]. The few a role calls directly are granted to that role alone; a trigger
      // function fires for every role all the same, and nobody calls it.
      const expected: Record<string, [boolean, boolean]> = {
        appeal_deadline: [false, true],
        case_access_log_insert: [false, false],
        cases_insert: [false, false],
        evidence_snapshots_insert: [false, false],
        frozen_for: [false, true],
        intake_items_attach: [true, false],
        intake_items_quote: [true, false],
        intakes_insert: [false, false],
        media_holds_apply: [true, false],
        media_holds_insert: [false, false],
        post_frozen: [false, true],
        post_media_guard: [false, false],
        post_media_insert: [false, false],
        post_media_keep: [true, false],
        staff_texts_insert: [false, false],
      };
      const names = Object.keys(expected);
      const rows = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && names.includes(f.name.slice(7)));
      expect(rows.map((f) => f.name.slice(7)).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
      for (const f of rows) {
        const [definer, api] = expected[f.name.slice(7)]!;
        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config: pub, api, auth: false, pub: false });
      }
    });

    test("the migrator owns every function of 0016; the API role may call four of them and no other", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];
      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role, the pinned search path]. The trigger functions fire for every role and nobody
      // calls them; moderation_apply, the one writer of the moderation columns, is called only by its owner's functions.
      const expected: Record<string, [boolean, boolean, string[]]> = {

        append_confirmed_audit: [true, true, pub],
        decision_actions_apply: [true, false, pub],
        decision_actions_check: [true, false, pub],
        decision_actions_recheck: [true, false, pub],
        decision_holds: [true, false, pub],
        decisions_apply: [true, false, pub],
        decisions_check: [true, false, pub],
        decisions_record: [true, false, pub],
        item_current_outcome: [false, false, pub],
        moderation_apply: [true, false, pub],
        posts_guard: [false, false, pub],
        release_outcomes: [true, true, pub],
        snapshot_withheld: [false, true, pub],
        staff_case_conflict: [true, true, pub],

      };
      const names = Object.keys(expected);
      const rows = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && names.includes(f.name.slice(7)));
      expect(rows.map((f) => f.name.slice(7)).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
      for (const f of rows) {
        const [definer, api, config] = expected[f.name.slice(7)]!;
        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config, api, auth: false, pub: false });
      }
      // Every function of the public schema is one of 0015's or 0016's lists, or older than both.
      const callable = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && f.api).map((f) => f.name.slice(7));
      expect(callable).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["append_confirmed_audit", "release_outcomes", "snapshot_withheld", "staff_case_conflict"]));
      for (const name of ["moderation_apply", "item_current_outcome", "account_is_staff", "staff_party_conflict"]) expect(callable, name).not.toContain(name);
    });

    test("the migrator owns the three functions of 0017; the API role may call the two that answer who reviews, and the three it replaced keep their owner and grants", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];
      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role]. The appeal's trigger function fires for every role and nobody calls it.
      const expected: Record<string, [boolean, boolean]> = {
        appeal_reviewer_state: [true, true],
        appeals_check: [true, false],
        review_needs_admin: [true, true],
        // Replaced by 0017 with CREATE OR REPLACE, which keeps what 0016 gave them.
        decision_actions_apply: [true, false],
        decisions_apply: [true, false],
        decisions_record: [true, false],
      };
      const names = Object.keys(expected);
      const rows = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && names.includes(f.name.slice(7)));
      expect(rows.map((f) => f.name.slice(7)).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
      for (const f of rows) {
        const [definer, api] = expected[f.name.slice(7)]!;
        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config: pub, api, auth: false, pub: false });
      }
      // The replaced functions are the new ones: a review is accepted, an appeal is answered, and a seal is asked of the view.
      const definition = (name: string) => rows.find((f) => f.name === `public.${name}`)!.definition;
      expect(definition("decisions_record")).toMatch(/reviewer_conflict/);
      expect(definition("decisions_record")).not.toMatch(/waits for the migration/);
      expect(definition("decisions_apply")).toMatch(/UPDATE public\.appeals/);
      expect(definition("decision_actions_apply")).toMatch(/measures_in_force m WHERE m\.id = NEW\.id/);
      // review_needs_admin reads the decision and its ledger, never the freeze.
      expect(definition("review_needs_admin")).not.toMatch(/frozen|intake_items|cases/);
    });

    test("the appeal's trigger is on its table, before the insert", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string; definition: string }>(sql`
        select t.tgname::text as name, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) as definition from pg_trigger t where not t.tgisinternal and t.tgrelid = 'public.appeals'::regclass order by 1`);
      expect(rows.map((row) => [row.name, row.definition.replace(/^CREATE (CONSTRAINT )?TRIGGER \S+ /, "").replace(/ EXECUTE FUNCTION .*$/, "")])).toEqual([["appeals_check", "BEFORE INSERT ON public.appeals FOR EACH ROW"]]);
    });

    test("the migrator owns every function of 0018; the API role may call the due rules and the erasures that check them, never the two gates' own functions", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];

      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role]. The three due rules are plain and run with their reader's rights. The one
      // function that erases a snapshot (gate E) and the one that releases holds are called only by their owner's functions.
      const expected: Record<string, [boolean, boolean]> = {

      const names = Object.keys(expected);

      const rows = all.filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && names.includes(f.name.slice(7)));
      expect(rows.map((f) => f.name.slice(7)).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
      for (const f of rows) {
        const [definer, api] = expected[f.name.slice(7)]!;
        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config: pub, api, auth: false, pub: false });
      }
      // The auth schema's two: the count of links, which the auth role alone may call, and the trigger function nobody calls.
      const authSide = all.filter((f) => f.name === "auth.users_deleted_mark" || f.name === "auth.staff_link_counts");
      expect(authSide.map((f) => ({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }))).toEqual([
        { name: "auth.staff_link_counts", owner: "korbat_migrate", definer: true, config: auth, api: false, auth: true, pub: false },
        { name: "auth.users_deleted_mark", owner: "korbat_migrate", definer: false, config: auth, api: false, auth: false, pub: false },

      // Everything the API role may call of what the migrator owns, in both schemas, after the last migration of 3c (design,

      // and 3e's two steps of the retention job (0024_standing_retention): a reply's text and the reporting counts; and 3f's

      const callable = all.filter((f) => f.owner === "korbat_migrate" && f.api).map((f) => f.name);
      expect(callable).toEqual([
        "public.alert_steps",

        "public.lost_told",

    test("the deletion mark's trigger is on auth.users, before an update that names the mark", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ definition: string }>(sql`
        select pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) as definition from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid
         where not t.tgisinternal and c.relnamespace = 'auth'::regnamespace and c.relname = 'users' and t.tgname = 'users_deleted_mark'`);
      expect(rows.map((row) => row.definition.replace(/^CREATE TRIGGER \S+ /, "").replace(/ EXECUTE FUNCTION .*$/, ""))).toEqual(["BEFORE UPDATE OF deleted_at ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW"]);
    });

    test("every function the migrator owns in the two schemas pins its search path and is closed to PUBLIC", async () => {
      const owned = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.owner === "korbat_migrate");
      expect(owned.length).toBeGreaterThan(15);
      for (const f of owned) {
        expect(f.config?.some((setting) => /^search_path=(public|auth), pg_temp$/.test(setting)), f.name).toBe(true);
        expect(f.pub, f.name).toBe(false);
      }
    });

    test("frozen_for is named only by post_frozen and by the keep trigger's function; post_frozen only by decisions_record, erase_snapshots, redact_r4_body and order_preservation_end", async () => {
      const all = await functions();
      const naming = (word: RegExp) => all.filter((f) => word.test(f.definition)).map((f) => f.name);
      // Each function's own definition holds its name.
      expect(naming(/\bfrozen_for\b/)).toEqual(["public.frozen_for", "public.post_frozen", "public.post_media_keep"]);
      // One function of 0016 reads the freeze: the one that stores whether a decision was taken while nobody could open the images.
      // And two of 0018: the one function that erases a snapshot (gate E), and the R4 redaction, which waits while its post is frozen.
      // And (3f, 0029) the end of an order's preservation, which waits as the redaction does.
      expect(naming(/\bpost_frozen\b/)).toEqual(["public.decisions_record", "public.erase_snapshots", "public.order_preservation_end", "public.post_frozen", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // Nor does a view, a trigger, a constraint, an index or a policy name either.
      const others = (await otherDefinitions()).filter((d) => /\b(frozen_for|post_frozen)\b/.test(d.definition));
      expect(others.map((d) => `${d.kind} ${d.name}`)).toEqual([]);
    });

    test("one function writes a seal's list, and one the moderation columns of posts and images", async () => {
      const all = await functions();
      const matching = (statement: RegExp) => all.filter((f) => statement.test(f.definition)).map((f) => f.name);
      // A statement that writes the table, as SQL may spell it: an insert, an update, a delete or a merge, the name bare or
      // schema-qualified, quoted or not; for a column, an update, a merge or an insert that updates on a conflict.
      const sealList = /(insert\s+into|update|delete\s+from|merge\s+into)\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?seal_posts"?(?![\w"])/i;
      const imageState = /(update\s+(only\s+)?|merge\s+into\s+(only\s+)?|insert\s+into\s+)("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media"?(?![\w"])[^;]*\bset\b[^;]*"?moderation_state"?\s*=/i;
      const postColumns = /(update\s+(only\s+)?|merge\s+into\s+(only\s+)?|insert\s+into\s+)("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?posts"?(?![\w"])[^;]*\bset\b[^;]*"?(moderation_level|state|erased_at)"?\s*=/i;
      const calls = /\bmoderation_apply\s*\(/i;
      expect(matching(sealList)).toEqual(["public.decision_actions_apply"]);
      expect(matching(imageState)).toEqual(["public.moderation_apply"]);
      // Of the three columns of posts, the level and the state are moderation_apply's alone; the erasure mark is the R4
      // redaction's and (3f, 0029) the end of an order's preservation's.
      expect(matching(postColumns)).toEqual(["public.moderation_apply", "public.order_preservation_end", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      const written = (table: string, columns: string) =>
        new RegExp(String.raw`(update\s+(only\s+)?|merge\s+into\s+(only\s+)?|insert\s+into\s+)("?public"?\s*[.]\s*)?"?${table}"?(?![\w"])[^;]*\bset\b[^;]*"?(${columns})"?\s*=`, "i");
      const postLevel = written("posts", "moderation_level|state");
      const postErased = written("posts", "erased_at");
      const imageErased = written("post_media", "erased_at");
      const snapshotErased = written("evidence_snapshots", "erased_at");
      expect(matching(postLevel)).toEqual(["public.moderation_apply"]);
      expect(matching(postErased)).toEqual(["public.order_preservation_end", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      expect(matching(imageErased)).toEqual(["public.order_preservation_end", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // Gate E: one function writes a snapshot's erasure, no function deletes a snapshot, and that one function is called
      // by the two erasures of 0018 and by nothing else.
      expect(matching(snapshotErased)).toEqual(["public.erase_snapshots"]);
      expect(matching(/delete\s+from\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*[.]\s*)?"?evidence_snapshots"?(?![\w"])/i)).toEqual([]);
      expect(matching(/\berase_snapshots\s*\(/i)).toEqual(["public.erase_case_evidence", "public.erase_snapshots", "public.order_preservation_end", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // The writer is called by the two triggers that follow a stored decision and a stored measure, by the R4 redaction,
      // and (3f) by order_correct, whose changed withholding derives the level of its measures' posts again.
      // And (3f, 0029) the end of an order's preservation, by which an erased post is removed for good.
      expect(matching(calls)).toEqual(["public.decision_actions_apply", "public.decisions_apply", "public.moderation_apply", "public.order_correct", "public.order_preservation_end", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      for (const statement of [
        "UPDATE public.evidence_snapshots s SET erased_at = now(), body = NULL",
        'update only "public"."evidence_snapshots" set "erased_at" = $1',
        "merge into evidence_snapshots s using v on s.id = v.id when matched then update set erased_at = now()",
      ]) {
        expect(snapshotErased.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(snapshotErased.test("select 1 from public.evidence_snapshots s where s.erased_at is null; update public.staff_texts t set erased_at = now()")).toBe(false);
      expect(imageErased.test("UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = coalesce(m.erased_at, now())")).toBe(true);
      expect(imageErased.test("UPDATE public.media_holds h SET released_at = now(); select m.erased_at = now() from public.post_media m")).toBe(false);
      expect(postErased.test("UPDATE public.posts p SET body = '', erased_at = now()")).toBe(true);
      expect(postErased.test("UPDATE public.posts p SET moderation_level = v.level WHERE p.erased_at IS NOT NULL")).toBe(false);
      // Each search finds such a statement in every form, and no other statement.
      for (const statement of [
        "INSERT INTO public.seal_posts (action_id, post_id, images)",
        'insert into "public"."seal_posts" (action_id)',
        "update seal_posts s set images = 1",
        'DELETE FROM ONLY "seal_posts" s',
        "merge into public.seal_posts s using listed l on l.post_id = s.post_id",
      ]) {
        expect(sealList.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(sealList.test("select 1 from public.seal_posts s; delete from public.seal_posts_kept")).toBe(false);
      for (const statement of [
        "UPDATE public.post_media i SET status = 'ready', moderation_state = v.state",
        'update only "public"."post_media" set "moderation_state" = $1',
        "insert into post_media (id) values ($1) on conflict (id) do update set moderation_state = excluded.moderation_state",
        "merge into public.post_media m using v on m.id = v.id when matched then update set moderation_state = v.state",
      ]) {
        expect(imageState.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(imageState.test("UPDATE public.post_media m SET hold_until = latest WHERE m.id = NEW.media_id; SELECT moderation_state = 'x'")).toBe(false);
      expect(imageState.test("insert into public.post_media (owner_id, moderation_state) values ($1, 'visible')")).toBe(false);
      for (const statement of [
        "update posts set body = '', state = 'removed'",
        'UPDATE "public"."posts" p SET "moderation_level" = v.level',
        "insert into public.posts (id) values ($1) on conflict (id) do update set erased_at = now()",
        "merge into posts p using v on p.id = v.id when matched then update set state = v.state",
      ]) {
        expect(postColumns.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(postColumns.test("insert into public.posts (author_id, body, state) values ($1, $2, 'visible')")).toBe(false);
      expect(postColumns.test("update public.posts_archive set state = 'removed'")).toBe(false);
    });

    test("no function deletes from post_media: the image rows go only by a statement the keep trigger meets", async () => {
      const deleting = (await functions()).filter((f) => /delete\s+from\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media"?\b/i.test(f.definition));
      expect(deleting.map((f) => f.name)).toEqual([]);
      // The search finds such a statement where there is one.
      expect(/delete\s+from\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media"?\b/i.test('DELETE FROM "public"."post_media" WHERE id = $1')).toBe(true);
      expect(/delete\s+from\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media"?\b/i.test("delete from public.post_media m where m.id = x")).toBe(true);
    });

    test("the triggers of 0015 are on their tables, in the timing the design gives", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string; definition: string }>(sql`
        select t.tgname::text as name, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) as definition from pg_trigger t
         where not t.tgisinternal and t.tgrelid in ('public.cases'::regclass, 'public.intakes'::regclass, 'public.intake_items'::regclass, 'public.staff_texts'::regclass,
               'public.evidence_snapshots'::regclass, 'public.case_access_log'::regclass, 'public.post_media'::regclass, 'public.media_holds'::regclass)
         order by 1`);

      expect(timing).toEqual({
        case_access_log_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.case_access_log FOR EACH ROW",
        cases_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.cases FOR EACH ROW",
