    for (const [key, subject] of Object.entries(DECISION_MAIL_SUBJECTS)) expect(renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: key, statement }).subject, key).toBe(subject);
    // A subject that is no key of the table is a programming error, never printed as given.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: "Click here to appeal", statement })).toThrow(/subject/);
  });

  test("the statement's paragraphs, one per line of the data, then where to read it, and that no korbat mail carries a link to act on a decision", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: "post_restricted", statement });
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat removed your post of 2026-10-01 12:00 UTC: other people can no longer see it.",
      "The facts: The post offers followers for money.",
      "You can appeal this decision once.",
      "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.",
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|:[/][/]/);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
    // A staff text is only ever text: what it holds never becomes markup, and an empty line is no paragraph.
    const hostile = renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: "post_restricted", statement: "The facts: <script>alert(1)</script>\n\nkorbat's reasons: <b>x</b>" });
    expect(hostile.html).toContain("&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;");
    expect(hostile.html).not.toMatch(/<script|<b>/);
    expect(paragraphs(hostile.text)).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: "post_restricted" })).toThrow(/statement/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { statement })).toThrow(/subject/);
  });
});

describe("the staff alerts of deciding", () => {
  test("moderation_burst names the staff account and how many decisions it confirmed, tells its holder what to do, and carries no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("moderation_burst", { handle: "mod_anna", count: "20" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: many staff decisions in a short time");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "The staff account @mod_anna confirmed 20 decisions in the last 15 minutes.",
      "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not confirm them, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
      "If that was not expected, ask them; if their key may be in someone else's hands, the operator revokes it with staff.js revoke.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(r);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_burst", { handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/count/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_burst", { count: "20" })).toThrow(/handle/);
  });

  test("moderation_csam_lifted has two texts for what the decision did, and says what staff do next", () => {
    const data = { handle: "mod_anna", time: TIME, what: "unsealed" };
    const unsealed = renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", data);
    expect(unsealed.subject).toBe("korbat: reported images are no longer protected");
    expect(paragraphs(unsealed.text)).toEqual([
      `The staff account @mod_anna confirmed a decision at ${TIME} that lifted a seal.`,
      "Unless another seal or another open report of this kind still covers them, the images its case reaches are served again as before and staff may open them. After an answer without a seal, whoever is on duty opens them the same day and, where one breaks a rule or the law, opens a finding on its post. Nobody at korbat could open those images while they were protected.",
      "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not confirm it, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
      "The staff console's home screen lists every such decision of the last 30 days with its case. A seal for good is lifted only on the answer of the authority korbat reported the images to, and a seal taken while deciding only when it was taken in error: the operator compares this decision with their R2 records. If it was not expected, ask them; if their key may be in someone else's hands, the operator revokes it with staff.js revoke, and whoever is on duty opens a finding citing R2 on the post or the account and seals its images while deciding.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(unsealed);
    const dismissed = renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", { ...data, what: "dismissed" });
    expect(paragraphs(dismissed.text)[0]).toBe(`The staff account @mod_anna confirmed a decision at ${TIME} that answered a report or finding of child sexual abuse material without a seal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(dismissed.text).slice(1)).toEqual(paragraphs(unsealed.text).slice(1));
    linkless(dismissed);
    // What it did is one of two words, never a text handed over.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", { ...data, what: "released the images" })).toThrow(/what/);
    for (const key of Object.keys(data)) {
      const { [key]: _left, ...rest } = data as Record<string, string>;
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", rest), key).toThrow(new RegExp(key));
    }
    // It names no case, no post and no person but the staff account.
    expect(renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", { ...data, caseId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a", author: "ada" }).text).toBe(unsealed.text);
  });

  test("moderation_waiting: one line for each lane with a case past its time, in lane order, a single case worded as one, and the cases that hold a measure taken while deciding", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane0Count: "2", lane0Oldest: TIME, lane1Count: "1", lane1Oldest: TIME, lane2Count: "12", lane2Oldest: TIME, interimCount: "3", phones: "on" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: cases are waiting longer than their response time");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `The urgent lane: 2 cases waiting longer than 24 hours; the oldest since ${TIME}.`,
      `Lane 1: 1 case waiting longer than 24 hours, since ${TIME}.`,
      `Lane 2: 12 cases waiting longer than 7 days; the oldest since ${TIME}.`,
      "3 cases have held a measure taken while deciding for more than 24 hours; their authors cannot appeal until the case is decided.",
      "Open the staff console. The same reminder went to every staff phone.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(r);
    // Only the lanes that have such a case, and the measures' line only when there is one.
    const one = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane2Count: "1", lane2Oldest: TIME, phones: "on" });
    expect(paragraphs(one.text)).toEqual([`Lane 2: 1 case waiting longer than 7 days, since ${TIME}.`, "Open the staff console. The same reminder went to every staff phone.", LAST_STAFF]);
    const held = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { interimCount: "1", phones: "on" });
    expect(paragraphs(held.text)).toEqual([
      "1 case has held a measure taken while deciding for more than 24 hours; its author cannot appeal until the case is decided.",
      "Open the staff console. The same reminder went to every staff phone.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    // 3e: the replies to a suspension or a termination unanswered for longer than korbat's aim, after the lanes and the measures.
    const replies = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane1Count: "1", lane1Oldest: TIME, replyCount: "2", replyOldest: TIME, phones: "on" });
    expect(paragraphs(replies.text)).toEqual([
      `Lane 1: 1 case waiting longer than 24 hours, since ${TIME}.`,
      `2 replies to a suspension or termination have waited more than ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours, the oldest since ${TIME}. A reply sent before the start holds its suspension until someone answers.`,
      "Open the staff console. The same reminder went to every staff phone.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(replies);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { replyCount: "1", replyOldest: TIME, phones: "on" }).text)[0]).toBe(
      `1 reply to a suspension or termination has waited more than ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours, since ${TIME}. A reply sent before the start holds its suspension until someone answers.`,
    );
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { replyCount: "2", phones: "on" })).toThrow(/replyOldest/);
    // A count without its time, and a mail about nothing, are programming errors.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane0Count: "2", phones: "on" })).toThrow(/lane0Oldest/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { phones: "on" })).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });

  test("3f's review (people4): with the phone alerts switched off, moderation_waiting says that it is the only reminder and never that one went to a phone", () => {
    const off = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane2Count: "1", lane2Oldest: TIME, phones: "off" });
    expect(paragraphs(off.text)).toEqual([`Lane 2: 1 case waiting longer than 7 days, since ${TIME}.`, "Open the staff console. Phone alerts are switched off on this server, so this email is the only reminder.", LAST_STAFF]);
    expect(off.text).not.toContain("went to");
    linkless(off);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane2Count: "1", lane2Oldest: TIME })).toThrow(/phones/);
  });
});

describe("notice_update: decisions on a person's reports, once a day", () => {
  const POST = "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab";
  const PAGE = "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
  const TERMS = "http://localhost:8081/terms";
  const COURTS = "go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).";
  const REEXAMINE = "You can ask korbat once, within six months and free of charge, to re-examine a moderator's decision to take no action: it is decided again as a new report.";
  const FINAL = "A decision changed on review or by a correction, or given on re-examination, is final within korbat.";
  const line = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateLine> = {}): NoticeUpdateLine => ({
    ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
    item: 1,
    link: POST,
    outcome: outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_legal", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null }),
    reexamination: false,
    changed: false,
    reexaminable: false,
    unseen: false,
    automatic: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const noAction = outcomeWords({ outcome: "no_violation", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
  const update = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateData>): NoticeUpdateData => ({ signedIn: false, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [], ...more });

  test("signed out: one paragraph per line, the page of each notice it has a line for, that nothing was automated, and the courts", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(r.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`,
      "N-ABCDEFGH23, item 2 (http://localhost:8081/u/ada): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.",
      `To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `You can ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // The page link stands at the end of its paragraph, and nothing is an anchor.
    expect(r.text).toMatch(/#t=A{43}$/m);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
  });

  test("signed in: no page link, and the re-examination points to Your reports", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `${REEXAMINE} Use korbat's Settings, Cases, Your reports.`,
      `You can also ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[/]notice[/]|#t=/);
    // A signed-in update never carries a page or a receipt: handed either, it is refused rather than mailed.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }))).toThrow(/signed-in/);
  });

  test("the re-examination sentence goes only with a re-examinable line, and points to the page when signed out", () => {
    const withIt = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`${REEXAMINE} Use the page linked in this email for that report.`);
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`You can also ${COURTS}`);
    const without = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(without.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    expect(paragraphs(without.text)).toContain(`You can ${COURTS}`);
  });

  test("a re-examination's answer and a changed outcome are final within korbat; a line that reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION never is, re-examined again or not", () => {
    const answered = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    expect(answered.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    const changed = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it.", changed: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(changed.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    // An answer given while nobody could open the images does not spend the re-examination, also when it answered one.
    const unseenLine = { outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, unseen: true };
    const open = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(open.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: ${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION}`);
    expect(open.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(open.text).toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // Asked again before a retried mail went out: no longer re-examinable, and still not final.
    const asked = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: false })] }));
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // A line of each kind in one update: each sentence once.
    const both = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true }), line({ item: 2, outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(both.text.split(FINAL).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(both.text.split(REEXAMINE).length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  test("only a link that named nothing is called automatic", () => {
    const dead = outcomeWords({ outcome: "not_available", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, outcome: dead, automatic: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide, except for links found to name nothing on korbat, which were checked automatically.");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("If a link was wrong, send a new report with the right link.");
    const live = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(paragraphs(live.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide.");
    expect(live.text).not.toContain("If a link was wrong");
  });

  test("the outcome's words are the contracts': ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, the scopes, the sealed phrase and UNSEEN_NO_ACTION stand in a line exactly as composed, with one full stop", () => {
    const facts = { rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null } as const;
    const outcomes = [
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "account" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "quote" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true }),
    ];
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: outcomes.map((outcome, index) => line({ item: index + 1, outcome })) }));
    const lines = paragraphs(r.text).slice(0, outcomes.length);
    outcomes.forEach((outcome, index) => expect(lines[index]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item ${index + 1} (${POST}): ${outcome}`));
    for (const sentence of [ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION]) expect(r.text).toContain(sentence);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[.][.]/);
  });

  test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link; an update of receipts alone has another subject and none of the decisions' sentences", () => {
    const receipt = { ref: "N-ZZZZZZZZ77", time: TIME, items: POST, pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB" };
    const alone = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt], termsUrl: TERMS }));
    expect(alone.subject).toBe("korbat received your reports");
    expect(paragraphs(alone.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 at ${TIME}. It names: ${POST}.`,
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB",
      `How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: ${TERMS}.`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // Two folds on one day and a line of another notice: the receipts first, the terms once, then the line and its page.
    const second = { ...receipt, ref: "N-YYYYYYYY66", pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-YYYYYYYY66#t=CCCC" };
    const full = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt, second], termsUrl: TERMS, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(full.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    const out = paragraphs(full.text);
    expect(out.slice(0, 5).map((paragraph) => paragraph.slice(0, 42))).toEqual([
      "korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "korbat received your report N-YYYYYYYY66 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "How korbat handles reports, and what it ke",
    ]);
    expect(full.text.split("How korbat handles reports").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(out[5]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`);
    expect(out[6]).toBe(`To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`);
    // A receipt needs the terms' address, and an update of nothing at all is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt] }))).toThrow(/termsUrl/);
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({}))).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });

  test("it carries only what korbat generated: no member of the data holds a report's words", () => {
    const keys = Object.keys(line()).sort();
    expect(keys).toEqual(["automatic", "changed", "item", "link", "outcome", "reexaminable", "reexamination", "ref", "unseen"]);
  });
});

describe("the mailers take the union of messages", () => {
  test("the memory mailer renders a flat message with renderTemplate and the structured one with renderNoticeUpdate, keeps the two apart, and reads a code only from a flat message", async () => {
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    const structured: MailMessage = { to: "a@b.io", template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [] } };
    // An update of nothing is refused as the real mailer would refuse it, before it counts as sent.
    await expect(mailer.send(structured)).rejects.toThrow(/nothing/);
    expect([mailer.sent.length, mailer.updates.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "111111" } });
    await mailer.send({
      to: "a@b.io",
      template: "notice_update",
      data: { signedIn: true, lines: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", item: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada", outcome: "no action.", reexamination: false, changed: false, reexaminable: false, unseen: false, automatic: false }], receipts: [], pages: [] },
    });
    // The two kinds are kept apart, so a reader of the flat ones never meets a structure.
    expect(mailer.sent.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["sign_in_code"]);
    expect(mailer.updates.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["notice_update"]);
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("a@b.io")).toBe("111111");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.updates[0]!).subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.sent[0]!).subject).toBe("Your korbat sign-in code");
  });

  test("a time in a mail is printed as noticeTime prints it", () => {
    expect(noticeTime(new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.999Z"))).toBe(TIME);
  });
});

describe("3e: the statement mails of a suspension taken at once and of its lift (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat suspended your account for 7 days, from this decision until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC, without notice beforehand.", "The facts: The account posted a threat."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";

  test("suspension_started_at_once: its subject, its lead with the days and the end, the statement's paragraphs, where to read it, and no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "7", endsAt: "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat suspended your account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat suspended your korbat account for 7 days, until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", endsAt: "2026-10-05 09:30 UTC", statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day, until");
    // A termination's lead names no days and no end.
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "terminate", statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat terminated your account");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe("korbat terminated your korbat account. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", statement })).toThrow(/days/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted: a lead for each state of the period, for a lift and for a basis that broke, and none says the account is free of every measure", () => {
    const lead = (why: string, period: string) => {
      const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement });
      expect(paragraphs(r.text).slice(1)).toEqual([...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
      return [r.subject, paragraphs(r.text)[0]];
    };
    expect(lead("lifted", "not_started")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account that it had announced: it never starts."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "running")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "ended")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted a past suspension of your korbat account: it no longer counts toward a later suspension."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "not_started")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account will not start", "korbat reversed a decision that the suspension it announced for your korbat account rested on. The suspension will not start."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "running")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account has ended", "The suspension of your korbat account has ended, because a decision it rested on was reversed. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "ended")).toEqual(["A past suspension of your account no longer counts", "korbat reversed a decision that a past suspension of your account rested on; that suspension no longer counts."]);
    for (const why of ["lifted", "basis"]) {
      for (const period of ["not_started", "running", "ended"]) expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement }).text).not.toMatch(/as before|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    }
    expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "lifted", period: "running", statement }).subject).toBe("korbat lifted the termination of your account");
    // Task 4: a withdrawal needs the withdrawn decision's time; a why the template does not have is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/decidedAt/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "answered", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/why/);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: the mails of an announced measure, of the answer to a reply, of a withdrawal, and of a termination's take-down (design, section 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat will suspend your account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet.", "The facts: The account had 3 active strikes."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";
  const EARLIEST = "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC";

  test("suspension_announced: its subject, its lead with the days, the window and the earliest start, the reply, then the statement; a termination's without days", () => {

  test("reply_answered: a lead for a kept and for a reversed answer, then the answer's statement", () => {

    );
  });

  test("termination_final: the decision's day, that it is final, what is deleted, the sentence on sealed images only when images are sealed, and never that korbat keeps nothing when they are", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "false" });

    expect(() => renderTemplate("termination_final", { imagesSealed: "false" })).toThrow(/decided/);
    // 3f (7.15 step 8): a termination's take-down holds the address as a deletion does, and its mail says so the same way.

      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "2", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", unknown: "0" }],
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "1", unknown: "1" }],
      ["order_corrected", "order_corrected", { count: "2", at: "2026-10-16T08:50:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_unverified", "order_unverified", { count: "1", textsMissing: "1", holdsOpen: "0", oldestAt: "2026-10-15T22:00:00.000Z" }],
    ];
    for (const [template, kind, facts] of cases) {
      const r = mail(template, facts);
      const counted = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? value : Number(value)]));
      const text = renderAlert(kind, counted, new Date(NOW));
      expect(r.subject, template).toBe(`korbat: ${text.title}`);
      expect(paragraphs(r.text), template).toEqual([text.sentence, text.todo, LAST_STAFF]);
      linkless(r);
    }
    expect(paragraphs(mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
    );
    expect(mail("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "0" }).subject).toBe("korbat: 0 minutes left");
  });

  test("3f's review: every kind whose mail is its sentence is one the alert tick mails, and each has its template: Task 5's two daily kinds too", () => {
    expect([...TICK_MAILED_KINDS].sort()).toEqual([...SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS].sort());
    for (const kind of SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "2"]));
      const r = mail(kind as TemplateName, facts);
      expect(r.subject, kind).toBe(`korbat: ${renderAlert(kind, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([n, v]) => [n, isTimeFact(n) ? v : Number(v)])), new Date(NOW)).title}`);
      linkless(r);
    }
  });

  test("they carry counts and UTC times only: a fact of another name, a time that is no time and a missing one are refused, and no handle or address is printed", () => {
    expect(() => mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => mail("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "yesterday" })).toThrow(/since/);
    expect(() => mail("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z", handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/now/);
    for (const template of ["contact_mail", "contact_mail_escalated", "order_due", "mailbox_unreachable", "alert_channel_down", "order_opened", "order_corrected", "order_unverified"] as const) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[template].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "3"]));
      expect(mail(template, facts).text, template).not.toMatch(/@/);
    }
  });
});

});

describe("what leads to the form", () => {
  test("the form's address names the post, the image of a post, or the profile it is opened on, and reads it back", () => {
    expect(reportHref()).toBe("/report");
    expect(reportHref({ post: id(1) })).toBe(`/report?post=${id(1)}`);
    expect(reportHref({ post: id(1), media: id(2) })).toBe(`/report?post=${id(1)}&media=${id(2)}`);
    expect(reportHref({ account: "ada" })).toBe("/report?account=ada");
    expect(givenTarget({ post: id(1) })).toEqual({ kind: "post", id: id(1) });
    expect(givenTarget({ post: id(1), media: id(2) })).toEqual({ kind: "post", id: id(1), mediaId: id(2) });
    expect(givenTarget({ account: "@Ada" })).toEqual({ kind: "account", handle: "ada" });
    // Anything the API would refuse names nothing: the form then asks for a link.
    for (const params of [{}, { post: "nope" }, { account: "a b" }, { media: id(2) }, { post: ["x"] }]) expect(givenTarget(params), JSON.stringify(params)).toBeNull();
  });

  const image = (n: number): MediaView => ({ id: id(n), width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "LEHV6nWB2yk8", alt: `picture ${n}`, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp` });
  const hidden = (n: number): HiddenMedia => ({ id: id(n), hidden: true });
  const post = (n: number, extra: Partial<PostView> = {}): PostView => ({
    id: id(n),
    author: { id: id(900), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", verified: false },
    body: `post number ${n}`,
    createdAt: "2026-10-04T10:00:00.000Z",
    state: "visible",
    replyTo: null,
    counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
    media: [],
    quoteOf: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const me = (userId: string) => ({ status: "signed-in", me: { user: { id: userId, onboarded: true }, profile: { handle: "me" } } });

  test("a post that is not the reader's own has Report in its action row, signed in or out; the reader's own has none", () => {
    for (const state of [{ status: "signed-out" }, me(id(901))]) {
      session.state = state;
      const out = html(<PostCard post={post(1)} />);
      expect(hrefs(out)).toContain(`/report?post=${id(1)}`);
      expect(textOf(out)).toContain("Report");
    }
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const own = html(<PostCard post={post(1)} />);
    expect(hrefs(own).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/report"))).toEqual([]);
    session.state = { status: "signed-out" };
  });

  test("the viewer reports an image on the post that holds it: opened from a post it names that post, and nothing for a hidden image or the reader's own post", () => {
    const noop = () => undefined;
    const media = [image(11), hidden(12)];
    const shown = html(<MediaViewerContent media={media} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} postId={id(2)} />);
    expect(hrefs(shown)).toEqual([`/report?post=${id(2)}&media=${id(11)}`]);
    expect(textOf(shown)).toContain("Report this image");
    // A hidden image has nothing to report by; the post's own Report still names the post.
    expect(hrefs(html(<MediaViewerContent media={media} index={1} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} postId={id(2)} />))).toEqual([]);
    // Without a post to report on (the reader's own post), the viewer offers nothing.
    expect(hrefs(html(<MediaViewerContent media={media} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the grid hands the viewer its post, and a quoted post's images belong to the quoted post", () => {
    const grid = read("components", "social", "MediaGrid.tsx");
    // 3d Task 1: the viewer is also told whether the reader wrote the post, for an image that fails to load.
    expect(grid).toContain("<MediaViewer media={media} index={open} onIndex={setOpen} onClose={() => setOpen(null)} postId={own ? undefined : postId} own={own === true} />");
    const card = read("components", "social", "PostCard.tsx");
    expect(card).toContain("<MediaGrid media={post.media} postId={post.id} own={post.author.id === me} />");
    expect(card).toContain("<MediaGrid media={quote.media} compact postId={quote.id} />");
    // The quote is one link to the quoted post, where the grid and the viewer are: its squares open nothing themselves.
    const quoted = { ...post(2, { media: [image(21)] }), quoteOf: null };
    const out = html(<QuoteEmbed quote={quoted} />);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([`/post/${id(2)}`, "/u/ada"]);
    expect(html(<MediaGrid media={[image(1)]} postId={id(5)} />)).not.toContain("/report");
  });

  test("a profile has Report beside Mute and Block, and signed out too", () => {
    const profile = read("app", "u", "[handle]", "index.tsx");
    // Anyone but the profile's owner is offered it.
    expect(profile).toContain("const report = own ? null : (");
    expect(profile).toContain("<Link href={reportHref({ account: profile.handle })} asChild>");
    // In the row of the signed-in controls, after Block; and alone in their place when they are not shown.
    const row = profile.slice(profile.indexOf("{me && !own && viewer ? ("), profile.indexOf("{!own && !(me && viewer) ?"));
    expect(row.indexOf("Block</Text>")).toBeGreaterThan(row.indexOf("Mute"));
    expect(row.indexOf("{report}")).toBeGreaterThan(row.indexOf("Block</Text>"));
    expect(profile).toContain('{!own && !(me && viewer) ? <View className="mt-3 flex-row">{report}</View> : null}');
  });

  test("the terms page ends with a Contact section built from the build's address, and a link to the form, which needs no account", () => {
    expect(CONTACT_EMAIL).toBe(CONTACT);
    const out = html(<Terms />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(CONTACT_WORDS.body(CONTACT)).toBe(
      "Write to korbat at contact@korbat.local when the report form does not work for you, to ask for your data, or about a decision. A person reads every email. Do not attach images or files: korbat does not open them.",
    );
    expect(text).toContain(`Contact ${CONTACT_WORDS.body(CONTACT)}`);
    expect(text).toContain("Report something on korbat");
    expect(hrefs(out)).toContain("/report");
    // After the terms' own sections, of which it is no part, and before the link to the form.
    expect(TERMS_SECTIONS.map((section) => section.title)).not.toContain("Contact");
    const last = TERMS_SECTIONS.at(-1)!.title;
    expect(text.indexOf(last)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("Contact Write to korbat"));
    expect(text.indexOf("Contact Write to korbat")).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("Report something on korbat"));
    // The form is no settings screen: the settings layout would send a signed-out reader to sign in.
    expect(read("app", "report.tsx")).not.toContain("SettingsNav");
  });
});

describe("the form", () => {
  test("asks what is wrong with three choices of equal weight, each a radio of one group, none chosen at first", () => {
    const out = form();
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("What is wrong with it?");
    const at = Object.values(REPORT_WORDS.grounds).map((label) => text.indexOf(label));
    expect(at.every((index) => index > 0)).toBe(true);
    expect([...at].sort((a, b) => a - b)).toEqual(at);
    expect(withRole(out, "radiogroup")).toHaveLength(1);
    const radios = withRole(out, "radio");
    expect(radios).toHaveLength(3);
    for (const radio of radios) expect(radio).toContain('aria-checked="false"');
    // Nothing of a ground shows before one is chosen, and nothing can be sent.
    for (const words of [REPORT_WORDS.whichRule, REPORT_WORDS.whyIllegal, REPORT_WORDS.which, REPORT_WORDS.anonymous]) expect(text).not.toContain(words);
    expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.missing.ground);
  });

  test("the rule ground lists the rules that can be reported, each with its title and one line, R2 replaced by the pointer to the third answer, and an optional note", () => {
    const out = form({ initial: { ground: "rule" } });
    const text = textOf(out);
    for (const ruleId of REPORT_RULE_IDS) {
      const rule = RULES.find((entry) => entry.id === ruleId)!;
      expect(text, ruleId).toContain(`${rule.id}: ${rule.title}`);
      expect(text, ruleId).toContain(ruleLine(rule));
    }
    const r2 = RULES.find((entry) => entry.id === "R2")!;
    expect(text).not.toContain(r2.title);
    expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.r2Instead);
    // In R2's place: after R1 and before R3.
    expect(text.indexOf(REPORT_WORDS.r2Instead)).toBeGreaterThan(text.indexOf("R1: "));
    expect(text.indexOf(REPORT_WORDS.r2Instead)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("R3: "));
    expect(fields(out)).toEqual([REPORT_WORDS.explanation]);
    expect(out.toLowerCase()).toContain(`maxlength="${NOTICE_LIMITS.explanationMax}"`);
    expect(ruleLine({ text: "One sentence. And another." })).toBe("One sentence.");
    expect(ruleLine({ text: "Only one" })).toBe("Only one");
  });

  test("the illegal ground asks for the category, not sure by default, points to the third answer directly below it, and asks why, the law, a rule and good faith", () => {
    const out = form({ initial: { ground: "illegal" } });
    const text = textOf(out);
    const categories = [REPORT_WORDS.categoryNotSure, ...TDB_FORM_CATEGORIES.map((category) => CATEGORY_LABELS[category])];
    for (const label of categories) expect(text, label).toContain(label);
    const checked = withRole(out, "radio").filter((tag) => tag.includes('aria-checked="true"'));
    // The ground itself, "I am not sure", and no rule beside the law.
    expect(checked).toHaveLength(3);
    // The pointer stands directly below the categories: after the last of them and before the next field.
    const pointer = text.indexOf(REPORT_WORDS.csamInstead);
    expect(pointer).toBeGreaterThan(Math.max(...categories.map((label) => text.indexOf(label))));
    expect(pointer).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf(REPORT_WORDS.citedLaw));
    expect(fields(out)).toEqual([REPORT_WORDS.citedLaw, REPORT_WORDS.whyIllegal]);
    // A rule it also breaks: every rule but R2, and none.
    expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.alsoRule);
    for (const ruleId of REPORT_RULE_IDS) expect(text).toContain(`${ruleId}: `);
    expect(text).not.toContain("R2: ");
    const box = withRole(out, "checkbox");
    expect(box).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(box[0]).toContain('aria-checked="false"');
    expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.bonaFide);
  });

  test("the anonymous path asks which it is, says that nobody is recorded, and asks for neither a name nor an email, signed in or out", () => {
    for (const signedIn of [true, false]) {
      const out = form({ signedIn, initial: { ground: "csam" } });
      const text = textOf(out);
      for (const label of Object.values(REPORT_WORDS.keywords)) expect(text).toContain(label);
      expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.anonymous);
      expect(fields(out)).toEqual([REPORT_WORDS.csamExplanation]);
      expect(text).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.contactHint);
      // Good faith may be stated, and is not asked for.
      expect(withRole(out, "checkbox")).toHaveLength(1);
      // The privacy line leaves out who sees the sender: this path records none.
      expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.privacy.use);
      expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.privacy.access);
      expect(text).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.privacy.sender);
    }
    // On the other grounds the line is whole.
    expect(textOf(form({ initial: { ground: "rule" } }))).toContain(`${REPORT_WORDS.privacy.use} ${REPORT_WORDS.privacy.sender} ${REPORT_WORDS.privacy.access}`);
  });

  test("on the anonymous path, for images, a report that names only a profile is asked for the post or the image, and never refused", () => {
    const images = (keyword: ReportDraft["keyword"], extra: Partial<ReportDraft> = {}) => draft({ ground: "csam", keyword, ...extra });
    expect(profileOnly(images("csam"), PROFILE)).toBe(true);
    expect(profileOnly(images("deepfake"), PROFILE)).toBe(true);
    // Not for grooming or other abuse, which are not about an image; not on another ground; not with a post beside it.
    expect(profileOnly(images("grooming"), PROFILE)).toBe(false);
    expect(profileOnly(images("abuse"), PROFILE)).toBe(false);
    expect(profileOnly(draft({ ground: "illegal", keyword: "csam" }), PROFILE)).toBe(false);
    expect(profileOnly(images("csam"), POST)).toBe(false);
    expect(profileOnly(images("csam", { others: ["http://localhost:8081/post/" + id(2)] }), PROFILE)).toBe(false);
    // A typed link to a profile is a profile too.
    expect(profileOnly(images("csam", { link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" }), null)).toBe(true);
    expect(profileOnly(images("csam", { link: "http://localhost:8081/post/" + id(2) }), null)).toBe(false);

    const out = form({ given: PROFILE, initial: { ground: "csam", keyword: "csam" } });
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.profileOnly);
    // It can still be sent: the sentence asks, it does not refuse.
    const sent = noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "csam", keyword: "csam" }), PROFILE, { signedIn: true, turnstileToken: null });
    expect(sent).toEqual({ request: { ground: "csam", targets: [PROFILE], keyword: "csam" } });
    expect(textOf(form({ given: PROFILE, initial: { ground: "csam", keyword: "grooming" } }))).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.profileOnly);
    expect(textOf(form({ given: PROFILE, initial: { ground: "rule" } }))).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.profileOnly);
  });

  test("on the anonymous path a report names one profile at most: with a second the form says so before anything is sent", () => {
    const second = draft({ ground: "csam", keyword: "grooming", others: ["http://localhost:8081/u/bob"] });
    expect(profilesNamed(draftTargets(second, PROFILE))).toBe(2);
    expect(tooManyProfiles(second, PROFILE)).toBe(true);
    expect(noticeFrom(second, PROFILE, { signedIn: true, turnstileToken: null })).toEqual({ problem: REPORT_WORDS.oneProfile });
    expect(textOf(form({ given: PROFILE, initial: second }))).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.oneProfile);
    // The same profile named twice is one profile, a post beside it is no profile, and other grounds have no such limit.
    expect(tooManyProfiles(draft({ ground: "csam", keyword: "csam", others: ["http://localhost:8081/u/ADA", "http://localhost:8081/post/" + id(2)] }), PROFILE)).toBe(false);
    expect(tooManyProfiles({ ...second, ground: "rule" }, PROFILE)).toBe(false);
    expect(textOf(form({ given: PROFILE, initial: { ...second, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R6" } }))).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.oneProfile);
  });

  test("signed out, the illegal ground asks for an optional name and email, and every ground shows the human check with its sentence; signed in, none of it", () => {
    for (const ground of ["rule", "illegal", "csam"] as const) {
      const out = form({ signedIn: false, initial: { ground } });
      expect(out, ground).toContain('data-turnstile="widget"');
      expect(textOf(out), ground).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.turnstile);
      const signedIn = form({ signedIn: true, initial: { ground } });
      expect(signedIn, ground).not.toContain("data-turnstile");
      expect(textOf(signedIn), ground).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.turnstile);
      expect(fields(signedIn), ground).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.email);
    }
    const illegal = form({ signedIn: false, initial: { ground: "illegal" } });
    expect(fields(illegal)).toEqual([REPORT_WORDS.citedLaw, REPORT_WORDS.whyIllegal, REPORT_WORDS.name, REPORT_WORDS.email]);
    expect(textOf(illegal)).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.contactHint);
    expect(fields(form({ signedIn: false, initial: { ground: "rule" } }))).toEqual([REPORT_WORDS.explanation]);
    // Before a ground is chosen the check is there already: it takes a moment to pass.
    expect(form({ signedIn: false })).toContain('data-turnstile="widget"');
  });

  test("opened without an item, the form starts with one required field for the link; opened on one, it shows what is reported; other items take up to nine more links", () => {
    const bare = form({ given: null });
    expect(fields(bare)[0]).toBe(REPORT_WORDS.link);
    expect(textOf(bare)).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.otherItems);
    expect(textOf(bare)).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.otherItemsHint);
    const onPost = form({ given: { kind: "post", id: id(1), mediaId: id(2) } });
    expect(fields(onPost)).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.link);
    expect(hrefs(onPost)).toContain(`/post/${id(1)}`);
    expect(hrefs(form({ given: PROFILE }))).toContain("/u/ada");
    // Each added link is a field of its own; at nine there is no way to add a tenth.
    const nine = form({ initial: { others: Array.from({ length: OTHER_LINKS_MAX }, () => "") } });
    expect(fields(nine).filter((label) => label.startsWith("Link "))).toHaveLength(9);
    expect(textOf(nine)).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.addLink);
    expect(textOf(form({ initial: { others: [""] } }))).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.addLink);
  });

  test("the screen opens the form on what its address names, signed in or out, and without an item when it names none", () => {
    session.state = { status: "signed-out" };
    route.params = { post: id(1), media: id(2) };
    const onImage = html(<Report />);
    expect(hrefs(onImage)).toContain(`/post/${id(1)}`);
    expect(onImage).toContain('data-turnstile="widget"');
    route.params = { account: "ada" };
    expect(hrefs(html(<Report />))).toContain("/u/ada");
    route.params = {};
    expect(fields(html(<Report />))[0]).toBe(REPORT_WORDS.link);
    session.state = { status: "signed-in", me: { user: { id: id(901), onboarded: true }, profile: { handle: "me" } } };
    expect(html(<Report />)).not.toContain("data-turnstile");
    session.state = { status: "signed-out" };
  });
});

describe("what the form sends", () => {
  const signedIn = { signedIn: true, turnstileToken: null };
  const signedOut = { signedIn: false, turnstileToken: "token" };

  test("says what is missing, one thing at a time, and sends nothing until it is all there", () => {
    const missing = REPORT_WORDS.missing;
    expect(noticeFrom(draft(), POST, signedIn)).toEqual({ problem: missing.ground });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "rule" }), null, signedIn)).toEqual({ problem: missing.link });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "rule", link: "korbat.example/post/1" }), null, signedIn)).toEqual({ problem: missing.linkInvalid });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "rule" }), POST, signedIn)).toEqual({ problem: missing.rule });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "illegal" }), POST, signedIn)).toEqual({ problem: missing.whyIllegal });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "illegal", explanation: "It is a threat." }), POST, signedIn)).toEqual({ problem: missing.bonaFide });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "csam" }), POST, signedIn)).toEqual({ problem: missing.keyword });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R3" }), POST, { signedIn: false, turnstileToken: null })).toEqual({ problem: missing.human });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "illegal", explanation: "x", bonaFide: true, email: "not an address" }), POST, signedOut)).toEqual({ problem: missing.details });
  });

  test("a rule report, a notice of illegality and an anonymous report, each in the contracts' shape for its sender", () => {
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R3", explanation: "  look at the second line  " }), POST, signedIn)).toEqual({
      request: { ground: "rule", ruleId: "R3", targets: [POST], explanation: "look at the second line" },
    });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", link: " http://localhost:8081/post/x ", others: ["", "http://localhost:8081/u/bob"] }), null, signedOut)).toEqual({
      request: { ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", targets: [{ kind: "link", url: "http://localhost:8081/post/x" }, { kind: "link", url: "http://localhost:8081/u/bob" }], turnstileToken: "token" },
    });
    const illegal = draft({ ground: "illegal", explanation: "It is a threat.", bonaFide: true, citedLaw: "Section 241", ruleId: "R5", name: "Ada", email: "ada@korbat.local", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE" });
    expect(noticeFrom(illegal, PROFILE, signedOut)).toEqual({
      request: { ground: "illegal", targets: [PROFILE], category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE", citedLaw: "Section 241", explanation: "It is a threat.", bonaFide: true, ruleId: "R5", name: "Ada", email: "ada@korbat.local", turnstileToken: "token" },
    });
    // Signed in, the contact is the account: a name or an address typed earlier is never sent.
    expect(noticeFrom(illegal, PROFILE, signedIn)).toEqual({
      request: { ground: "illegal", targets: [PROFILE], category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE", citedLaw: "Section 241", explanation: "It is a threat.", bonaFide: true, ruleId: "R5" },
    });
    // The anonymous path sends neither, whatever the draft holds, and good faith only when it was stated.
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "csam", keyword: "deepfake", name: "Ada", email: "ada@korbat.local", ruleId: "R1" }), POST, signedOut)).toEqual({
      request: { ground: "csam", targets: [POST], keyword: "deepfake", turnstileToken: "token" },
    });
    expect(noticeFrom(draft({ ground: "csam", keyword: "abuse", bonaFide: true, explanation: "seen today" }), POST, signedIn)).toEqual({
      request: { ground: "csam", targets: [POST], keyword: "abuse", explanation: "seen today", bonaFide: true },
    });
  });

  test("the form posts the request once, resets the human check after a failure, and shows the answer's screen", () => {
    const source = read("components", "moderation", "ReportForm.tsx");
    expect(source).toContain("const answer = await moderation.send(built.request);");
    expect(source).toContain("turnstile.current?.reset();");
    expect(source).toContain('setError(reportFailure(err, draft.ground === "csam"));');
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain('send: (request: NoticeRequest) => api("/api/notices", { json: request, schema: NoticeResponse })');
  });
});

describe("after sending", () => {
  const TOKEN = "t".repeat(43);

  test("signed out, the screen shows the reference and the link to keep, its token in the fragment, with a Copy button", () => {
    const out = html(<ReportSent answer={{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", token: TOKEN }} signedIn={false} origin="http://localhost:8081" />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("N-ABCDEFGH23");
    expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.keepLink);
    expect(statusLink("http://localhost:8081", "N-ABCDEFGH23", TOKEN)).toBe(`http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=${TOKEN}`);
    expect(text).toContain(`http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=${TOKEN}`);
    // The token is never part of a query, which a server would be sent and would log.
    expect(out).not.toContain(`?t=${TOKEN}`);
    expect(withRole(out, "button").some((tag) => tag.includes(REPORT_WORDS.copy)) || text.includes(REPORT_WORDS.copy)).toBe(true);
    expect(text).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.followInSettings);
  });

  test("signed in, a report on a rule or on the law is followed under Settings, Cases, Your reports, and no link is shown", () => {
    const out = html(<ReportSent answer={{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23" }} signedIn origin="http://localhost:8081" />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.followInSettings);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toContain("/settings/cases?tab=reports");
    expect(text).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.keepLink);
    expect(text).not.toContain("/notice/");
  });

  test("signed in, an anonymous report shows the link and not the Settings sentence: korbat recorded no account for it", () => {
    const out = html(<ReportSent answer={{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", token: TOKEN }} signedIn origin="http://localhost:8081" />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(REPORT_WORDS.keepLink);
    expect(text).toContain(`/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=${TOKEN}`);
    expect(text).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.followInSettings);
    expect(hrefs(out).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings"))).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("a send that fails", () => {
  const failed = (code: string, retryAfter?: number) => new ApiError(code === "rate_limited" ? 429 : 403, code, "the server's own words", retryAfter);

  test("the human check, the limits and an API that cannot take reports each get the form's own sentence, naming the build's contact address", () => {
    expect(reportFailure(failed("human_check_failed"), false)).toBe(REPORT_WORDS.humanCheckFailed(CONTACT));
    expect(reportFailure(failed("rate_limited", 1200), false)).toBe(REPORT_WORDS.rateLimited("20 minutes", CONTACT));
    expect(reportFailure(failed("service_unavailable"), false)).toBe(REPORT_WORDS.unavailable(CONTACT));
    for (const code of ["human_check_failed", "rate_limited", "service_unavailable"]) expect(reportFailure(failed(code, 60), false), code).toContain("contact@korbat.local");
  });

  test("the wait is worded in minutes under an hour and in hours otherwise", () => {
    expect([waitWords(1), waitWords(60), waitWords(61), waitWords(3599), waitWords(3600), waitWords(3601), waitWords(20 * 3600), waitWords(undefined)]).toEqual([
      "1 minute",
      "1 minute",
      "2 minutes",
      "60 minutes",
      "1 hour",
      "2 hours",
      "20 hours",
      "1 hour",
    ]);
  });

  test("on the anonymous path each is followed by what an email gives away", () => {
    for (const code of ["human_check_failed", "rate_limited", "service_unavailable"]) {
      const words = reportFailure(failed(code, 60), true);
      expect(words.endsWith(` ${REPORT_WORDS.mailShowsAddress}`), code).toBe(true);
      expect(reportFailure(failed(code, 60), false), code).not.toContain(REPORT_WORDS.mailShowsAddress);
    }
  });

  test("any other failure shows the server's message, as everywhere in the app", () => {
    expect(reportFailure(failed("already_reported"), false)).toBe("the server's own words");
    expect(reportFailure(failed("already_reported"), true)).toBe("the server's own words");
    expect(reportFailure(new Error("boom"), false)).toBe("Something went wrong. Try again.");
  });
});

describe("the build's contact address", () => {
  const repo = (...parts: string[]) => readFileSync(path.join(REPO, ...parts), "utf8");

  test("the app reads it from the build, and both example files carry the development value", () => {
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain('export const CONTACT_EMAIL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL ?? "";');
    expect(repo("infra", ".env.example")).toMatch(/^WEB_CONTACT_EMAIL=contact@korbat\.local$/m);
    expect(repo("apps", "app", ".env.example")).toMatch(/^EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL=contact@korbat\.local$/m);
  });

  test("the compose service requires it, and the web image takes it as a build argument, refuses what is no address, refuses a placeholder domain in production, and passes it to the export", () => {
    expect(repo("infra", "compose.yml")).toContain("EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL: ${WEB_CONTACT_EMAIL:?set WEB_CONTACT_EMAIL in infra/.env}");
    const dockerfile = repo("infra", "caddy", "Dockerfile");
    expect(dockerfile).toContain("ARG EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL");
    expect(dockerfile).toContain('RUN case "$EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL" in *?@?*.?*) ;; *) echo "the EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL build argument must be an email address" >&2; exit 1;; esac');
    expect(dockerfile).toContain(
      'RUN if [ "$KORBAT_ENV" = "production" ]; then case "$(printf %s "${EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL##*@}" | tr A-Z a-z)" in *.local|*.localhost|*.test|*.invalid|*.example|example.com|example.org|example.net) echo "EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL is a placeholder address; a production build needs the address people can write to" >&2; exit 1;; esac; fi',
    );
    expect(dockerfile).toContain(
      'RUN cd apps/app && EXPO_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY="$EXPO_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY" EXPO_PUBLIC_BADGE="$EXPO_PUBLIC_BADGE" EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL="$EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL" EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_POINT="$EXPO_PUBLIC_CONTACT_POINT" EXPO_PUBLIC_HOME_STATE="$EXPO_PUBLIC_HOME_STATE" npx expo export --platform web',
    );
    // The refusals come before the export, and the production one after KORBAT_ENV is declared.
    expect(dockerfile.indexOf("ARG KORBAT_ENV")).toBeLessThan(dockerfile.indexOf("is a placeholder address"));
    expect(dockerfile.indexOf("is a placeholder address")).toBeLessThan(dockerfile.indexOf("npx expo export"));
  });
});

 */
const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;

describe("an appeal's and a re-examination's request", () => {

    expect(STATEMENT_MAX).toBe(2000);

    for (const schema of [AppealRequest, ReexamineRequest]) {
      expect(schema.parse({})).toEqual({});
      expect(schema.parse({ statement: "Line one.\nLine two." })).toEqual({ statement: "Line one.\nLine two." });
      expect(schema.safeParse({ statement: "x".repeat(STATEMENT_MAX) }).success).toBe(true);
      expect(schema.safeParse({ statement: "x".repeat(STATEMENT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(false);
      // Nothing is trimmed, changed or dropped: an empty text, a control character and an unknown member are refused.
      for (const statement of ["", "   ", `a${String.fromCharCode(0)}b`, `a${String.fromCharCode(0x202e)}b`]) expect(schema.safeParse({ statement }).success, JSON.stringify(statement)).toBe(false);
      expect(schema.safeParse({ statement: "x", decisionId: id(1) }).success).toBe(false);
      expect(schema.safeParse({ statement: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
    }
  });

    expect(NoticeReexamineRequest.parse({ ...request, position: 20, statement: "Look again." })).toEqual({ ...request, position: 20, statement: "Look again." });
    for (const position of [0, 21, 1.5, "1"]) expect(NoticeReexamineRequest.safeParse({ ...request, position }).success, String(position)).toBe(false);
    for (const broken of [{ ...request, ref: "nope" }, { ...request, token: undefined }, { ...request, itemId: id(1) }, { ref: request.ref, position: 1 }]) {
      expect(NoticeReexamineRequest.safeParse(broken).success, JSON.stringify(broken)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("the answer names the positions that are examined again: one, or two with the item korbat added for a quoted post", () => {
    expect(ReexamineResponse.parse({ positions: [1] })).toEqual({ positions: [1] });
    expect(ReexamineResponse.parse({ positions: [1, 11] })).toEqual({ positions: [1, 11] });
    for (const positions of [[], [1, 11, 2], [0], [21]]) expect(ReexamineResponse.safeParse({ positions }).success, JSON.stringify(positions)).toBe(false);
  });
});

    expect(AppealReviewRequest.safeParse({ ...params, outcome: "restricted", stepUp }).success).toBe(false);

 * reads, the closed lists, the alert kinds with their legs, and the fixed texts of a push and of 3f's staff mails, which
 * carry counts and UTC times only (invariant 15).
 */

      itemsPerAction: 10,
      decisionsPerDay: 50,
      recordsPerDay: 20,
      holdDays: 43,
      holdExtensionDays: 42,
      holdWarningDays: 7,
      unconfirmedHoldHours: null,
      preserveMonths: 6,
      preserveMarginDays: 1,

      messageKeepDays: 30,
      recordKeepYears: 3,
      gapKeepMonths: 12,
    });
  });

  test("a hold with its one extension ends before the preservation does: hold_days + hold_extension_days days are fewer than preserve_months months", () => {
    // The shortest run of preserve_months calendar months has this many days (February in a common year among them).

    expect(ORDER_RULES.holdDays + ORDER_RULES.holdExtensionDays).toBeLessThan(shortestMonths);
  });

  });

  });

    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {

      // A kind of 3f has a line of what to do exactly when its mail is its sentence; 3c's and 3e's keep their own mails.
      expect(ALERT_TEXTS[kind].todo !== null, kind).toBe(k.mail === "sentence");
    }
    expect(ALERT_KIND_LIST.filter((kind) => ALERT_KINDS[kind].mail === "own")).toEqual(["moderation_urgent", "moderation_waiting", "moderation_burst", "moderation_reads", "moderation_reveal", "moderation_csam_lifted"]);
  });

  const now = new Date("2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z");

  const factsOf = (kind: AlertKind, n: number, time: string, over: Partial<Record<string, number | string | undefined>> = {}): AlertFacts => {
    const facts: Record<string, number | string> = {};
    for (const name of ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts) facts[name] = isTimeFact(name) ? time : n;
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(over)) {
      if (!ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.includes(name)) continue;
      if (value === undefined) delete facts[name];
      else facts[name] = value;
    }
    return facts;
  };
  const DIGITS = /[0-9]/g;
  const all = (kind: AlertKind, facts: AlertFacts) => {
    const r = renderAlert(kind, facts, now);
    return [r.title, r.sentence, r.todo ?? ""].join(" | ");
  };

  test("rendered with two sets of facts, every kind's title, sentence and line differ only in their digits", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {
      // The flags of order_effected and order_opened chose a variant: both sets hold the same flags.
      const flags = { urgent: 0, unknown: 0 };
      const first = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 3, "2026-10-16T07:05:00.000Z", flags));
      const second = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 1234, "2026-10-16T22:49:59.999Z", flags));
      expect(first.replace(DIGITS, ""), kind).toBe(second.replace(DIGITS, ""));
      expect(first, kind).not.toBe(second);
    }
  });

      expect(words, kind).not.toContain("@");
      expect(words.toLowerCase(), kind).not.toContain("http");
      for (const name of alertPlaceholders(kind)) {
        expect([...ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts, ...Object.keys(ORDER_RULES), ...Object.keys(QUARANTINE_RULES)], `${kind}: {${name}}`).toContain(name);
      }

      // window is 3c's own number, which its push names as its mail does.
      if (ALERT_KINDS[kind].mail !== "own") expect(words.replace(/[{][a-zA-Z]+[}]/g, ""), kind).not.toMatch(DIGITS);
    }
  });

  test("a time prints as 14:05 UTC, with the day when it is not the day of the alert", () => {

    expect(alertTime("2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z", now)).toBe("2026-10-17 00:00 UTC");

      todo: `Read it in the mail host's app, never in korbat, and with it every other new message there: further mail within ${ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes} minutes raises no alarm of its own. Then open Contact point in the staff console. What ends this message's alarms is handling it there: opening an order from it, or closing it.`,
    });
    // A restart of an order's clock has no time of receipt.

    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Nobody has answered: mail at the contact point",
      sentence: "Nobody has answered the mail that arrived at the authorities' contact point at 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
      todo: "This went to every staff phone. Whoever reads it first acts, and tells the others.",
    });

    expect(due.title).toBe("15 minutes left");

    expect(due.todo).toBe(

    );

    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Phone alerts are down",

      todo: `Until it is repaired, korbat wakes nobody: the mail host's own app on the on-call phone, signed in to the contact-point mailbox and allowed to ring at night, is the only thing that does. Check now that it is. An order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed". The operator restarts the notify and ntfy services.`,
    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({ title: "Daily test", sentence: "Daily test, 08:00 UTC. If you read this on your phone, alerts reach it. Nothing to do.", todo: null });
  });

    expect(renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: 4 }, now).sentence).toBe("4 cases or replies are waiting longer than their response time.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_burst", { count: 20 }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account confirmed 20 decisions in 15 minutes. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_reads", { limit: 200 }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account opened 200 different cases today. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_reveal", { at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe("One staff account revealed who sent a report, at 08:59 UTC. The staff mail says which.");
    expect(renderAlert("moderation_csam_lifted", { at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Reported images are no longer protected",
      sentence: "A decision at 08:59 UTC ended the protection of reported images. Read the staff mail.",
      todo: null,
    });
  });

  test("the variants a fact chooses: an order given effect as urgent, with items still open; the counts of what an order misses", () => {
    expect(renderAlert("order_effected", { items: 3, at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", itemsOpen: 0, urgent: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was given effect at 08:59 UTC: 3 posts disabled.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_effected", { items: 2, at: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", itemsOpen: 1, urgent: 1 }, now).sentence).toBe(
      "An order that is not verified was given effect as urgent at 08:59 UTC: 2 posts disabled. 1 items of the order are still open.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 2, dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:30:00.000Z", unknown: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 2 items. Due 09:30 UTC.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 1, unknown: 0 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 1 items. No deadline runs.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_opened", { items: 1, unknown: 1 }, now).sentence).toBe("An order was opened: 1 items. Its deadline is unknown: act now.");
    expect(renderAlert("order_unverified", { count: 1, textsMissing: 0, holdsOpen: 2, oldestAt: "2026-10-14T08:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(

    expect(renderAlert("hold_ending", { count: 2, at: "2026-10-20T00:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(`2 held notices are released within ${ORDER_RULES.holdWarningDays} days, the first on 2026-10-20 00:00 UTC.`);
    expect(renderAlert("report_owed", { count: 1, oldestAt: "2026-10-14T08:00:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe(

    );
  });

  test("a fact that is missing, of another kind, or a string that is no time is refused", () => {
    expect(() => renderAlert("contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: 1, handle: 7 }, now)).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("alert_test", { at: "mod_anna" }, now)).toThrow(/at/);
    expect(() => renderAlert("moderation_waiting", { count: "4" }, now)).toThrow(/count/);

 * Each table is the one place its words are written: the mails, the status page, the app's list and the console take

describe("the outcome phrases", () => {

      not_evident:
        "no action: korbat found no breach of its rules, and whether it is illegal cannot be seen without a detailed legal examination; a court or an authority can order its removal",
      not_available: "no action: the link names nothing korbat can show (checked automatically)",

    );
    expect(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE).toBe(
      "This answer concerns the account's display name and bio and, taken together, the images on its posts. korbat decides about single posts of the account, and about what its posts say, in cases of their own and does not report those here.",
    );
    expect(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES).toEqual({

    expect(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION).toBe(

});

  });
});

    for (const ruleId of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId }).success, ruleId).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.parse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).target).toEqual({ kind: "account", handle: "some_one" });
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "link", url: "https://korbat.example/post/" + POST } }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("it has no other ground than a rule: a finding never alleges illegality and never goes the path that records no sender", () => {
    for (const ground of ["illegal", "csam", "order", "law", ""]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ground }).success, ground).toBe(false);
    const { ground: _ground, ...withoutGround } = finding;
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse(withoutGround).success).toBe(false);
    // The members of the other grounds are refused, never ignored.
    for (const extra of [{ explanation: "words" }, { bonaFide: true }, { citedLaw: "a law" }, { keyword: "csam" }, { name: "A" }, { email: "a@b.example" }, { turnstileToken: "t" }]) {

    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: null }).success).toBe(false);

    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toHaveLength(TDB_CATEGORIES.length - 1);

describe("a saved text", () => {
  const save = { kind: "note", text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion", salt: HEX, digest: HEX };

  test("is of one of the seven kinds, the recorded choice not to seal among them, with a 32-byte salt and a digest in lower-case hex", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_KINDS).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason", "reveal_reason", "note", "seal_declined"]);
    for (const kind of STAFF_TEXT_KINDS) expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind: "statement" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [HEX.toUpperCase(), HEX.slice(2), `${HEX}00`, "", "g".repeat(64)]) {
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, salt: bad }).success, `salt ${bad}`).toBe(false);
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, digest: bad }).success, `digest ${bad}`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, caseId: CASE }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the request's schema lets any text through: what a text must be is the route's to refuse, with a code of its own", () => {
    // A text that is too long or holds a control character is answered text_invalid, not invalid_request.
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: "x".repeat(STAFF_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: `a${String.fromCharCode(7)}b` }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("staffTextProblem: a well-formed text of at most 5000 UTF-16 units, with no control character but the line feed and no invisible direction or zero-width character", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_MAX).toBe(5000);
    const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
    expect(staffTextProblem(`two${LF}lines`)).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("")).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5000))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5001))).toBe("too_long");
    // An emoji is two units: 2500 of them fit, and one more unit does not.
    const emoji = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(staffTextProblem(emoji.repeat(2500))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`${emoji.repeat(2500)}x`)).toBe("too_long");
    // Half of a surrogate pair has no UTF-8 bytes.
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xd83d)}b`)).toBe("malformed");
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xde00)}`)).toBe("malformed");
    // NUL and every other C0 control but the line feed.
    for (let code = 0; code < 32; code++) {
      expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe(code === 10 ? null : "control");
    }
    // The invisible direction and spacing characters the notice texts refuse too; the joiners scripts and emoji need stay.
    for (const code of [0x202a, 0x202e, 0x2066, 0x2069, 0x200b, 0x2060, 0xfeff]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe("format");
    for (const code of [0x200c, 0x200d]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`r${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}sum${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the answers: the stored text's id and digest, the person's own drafts with their salts, and a snapshot's id and digest, never content", () => {
    expect(StaffTextSaved.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX })).toEqual({ id: CASE, digest: HEX });
    const draft = { id: CASE, kind: "facts", text: "The post names a home address.", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME };
    expect(StaffTextsResponse.parse({ texts: [draft] }).texts).toEqual([draft]);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffSnapshotTaken.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX, body: "content", media: [] }))).toEqual(["id", "digest"]);
  });
});
