    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, target: { type: "post", id: POST, link: `https://korbat.example/post/${POST}`, authorHandle: null, state: null, level: null } }).success).toBe(true);
  });


  test("3e: a post case carries whether a strike is due and the author's standing in bands; an account case the account's standing", () => {
    for (const why of ["due", "already_struck", "before_last_strike"] as const) expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, strikeDue: { due: why === "due", why } }).success, why).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, strikeDue: { due: true, why: "maybe" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, authorStanding: { activeStrikes: "3", suspensionsInYear: "0", now: "none" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, authorStanding: { activeStrikes: "3_or_more", suspensionsInYear: "2_or_more", now: "terminated" } }).success).toBe(true);
    const standing = {
      activeStrikes: 3,
      strikes: [{ decisionId: OTHER, caseId: CASE, ruleId: "R3", decidedAt: TIME, countsUntil: TIME }],
      ladderRule: "R3",
      suspensionsInYear: 0,
      lastSuspendedOn: null,
      maxDays: 3,
      mayTerminate: false,
      live: false,
      openReports: true,
      atOnce: ["threat"],
      flood: { posts: 2, from: TIME, to: TIME },
      seal: { decidedOn: "2026-10-01" },
      snapshotHandleRetired: false,
      // 3e Task 3: the decision each ground of a suspension at once would rest on now, by its time.
      basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME, terrorist: null, protective: TIME },
      // 3e Task 5: the account's record of reporting, in reports.
      reporting: { reports: 0, unfounded: 0, warnedOn: null, warnedAt: null, marksSince: null, mayWarn: false, mayRestrict: false, restrictedUntil: null, marked: [] },
    };
    const account = { ...view, target: { type: "account", id: POST, handle: "now_named", displayName: "A name", bio: "A bio", deleted: false }, suspicion: null, snapshots: [], items: [], decisions: [], strikeDue: null, authorStanding: null, standing };
    expect(CaseView.parse(account).standing).toEqual(standing);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, maxDays: 31 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, atOnce: ["ladder"] } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
    // A decision says which standing measures rest on it, when any does; older answers carry no such member.
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) {
      expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }]);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "spam" }] }] }).success).toBe(false);
    }
    // Each member is always there: on the other kind of case it is null.
    const { standing: _standing, ...without } = account;
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(without).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3e: a ledger row carries its days, whether it is announced, its basis, what it rests on, its earliest start, its end of counting and its period", () => {
    const action = view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!;
    const strike = { ...action, kind: "strike", sealed: null, countsUntil: TIME };
    const suspend = { ...action, kind: "suspend", sealed: null, days: 3, announced: true, basis: "strikes", restsOn: [OTHER], earliestStart: TIME, period: { startsAt: null, endsAt: null, state: "unfixed" } };
    for (const row of [strike, suspend]) expect(CaseDecisionAction.parse(row)).toEqual(row);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, basis: "ladder" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, period: { ...suspend.period, state: "paused" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, days: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
    const { period: _period, ...withoutPeriod } = suspend;
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse(withoutPeriod).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3e Task 5: each item says whether it can be marked and whether its mark counts or was withdrawn; an account case carries its record of reporting in reports, by reference and never by person", () => {
    const item = view.items[0]!;
    for (const member of ["markable", "unfounded", "markWithdrawn"] as const) {
      const { [member]: _gone, ...without } = item;
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [without] }).success, member).toBe(false);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, [member]: null }] }).success, member).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, markable: true, unfounded: true }] }).items[0]).toMatchObject({ markable: true, unfounded: true, markWithdrawn: false });
    const reporting = {
      reports: 8,
      unfounded: 5,
      warnedOn: "2026-09-01",
      warnedAt: TIME,
      marksSince: 2,
      mayWarn: false,
      mayRestrict: false,
      restrictedUntil: null,
      marked: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGHIJ", position: 2, sentOn: "2026-08-30", markedOn: "2026-08-31", sinceWarning: false }],
    };
    const parsed = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting.parse(reporting);
    expect(parsed).toEqual(reporting);
    const Reporting = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting;
    // A marked report is named by its reference and the item's place in it, never by who sent it.
    expect(Object.keys(Reporting.shape.marked.element.shape).sort()).toEqual(["markedOn", "position", "ref", "sentOn", "sinceWarning"]);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, marked: [{ ...reporting.marked[0], ref: "someone" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, unfounded: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, restrictedUntil: "2026-10-01" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A restriction of reporting rests on its warning: the warning's decision says so, for [review.warning].
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }]);
  });

  test("a withheld snapshot carries its id, time and digest and no content, whatever the answer held", () => {
    const withheld = CaseSnapshot.parse({ ...shown, withheld: true });
    expect(Object.keys(withheld).sort()).toEqual(["digest", "id", "takenAt", "withheld"]);
  });

  test("a snapshot that is shown carries everything its digest covers: the console recomputes the digest from the answer", async () => {
    const parsed = CaseSnapshot.parse(shown);
    if (parsed.withheld) throw new Error("the snapshot is shown");
    const expected = await snapshotDigest({ ...shown, targetType: "post", postState: "visible" });
    expect(await snapshotDigest(parsed)).toBe(expected);
    const { salt: _salt, ...withoutSalt } = shown;
    expect(CaseSnapshot.safeParse(withoutSalt).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a seal's list holds at most the 500 rows the case answer carries", () => {
    const row = { postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 };
    const withList = (rows: number) => ({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!, actions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!, sealed: { posts: rows, images: rows, deletedPosts: 0, list: Array.from({ length: rows }, () => row) } }] }] });
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(500)).success).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(501)).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("suspicion holds counts and days only", () => {
    const bad = { ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: TIME, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } } };
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(bad).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, reach: { ...view.suspicion.reach, newestPostOn: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the queue and the overview", () => {
  const row = { id: CASE, lane: 0, targetType: "post", openedAt: TIME, oldestOpenAt: TIME, openItems: 2, rules: ["R5"], categories: ["STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE"], allegesIllegal: true, suspect: false, reexamination: false, deferred: false };

  test("a page of the queue holds at most 50 cases and the cursor of the next", () => {
    expect(QUEUE_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(50);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [row], nextCursor: null, replies: [] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => row), nextCursor: "abc_-123", replies: [] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: Array.from({ length: 51 }, () => row), nextCursor: null, replies: [] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [{ ...row, lane: 3 }], nextCursor: null, replies: [] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the queue's cursor is an opaque word: letters, digits, dashes and underscores", () => {
    expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({}).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "eyJhIjoxfQ_-" }).success).toBe(true);
    for (const cursor of ["", "a b", "a/b", "a=b", "x".repeat(401)]) expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor }).success, cursor).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the overview holds counts, times, staff handles and cases", () => {
    const overview = {
      lanes: [
        { lane: 0, open: 2, oldestAt: TIME },
        { lane: 1, open: 0, oldestAt: null },
        { lane: 2, open: 5, oldestAt: TIME },
      ],
      appealsWaiting: 3,
      appealsYouMayReview: 1,
      appealsWithoutReviewer: 2,
      reveals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE }] },
      imagesToday: [{ handle: "mod_anna", count: 4 }],
      findingsToday: [{ handle: "mod_anna", count: 1 }],
      mailsWaiting: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 1, outcomes: 0 },
      mailsFailed: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 0, outcomes: 2 },
      releaseOverdue: 0,
      erasureOverdue: { caseEvidence: 0, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 0, redactions: 0, images: 0, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 0 },
      deferUnproven: false,
      protectionLifted: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, kind: "dismissed" }] },
      sealsDeclined: { total: 0, items: [] },
      interimSeals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, posts: 2, images: 5 }] },
      repliesWaiting: { count: 2, oldestAt: TIME },
      strikeAccounts: 1,
      // 3f: the contact point and the alert channel.
      contact: { open: 2, oldestAt: TIME, dueAt: TIME },
      alerts: { channel: "down", since: TIME },
      ordersUnverified: { total: 1, items: [{ orderId: POST, effectAt: TIME }] },
      // 3f Task 5: a report owed for a case, from reports_owed(): a case, a kind and a time.
      reportsOwed: { total: 1, items: [{ caseId: CASE, kind: "sealed_images" as const, since: TIME }] },
      // 3f Task 6: the newest copy mark and whether the copy is overdue; the open gaps after a restore, the measures among
      // them, and when the newest import ran.
      copy: { newestAt: TIME, overdue: true },
      restore: { open: 3, measures: 2, importedAt: TIME },
      quarantine: { dueIn: 1, dueOut: 2, undestroyed: 0, oldest: TIME },
    };
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(overview).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, copy: { newestAt: null } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, restore: { open: -1, measures: 0, importedAt: null } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, reportsOwed: { total: 1, items: [{ caseId: CASE, kind: "an authority", since: TIME }] } }).success).toBe(false);
    // Each of the three lists holds at most as many rows as the reveals' list does.
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, interimSeals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.interimSeals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, lanes: overview.lanes.slice(0, 2) }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, reveals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.reveals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, releaseOverdue: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("erasureOverdue is one count for each due rule of retention: all eight, each a whole number from 0", () => {
    const counts = { caseEvidence: 2, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 1, redactions: 0, images: 60, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 3 };
    expect(ErasureOverdue.parse(counts)).toEqual(counts);
    expect(Object.keys(ErasureOverdue.shape).sort()).toEqual(["accessLog", "caseEvidence", "contacts", "drafts", "images", "intakeRecords", "redactions", "statements"]);
    for (const key of Object.keys(counts)) {
      const { [key]: _left, ...missing } = counts as Record<string, number>;
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse(missing).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: -1 }).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: 1.5 }).success, key).toBe(false);
    }
    // The overview carries it: an answer without it is refused, so a console never reads "nothing is late" from a missing member.
    const parsed = StaffOverview.safeParse({ lanes: [], erasureOverdue: counts });
    expect(parsed.success).toBe(false);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffOverview.shape)).toContain("erasureOverdue");
  });
});

import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { is, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import { PgDialect, PgTable, getTableConfig, pgTable } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { apiRole, authRole, bytea, notifyRole, xid8 } from "../src/schema/helpers";
import * as schema from "../src/schema/index";

const tables = Object.values(schema).filter((v) => is(v, PgTable)) as PgTable[];
const byName = new Map(tables.map((t) => [getTableConfig(t).name, getTableConfig(t)]));

describe("auth schema", () => {
  test("auth tables live in the auth schema", () => {
    for (const name of ["users", "devices", "sessions", "email_codes", "passkeys", "auth_events"]) {
      expect(byName.get(name)?.schema, name).toBe("auth");
    }
  });
  test("sessions store only a hash id and carry both expiries", () => {
    const cols = byName.get("sessions")!.columns.map((c) => c.name);
    expect(cols).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["id", "user_id", "device_id", "expires_at", "absolute_expires_at", "reauth_at", "revoked_at"]));
  });
});

describe("row level security", () => {
  test("every table has RLS enabled and at least one policy", () => {
    expect(tables.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const t of tables) {
      const cfg = getTableConfig(t);
      expect(cfg.enableRLS, cfg.name).toBe(true);
      expect(cfg.policies.length, cfg.name).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });
});

describe("content schema", () => {
  test("posts carry a state enum and a body length check", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("posts")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    expect(cfg.columns.find((c) => c.name === "state")?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.checks.map((c) => c.name)).toContain("posts_body_len");
  });
  test("join tables have composite primary keys", () => {
    for (const name of ["follows", "likes", "reposts", "bookmarks", "blocks", "mutes"]) {
      expect(byName.get(name)!.primaryKeys.length, name).toBe(1);
      expect(byName.get(name)!.primaryKeys[0]!.columns.length, name).toBe(2);
    }
  });
});

    expect(cfg.columns.find((c) => c.name === "profile_id")?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.columns.find((c) => c.name === "changed_at")?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.columns.find((c) => c.name === "changed_at")?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    const fk = cfg.foreignKeys.map((k) => ({ table: getTableConfig(k.reference().foreignTable).name, columns: k.reference().foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }));
    expect(fk).toEqual([{ table: "profiles", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" }]);
    expect(cfg.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for])).toEqual([["handle_history_api_all", "all"]]);
  });
  test("profiles record when the handle last changed; users record when their purge finished", () => {
    const handleChangedAt = byName.get("profiles")!.columns.find((c) => c.name === "handle_changed_at");
    expect(handleChangedAt).toBeDefined();
    expect(handleChangedAt?.notNull).toBe(false);
    const purgedAt = byName.get("users")!.columns.find((c) => c.name === "purged_at");
    expect(purgedAt).toBeDefined();
    expect(purgedAt?.notNull).toBe(false);
  });
  test("one phone per account: a unique index on phone_hash that leaves out the accounts without one", () => {
    const idx = byName.get("users")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "users_phone_hash_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["phone_hash"]);
    expect(idx?.config.where).toBeDefined();
  });
  test("email codes can be for deleting the account, and every account event of 1b has a type", () => {
    expect(schema.emailCodePurpose.enumValues).toContain("delete_account");
    const values = schema.authEventType.enumValues;
    expect(values.slice(values.indexOf("not_me"), values.indexOf("account_deleted") + 1)).toEqual([
      "not_me",
      "profile_updated",
      "handle_changed",
      "email_changed",
      "badge_verified",
      "badge_removed",
      "export_created",
      "account_deleted",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("passkeys 1c", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** The foreign keys of one local column: the table and columns they point at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string, name: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .foreignKeys.filter((k) => k.reference().columns.some((c) => c.name === name))
      .map((k) => ({ table: getTableConfig(k.reference().foreignTable).name, columns: k.reference().foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }));

  test("bytea is the bytea SQL type and hands Buffers both ways", () => {
    const table = pgTable("bytea_probe", { value: bytea("value") });
    const probe = getTableConfig(table).columns[0]!;
    expect(probe.getSQLType()).toBe("bytea");
    const bytes = Buffer.from([0, 1, 254, 255]);
    expect(probe.mapToDriverValue(bytes)).toEqual(bytes);
    // postgres.js already parses bytea into a Buffer; a driver that answers a plain Uint8Array gets one too.
    const read = probe.mapFromDriverValue(new Uint8Array([0, 1, 254, 255]));
    expect(Buffer.isBuffer(read)).toBe(true);
    expect(read).toEqual(bytes);
    expect(probe.mapFromDriverValue(bytes)).toEqual(bytes);
  });

  test("users carry an optional WebAuthn user handle in bytea, unique among the accounts that have one", () => {
    const handle = column("users", "webauthn_user_id");
    expect(handle?.getSQLType()).toBe("bytea");
    expect(handle?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(handle?.hasDefault).toBe(false);
    const idx = byName.get("users")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "users_webauthn_user_id_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["webauthn_user_id"]);
    expect(idx?.config.where).toBeDefined();
  });

  test("passkeys record the AAGUID, the backup and verification flags, the creating device and a suspected copy", () => {
    expect(column("passkeys", "aaguid")?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(column("passkeys", "aaguid")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    for (const name of ["backup_eligible", "uv_initialized"]) {
      expect(column("passkeys", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe("boolean");
      expect(column("passkeys", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(true);
      expect(column("passkeys", name)?.default, name).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(column("passkeys", "created_device_id")?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(column("passkeys", "created_device_id")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(foreignKeys("passkeys", "created_device_id")).toEqual([{ table: "devices", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "set null" }]);
    expect(column("passkeys", "suspect_at")?.getSQLType()).toBe("timestamp with time zone");
    expect(column("passkeys", "suspect_at")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    // One row per credential: the index the foundation created stays.
    const idx = byName.get("passkeys")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "passkeys_credential_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["credential_id"]);
  });

  test("sessions carry a random handle that is unique, the factors they proved and the passkey that started them", () => {
    const handle = column("sessions", "handle");
    expect(handle?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(handle?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(handle?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    const idx = byName.get("sessions")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "sessions_handle_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["handle"]);
    const factors = column("sessions", "factors");
    expect(factors?.getSQLType()).toBe("jsonb");
    expect(factors?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(factors?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    expect(column("sessions", "passkey_id")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(foreignKeys("sessions", "passkey_id")).toEqual([{ table: "passkeys", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "set null" }]);
  });

  test("adding, removing and a counter regression of a passkey are security events", () => {
    const values = schema.authEventType.enumValues;
    // The slice ends at 1c's last value: 3a appends the staff events after it.
    expect(values.slice(values.indexOf("account_deleted"), values.indexOf("passkey_counter_regression") + 1)).toEqual([
      "account_deleted",
      "passkey_added",
      "passkey_removed",
      "passkey_counter_regression",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("explore 2c", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  /** Every foreign key of a table by its local column: the table and columns it points at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      byName.get(table)!.foreignKeys.map((k) => {
        const ref = k.reference();
        return [ref.columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), { table: getTableConfig(ref.foreignTable).name, columns: ref.foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }];
      }),
    );
  const indexColumns = (config: { columns: unknown[] }) => config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name);

  test("profiles carry the author's Explore switch, on by default", () => {
    const flag = column("profiles", "show_in_explore");
    expect(flag?.getSQLType()).toBe("boolean");
    expect(flag?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(flag?.default).toBe(true);
  });

  test("explore_runs numbers each ranking with an identity and records its time, formula, counts and duration", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("explore_runs")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    expect(shape("explore_runs")).toEqual([
      ["generation", "integer", true],
      ["as_of", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["formula", "smallint", true],
      ["candidates", "integer", true],
      ["items", "integer", true],
      ["took_ms", "integer", true],
    ]);
    const generation = column("explore_runs", "generation");
    expect(generation?.primary).toBe(true);
    // Always generated: an insert cannot choose its generation, so the numbers come from the sequence alone.
    expect(generation?.generatedIdentity?.type).toBe("always");
    // The refresh writes every other value itself, the refresh time included, which tests move.
    expect(cfg.columns.filter((c) => c.hasDefault).map((c) => c.name)).toEqual(["generation"]);
    expect(cfg.foreignKeys).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("explore_items holds a ranking's posts by position, each post once, and goes with its ranking, its post or its author", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("explore_items")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    // No score or count is stored: the position is the order.
    expect(shape("explore_items")).toEqual([
      ["generation", "integer", true],
      ["position", "integer", true],
      ["post_id", "uuid", true],
      ["author_id", "uuid", true],
    ]);
    expect(cfg.primaryKeys.map((k) => k.columns.map((c) => c.name))).toEqual([["generation", "position"]]);
    expect(cfg.indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, indexColumns(i.config), i.config.unique])).toEqual([["explore_items_generation_post_idx", ["generation", "post_id"], true]]);
    expect(foreignKeys("explore_items")).toEqual({
      generation: { table: "explore_runs", columns: ["generation"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      post_id: { table: "posts", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      author_id: { table: "profiles", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
    });
  });

  test("both tables have row level security and one full-access policy for the API role", () => {
    // The loop under "row level security" covers them too; this pins the policy each one has.
    for (const name of ["explore_runs", "explore_items"]) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name)!;
      expect(cfg.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      expect(cfg.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]), name).toEqual([[`${name}_api_all`, "all", apiRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("likes and reposts have a BRIN index on created_at for the refresh's window; bookmarks, which Explore never reads, has none", () => {
    for (const name of ["likes", "reposts"]) {
      const brin = byName.get(name)!.indexes.filter((i) => i.config.method === "brin");
      expect(brin.map((i) => [i.config.name, indexColumns(i.config), i.config.unique, i.config.where]), name).toEqual([[`${name}_created_brin`, ["created_at"], false, undefined]]);
    }
    expect(byName.get("bookmarks")!.indexes.filter((i) => i.config.method === "brin")).toEqual([]);
    // The factory's other indexes stay the same on all three tables.
    for (const name of ["likes", "reposts", "bookmarks"]) {
      const others = byName.get(name)!.indexes.filter((i) => i.config.method !== "brin");
      expect(others.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.method]).sort(), name).toEqual([
        [`${name}_post_idx`, "btree"],
        [`${name}_user_created_idx`, "btree"],
      ]);
    }
  });
});

describe("staff console 3a", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  /** Every foreign key of a table by its local columns: the table and columns it points at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      byName.get(table)!.foreignKeys.map((k) => {
        const ref = k.reference();
        return [ref.columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), { table: getTableConfig(ref.foreignTable).name, columns: ref.foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }];
      }),
    );
  /** Every index as its name, its columns and whether it is unique, by name. */
  const indexes = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name), i.config.unique])
      .sort((a, b) => String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])));
  const uniques = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.uniqueConstraints.map((u) => [u.getName(), u.columns.map((c) => c.name)]);
  const checks = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort();
  const policies = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]);

  test("the seven staff events close the auth event type, after 1c's passkey events", () => {
    const values = schema.authEventType.enumValues;
    expect(values.slice(values.indexOf("passkey_counter_regression") + 1)).toEqual([
      "staff_enrollment_issued",
      "staff_key_added",
      "staff_key_revoked",
      "staff_key_counter_regression",
      "staff_sign_in",
      "staff_signed_out",
      "staff_session_revoked",
    ]);
  });

  test("the three staff tables live in the auth schema, with row level security and one policy for the auth role", () => {
    for (const name of ["staff_keys", "staff_enrollments", "staff_sessions"]) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name)!;
      expect(cfg.schema, name).toBe("auth");
      expect(cfg.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      expect(policies(name), name).toEqual([[`${name}_auth_all`, "all", authRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("a staff key records its credential, its origin and relying party ID, its dates and whether it was revoked or suspect", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_keys")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["credential_id", "text", true],
      ["public_key", "text", true],
      ["counter", "bigint", true],
      ["transports", "text[]", true],
      ["name", "text", true],
      ["aaguid", "uuid", false],
      ["origin", "text", true],
      ["rp_id", "text", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["last_used_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["revoked_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["suspect_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
    ]);
    // No user handle of its own: staff registrations use the account's webauthn_user_id.
    expect(column("staff_keys", "user_handle")).toBeUndefined();
    // The development cleaner deletes accounts as the superuser; a key must stop that delete, never go with it.
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_keys")).toEqual({ user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" } });
    expect(indexes("staff_keys")).toEqual([
      ["staff_keys_credential_idx", ["credential_id"], true],
      ["staff_keys_user_idx", ["user_id"], false],
    ]);
    // The pair the staff sessions' foreign key names.
    expect(uniques("staff_keys")).toEqual([["staff_keys_id_user_id_unique", ["id", "user_id"]]]);
    expect(checks("staff_keys")).toEqual(["staff_keys_suspect_is_revoked"]);
  });

  test("an enrolment keeps only its token's hash, the console it was issued for, its expiry and when it was used", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_enrollments")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["token_hash", "text", true],
      ["origin", "text", true],
      ["rp_id", "text", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["used_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
    ]);
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_enrollments")).toEqual({ user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" } });
    expect(indexes("staff_enrollments")).toEqual([
      ["staff_enrollments_token_hash_idx", ["token_hash"], true],
      ["staff_enrollments_user_idx", ["user_id"], false],
    ]);
  });

  test("a staff session keeps its token's hash, a unique handle, its key and account together, both expiries and the browser label", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_sessions")).toEqual([
      ["id", "text", true],
      ["handle", "uuid", true],
      ["user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["key_id", "uuid", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["last_used_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["idle_expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["absolute_expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["revoked_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["browser", "text", true],
    ]);
    expect(column("staff_sessions", "id")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(column("staff_sessions", "handle")?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    // The key's foreign key names the account as well, so a session's key always belongs to its account.
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_sessions")).toEqual({
      user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      "key_id,user_id": { table: "staff_keys", columns: ["id", "user_id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
    });
    expect(indexes("staff_sessions")).toEqual([
      ["staff_sessions_handle_idx", ["handle"], true],
      ["staff_sessions_user_idx", ["user_id"], false],
    ]);
    expect(checks("staff_sessions")).toEqual(["staff_sessions_lifetime"]);
  });

  test("audit_log gains the staff session's handle, the key, the action's hash and the step-up, all optional", () => {
    const added = [
      ["staff_session", "uuid"],
      ["key_id", "uuid"],
      ["action_hash", "text"],
      ["step_up", "jsonb"],
    ] as const;
    for (const [name, type] of added) {
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe(type);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(false);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.hasDefault, name).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(checks("audit_log")).toEqual(["audit_log_step_up_complete"]);
  });

  test("audit_log's chain columns are not null, with placeholder defaults that the trigger always overwrites", () => {
    const chain = [
      ["chain_version", "smallint", 0],
      ["chain_seq", "bigint", 0],
      ["prev_hash", "text", ""],
      ["hash", "text", ""],
    ] as const;
    for (const [name, type, placeholder] of chain) {
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe(type);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(true);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.default, name).toBe(placeholder);
    }
    // One index serves the viewer and audit-verify; there is none on (created_at, id).
    expect(indexes("audit_log")).toEqual([["audit_log_chain_seq_idx", ["chain_seq"], true]]);
  });

  test("audit_head holds one row, the newest place and hash, which the API role may only read", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("audit_head")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    expect(shape("audit_head")).toEqual([
      ["id", "smallint", true],
      ["seq", "bigint", true],
      ["hash", "text", true],
    ]);
    expect(column("audit_head", "id")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.columns.filter((c) => c.hasDefault)).toEqual([]);
    expect(checks("audit_head")).toEqual(["audit_head_single_row"]);
    expect(cfg.enableRLS).toBe(true);
    expect(policies("audit_head")).toEqual([["audit_head_api_select", "select", apiRole]]);
  });
});

describe("moderation cases 3c", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  const checks = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort();
  const policies = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]);
  const index = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === name)?.config;
  const indexColumns = (config: { columns: unknown[] } | undefined) => config?.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name);
  /** An index's predicate as the SQL the migration holds. */
  const predicate = (config: { where?: SQL } | undefined) => (config?.where ? new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(config.where).sql : undefined);
  /** Every foreign key of a table by its local columns: the table and columns it points at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      byName.get(table)!.foreignKeys.map((k) => {
        const ref = k.reference();
        return [ref.columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), { table: getTableConfig(ref.foreignTable).name, columns: ref.foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }];
      }),
    );
  /** The columns declared unique by themselves, each with the name of its constraint. */
  const uniques = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .columns.filter((c) => c.isUnique)
      .map((c) => [c.uniqueName, [c.name]])
      .sort();

  /** A check's expression as the migration holds it. */
  const checkSql = (table: string, name: string) => new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(byName.get(table)!.checks.find((c) => c.name === name)!.value).sql;

  const MODERATION_TABLES = ["cases", "intakes", "intake_items", "decisions", "decision_actions", "seal_posts", "appeals", "staff_texts", "evidence_snapshots", "case_access_log", "moderation_limits", "media_holds"];
  const AUTH_TABLES = ["notifier_contacts", "notifier_confirmations", "notifier_suppressions", "staff_personal_accounts"];

  test("the twelve moderation tables are public, with row level security and one policy for the API role", () => {
    for (const name of MODERATION_TABLES) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name);
      expect(cfg, name).toBeDefined();
      expect(cfg!.schema, name).toBeUndefined(); // public
      expect(cfg!.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      // The grants do the restricting (migration 0015); moderation_limits is read only, so its one policy is a SELECT one.
      expect(policies(name), name).toEqual(name === "moderation_limits" ? [["moderation_limits_api_select", "select", apiRole]] : [[`${name}_api_all`, "all", apiRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("no moderation table has a column named like an email or an address", () => {
    for (const name of MODERATION_TABLES) {
      for (const c of byName.get(name)!.columns) expect(c.name, `${name}.${c.name}`).not.toMatch(/email|address/i);
    }
  });

  test("xid8 is the xid8 SQL type and hands the transaction id over as a string", () => {
    const table = pgTable("xid8_probe", { value: xid8("value") });
    const probe = getTableConfig(table).columns[0]!;
    expect(probe.getSQLType()).toBe("xid8");
    // A 64-bit counter: a string keeps every digit, where a JavaScript number would not.
    expect(probe.mapFromDriverValue("18446744073709551615")).toBe("18446744073709551615");
    expect(probe.mapToDriverValue("773")).toBe("773");
  });

  test("one open case a target: the partial unique index, the queue's index and the target's index", () => {
    const open = index("cases", "cases_one_open_per_target");
    expect(open?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(open)).toEqual(["target_type", "target_id"]);
    expect(predicate(open)).toBe("closed_at is null");
    const queue = index("cases", "cases_queue_idx");
    expect(queue?.unique).toBe(false);
    expect(indexColumns(queue)).toEqual(["lane", "oldest_open_at"]);
    expect(predicate(queue)).toBe("closed_at is null");
    expect(indexColumns(index("cases", "cases_target_idx"))).toEqual(["target_type", "target_id", "opened_at"]);
    expect(checks("cases")).toEqual(["cases_closed_answered", "cases_lane", "cases_seq_order"]);
    expect(column("cases", "id")?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    // No foreign key on the target: it names two tables.
    expect(foreignKeys("cases")).toEqual({});
  });

  test("an item's partial unique indexes: one target a notice, one re-examination an item, one item per reporter, case and ground", () => {
    const target = index("intake_items", "intake_items_target_once");
    expect(target?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(target)).toEqual(["intake_id", "target_type", "target_id"]);
    expect(predicate(target)).toBe("reexamines_item_id is null");

    const reexamines = index("intake_items", "intake_items_reexamines_once");
    expect(reexamines?.unique).toBe(true);

  test("no check lets a row through on a null: a statement always has its digest, a salt its form, and the two comparisons with a nullable value are null-safe", () => {
    // A CHECK passes when its expression is null, so `digest = encode(...)` alone would accept a statement with no digest.
    for (const [table, name] of [
      ["intake_items", "intake_items_statement"],
      ["appeals", "appeals_statement"],
    ] as const) {
      expect(checkSql(table, name), name).toContain(`"${table}"."statement_digest" is not null and "${table}"."statement_digest" = encode(sha256(`);
      expect(checkSql(table, name), name).toContain(`"${table}"."statement_salt" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'`);
    }
    expect(checkSql("staff_texts", "staff_texts_digest")).toContain(`"staff_texts"."salt" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "staff_texts"."digest" = encode(sha256(`);
    expect(checkSql("intake_items", "intake_items_case")).toBe(
      `("intake_items"."case_id" is null) = ("intake_items"."seq" is null) and ("intake_items"."case_id" is not null or "intake_items"."outcome" is not distinct from 'not_available')`,
    );
    expect(checkSql("decisions", "decisions_keyword")).toBe(`"decisions"."category_keyword" is null or "decisions"."ground" is not distinct from 'illegal'`);
  });

  test("the columns of decisions that the database forces: their types, and which carry a default", () => {
    // [name, SQL type, not null, default]; undefined where the column has none and the trigger of 0016 alone fills it.
    const forced = [
      ["appeal_id", "uuid", false, undefined],
      ["answers_from_seq", "integer", false, undefined],
      ["source", "decision_source", true, undefined],
      ["automated_detection", "boolean", true, false],

      ["informed_at", "timestamp with time zone", false, undefined],

  test("the ledger: a measure once a decision, lifted at most once, and the columns the database forces", () => {
    expect(shape("decision_actions")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["decision_id", "uuid", true],
      ["kind", "action_kind", true],
      ["media_id", "uuid", false],
      ["subject_account_id", "uuid", true],
      ["post_id", "uuid", false],
      ["reverses_action_id", "uuid", false],
      ["no_effect", "text", false],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      // 3e (design, section 6.1): three the key signs, four the trigger forces.
      ["days", "smallint", false],
      ["announced", "boolean", false],
      ["basis", "text", false],
      ["rests_on", "uuid[]", false],
      ["starts_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["ends_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["replaced", "boolean", false],
      // 3f (design, section 6.2): one the trigger forces from the order, one the key signs on a reinstatement.
      ["withhold_author", "boolean", false],
      ["order_ground", "text", false],
    ]);
    // None of the forced columns has a default: the triggers of 0016 and 0021 alone fill them.
    for (const name of ["subject_account_id", "post_id", "reverses_action_id", "no_effect", "created_at", "days", "announced", "basis", "rests_on", "starts_at", "ends_at", "replaced", "withhold_author", "order_ground"]) {
      expect(column("decision_actions", name)?.hasDefault, name).toBe(false);
    }
    const once = byName.get("decision_actions")!.uniqueConstraints.map((u) => [u.getName(), u.columns.map((c) => c.name), u.nullsNotDistinct]);
    expect(once).toEqual([["decision_actions_once", ["decision_id", "kind", "media_id"], true]]);
    const reversed = index("decision_actions", "decision_actions_reversed_once");
    expect(reversed?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(reversed)).toEqual(["reverses_action_id"]);
    expect(predicate(reversed)).toBe("reverses_action_id is not null");
    expect(checks("decision_actions")).toEqual(["decision_actions_announced", "decision_actions_basis", "decision_actions_days", "decision_actions_no_effect", "decision_actions_order_ground"]);
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_order_ground")).toBe(`"decision_actions"."order_ground" in ('withdrawn', 'annulled', 'scrutiny', 'not_authentic', 'wrong_item')`);
    // Each check names columns only: no value of action_kind, which a check may not name in the migration that adds it.
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_days")).toBe(`"decision_actions"."days" between 1 and 30`);
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_basis")).toBe(
      `"decision_actions"."basis" in ('strikes', 'threat', 'terrorist', 'flood', 'protective', 'threat_repeat', 'ladder_end', 'reports')`,
    );
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_announced")).toBe(`"decision_actions"."announced" is null or "decision_actions"."basis" is not null`);
    expect(foreignKeys("decision_actions")).toEqual({
      decision_id: { table: "decisions", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
      reverses_action_id: { table: "decision_actions", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "no action" },
    });
    // 3c's seven measures and five reversals, then 3e's six measures and four reversals, in the order the migration adds them.
    expect(schema.actionKind.enumValues).toEqual([
      "withhold",
      "remove",
      "seal_media",
      "withhold_media",
      "remove_media",
      "reset_display_name",
      "reset_bio",
      "restore",
      "unseal_media",
      "restore_media",
      "restore_display_name",
      "restore_bio",
      "strike",
      "suspend",
      "terminate",
      "retire_handle",
      "warn_reporting",
      "restrict_reporting",
      "overrule",
      "lift_suspension",
      "unretire_handle",
      "lift_reporting",
      // 3f: the measure of an order decision and its reversal.
      "disable_by_order",
      "reinstate_by_order",
    ]);
  });

import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { MEASURES, MEASURE_KINDS, ORDER_DRAFTS, ORDER_GROUNDS, ORDER_RULES, RETENTION, REVERSAL_KINDS, SEAL_DRAFTS, STANDING_RULES, appealDeadline, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { IMAGE_LOST_NOTICE, ORDER_NOTICE, REDRESS_TEXTS, RULEBOOKS, STATEMENT_WORDS, getRule, retireEnd, statementParagraphs, type StatementInput } from "../src/index";

/**
 * The statement of reasons (3c design, section 10): one pure function renders it for the author's screen, the console's
 * preview and the mail, from the decision's data and the versions it was made under. These tests hold it to the six
 * elements of Article 17(3) of the Digital Services Act for every kind of decision, and to the design's sentences word
 * for word.
 */
const POST = { id: "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36", createdAt: "2026-10-01T12:00:00.000Z" };
const POST_TIME = "2026-10-01 12:00 UTC";
const DECIDED = "2026-10-04T09:30:15.250Z";
const IMAGE = "0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d";
const RESET_DECISION = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
const NO_RESET = { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } as const;

const measure = (kind: MeasureKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["measures"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["measures"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  noEffect: null,
  sealed: kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } : null,
  ...more,
});
const reversal = (kind: ReversalKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["reversals"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  ...NO_RESET,
  ...more,
});

/** A final removal of a post under R1, following a report: the plainest restricting decision. */
function statement(more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}): StatementInput {
  return {
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R1",
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: "The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
    reason: "That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
    source: "report",
    decidedAt: DECIDED,
    post: POST,
    measures: [measure("remove")],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
    ...more,
  };
}

const W = STATEMENT_WORDS;
const text = (input: StatementInput) => statementParagraphs(input).join("\n");
/** A line break, to join paragraphs for a search across them (3f's tests). */
const NL = String.fromCharCode(10);
const appeal = (decidedAt: string) => REDRESS_TEXTS[1].appeal.replace("{deadline}", `${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)} ${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(11, 16)} UTC`);

describe("statementParagraphs", () => {
  test("a final removal under a rule, paragraph by paragraph: what was done, where and how long, how it came to korbat, no automation, the rule as its version words it, the facts, the reason and the appeal", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toEqual([
      `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`,
      "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
      "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
      "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
      `It breaks korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
      "The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
      "korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
      appeal(DECIDED),
    ]);
    // The deadline is the appeal's own: six months after the decision, to the minute, in UTC.
    expect(text(statement())).toContain("until 2027-04-04 09:30 UTC");
  });

  test("a time is printed as the mails print one: the date and the minute, in UTC", () => {
    expect(text(statement({ post: { id: POST.id, createdAt: "2026-02-28T23:59:59.999Z" } }))).toContain("your post of 2026-02-28 23:59 UTC");
  });

  test("an old statement renders with the rulebook it was made under", () => {
    for (const version of [1, 2, 3] as const) {
      for (const rule of RULEBOOKS[version]) {
        const out = text(statement({ ruleId: rule.id as StatementInput["ruleId"], rulesVersion: version }));
        expect(out, `${rule.id} v${version}`).toContain(`It breaks korbat rule ${rule.id}, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`);
      }
    }
    // R6 changed its title, R1 its text: version 1 keeps the old words.
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 1 }))).toContain('"No spam, scams, or impersonation"');
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 2 }))).toContain('"No spam, scams, impersonation or coordinated manipulation"');
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 1 }))).toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 2 }))).not.toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    // A version the package does not hold cannot be rendered as another one.
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ rulesVersion: 9 }))).toThrow(/rulebook/);
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ redressVersion: 9 }))).toThrow(/redress/);
  });

  test("a decision on the law names the law, never a rule, and says that it applies everywhere", () => {
    const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).", source: "notice" }));
    expect(out).toContain("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).");
    expect(out).toContain("korbat cannot restrict content for one country alone, so this applies everywhere, which is more than the law of a single country asks for.");
    expect(out).toContain("korbat decided this following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act.");
    expect(out.join("\n")).not.toMatch(/korbat rule R[1-6]/);
  });

  test("the source is one of three phrases", () => {
    expect(W.source).toEqual({
      notice: "following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act",
      report: "following a report by another user",
      own_initiative: "found by a moderator",
    });
    expect(text(statement({ source: "own_initiative" }))).toContain("What this decision is about was found by a moderator.");
    for (const source of ["notice", "report", "own_initiative"] as const) expect(text(statement({ source })), source).toContain(W.source[source]);
  });

  describe("the redress text follows the decision's own kind and outcome, never a later event", () => {
    test("an interim decision carries the interim text and no appeal", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat hid your post of ${POST_TIME} from other people while it decides.`);
      expect(out).toContain("This applies everywhere korbat is available, for as long as korbat decides the case.");
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
      expect(out.join("\n")).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision once");
    });

    test("a final restriction carries korbat's appeal with its deadline", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement()).at(-1)).toBe(appeal(DECIDED));
    });

    test("3f's review (people3): a decision its author was told of later than it was taken (held with an order's notice) counts the six months from the telling", () => {
      const told = "2027-01-02T10:05:00.000Z";
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ informedAt: told })).at(-1)).toBe(appeal(told));
      // Told at once, held still (null), or written before the member existed: from the decision, as before.
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ informedAt: DECIDED })).at(-1)).toBe(appeal(DECIDED));
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ informedAt: null })).at(-1)).toBe(appeal(DECIDED));
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement()).at(-1)).toBe(appeal(DECIDED));
    });

    test("every other decision carries the text for a decision its author cannot appeal", () => {
      const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
      const others: StatementInput[] = [
        statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, ...NO_RESET }] }),
        statement({ outcome: "not_evident", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [] }),
        statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "partly_reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore_media")], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),
      ];
      for (const input of others) expect(statementParagraphs(input).at(-1), `${input.kind} ${input.outcome}`).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });
  });

  test("every restricting decision carries the six elements of Article 17(3): each measure, kind, ground and rulebook version", () => {
    const grounds = [
      { ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R3" as const, legalReference: null },
      { ground: "illegal" as const, ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 130 of the criminal code." },
    ];
    for (const kind of ["interim", "final"] as const) {
      // 3c's seven measures; 3e's are held to their own sentences below and in later tasks.
      for (const measureKind of MEASURE_KINDS.slice(0, 7)) {
        if (!MEASURES[measureKind][kind]) continue;
        for (const ground of grounds) {
          for (const rulesVersion of [1, 2]) {
            const account = MEASURES[measureKind].target === "display_name" || MEASURES[measureKind].target === "bio";
            const input = statement({ kind, ...ground, rulesVersion, post: account ? null : POST, measures: [measure(measureKind)] });
            const out = statementParagraphs(input);
            const label = `${kind} ${measureKind} ${ground.ground} v${rulesVersion}`;
            // (a) the restriction, where it applies and for how long.
            expect(out[0], label).toMatch(/^korbat (hid|removed|sealed|reset) /);
            expect(out, label).toContain(kind === "interim" ? W.scope.interim : W.scope.final);
            // (b) the facts, and whether the decision followed a notice or korbat's own finding.
            expect(out, label).toContain("The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.");
            expect(out, label).toContain("korbat decided this following a report by another user.");
            // (c) the use of automated means.
            expect(out, label).toContain(W.automation);
            // (d) and (e) the legal ground, or the rule, with its explanation: as a finding only for a final restriction
            // that seals nothing; while deciding, as what korbat is checking; for a seal, as what the step rests on.
            const rule = getRule("R3", rulesVersion)!;
            const seals = measureKind === "seal_media";
            if (ground.ground === "illegal") {
              expect(out, label).toContain(seals ? "This step rests on the law: Section 130 of the criminal code." : kind === "interim" ? "korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 130 of the criminal code." : "korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 130 of the criminal code.");
            } else {
              expect(out, label).toContain(`${seals ? "This step rests on" : kind === "interim" ? "korbat is checking this against" : "It breaks"} korbat rule R3, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`);
            }
            if (seals || kind === "interim") expect(out.join(" "), label).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal/);
            expect(out, label).toContain("korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.");
            // (f) redress.
            expect(out.at(-1)!.startsWith(kind === "interim" ? REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim : "You can appeal this decision once"), label).toBe(true);
            // One paragraph is one line, but for a staff text that holds line feeds of its own, and none is empty.
            for (const paragraph of out) expect(paragraph.trim().length, label).toBeGreaterThan(0);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  describe("what was done, for each measure", () => {
    test("a post and an image, while deciding and for good", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", measures: [measure("withhold_media")] }))[0]).toBe(`korbat hid one image of your post of ${POST_TIME} from other people while it decides.`);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ measures: [measure("remove_media")] }))[0]).toBe(`korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`);
      // Several measures in one decision: one paragraph each, in the decision's order.
      const both = statementParagraphs(statement({ measures: [measure("remove"), measure("remove_media")] }));
      expect(both.slice(0, 2)).toEqual([`korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`, `korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`]);
    });

    test("a field reset says that the placeholder was written once and that the old value does not come back", () => {
      const name = statementParagraphs(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_display_name")] }));
      expect(name[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reset your display name. korbat wrote this placeholder once. You may set your display name again; what you set is judged on its own if someone reports it, and korbat does not put the old value back when this measure ends or is lifted.",
      );
      const bio = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio")] }));
      expect(bio[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reset your bio while it decides. korbat wrote this placeholder once. You may set your bio again; what you set is judged on its own if someone reports it, and korbat does not put the old value back when this measure ends or is lifted.",
      );
    });

    test("each noEffect sentence: another decision already holds it, the post or the account is deleted, the field already held the placeholder", () => {
      const first = (input: StatementInput) => statementParagraphs(input)[0];
      expect(first(statement({ measures: [measure("remove", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).toBe(
        `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it. Another decision already keeps this post from being shown, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
      );
      expect(first(statement({ measures: [measure("remove_media", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).toBe(
        `korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it. Another decision already keeps this image from being shown, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
      );
      expect(first(statement({ measures: [measure("remove", { noEffect: "deleted" })] }))).toBe(
        `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it. You had deleted this post, so this changes nothing anyone sees.`,
      );
      expect(first(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).toBe("korbat reset your bio. The field already held korbat's placeholder, so this changes nothing now.");
      expect(first(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_display_name", { noEffect: "deleted" })] }))).toBe("korbat reset your display name. Your account is deleted, so this changes nothing.");
      // A reset that changed nothing wrote no placeholder, so it does not say that it wrote one.
      expect(first(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).not.toContain("wrote this placeholder once");
    });
  });

  describe("the ground is worded by what the decision is", () => {
    const r2 = getRule("R2", 2)!;
    const r5 = getRule("R5", 2)!;

    test("the words, each a constant", () => {
      expect(W.ground.sealRule("R2", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('This step rests on korbat rule R2, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.sealLaw("Section 184b.")).toBe("This step rests on the law: Section 184b.");
      expect(W.ground.checkingRule("R5", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('korbat is checking this against korbat rule R5, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.checkingLaw("Section 241.")).toBe("korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 241.");
      expect(W.ground.breaks("R1", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('It breaks korbat rule R1, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.illegal("Section 241.")).toBe("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241.");
      expect(W.ground.restedOnRule("R1", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.restedOnLaw("Section 241.")).toBe("That decision rested on the law: Section 241.");
      expect(W.ground.referenceErased).toBe("its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.");
    });

    test("a seal, while deciding and for good, on a report alone: the step rests on rule R2, and nothing says that the rule is broken or the images illegal", () => {
      const sealing = (kind: "interim" | "final") =>
        statementParagraphs(statement({ kind, ruleId: "R2", facts: SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post, reason: kind === "interim" ? SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.deciding : SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.final, source: "notice", measures: [measure("seal_media")] }));
      for (const kind of ["interim", "final"] as const) {
        const out = sealing(kind);
        expect(out, kind).toContain(`This step rests on korbat rule R2, "${r2.title}": ${r2.text}`);
        expect(out.join(" "), kind).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal|korbat is checking/);
      }
      // A seal in the category Protection of minors, on the law: the same, with the law.
      const law = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 184b of the criminal code.", source: "notice", measures: [measure("seal_media")] }));
      expect(law).toContain("This step rests on the law: Section 184b of the criminal code.");
      expect(law.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/found it illegal|korbat is checking/);
    });

    test("a decision taken while deciding that seals nothing says what korbat is checking, on a rule and on the law", () => {
      const rule = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", ruleId: "R5", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(rule).toContain(`korbat is checking this against korbat rule R5, "${r5.title}": ${r5.text}`);
      const law = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).", source: "notice", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(law).toContain("korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).");
      // Beside "while it decides", nothing states a finding.
      for (const out of [rule, law]) expect(out.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal/);
    });

    test("a final restriction that seals nothing states what korbat found", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toContain(`It breaks korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241." }))).toContain("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241.");
    });
  });

  describe("the seal's sentences", () => {
    const seal = (sealed: { posts: number; images: number; deletedImages: number }, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["measures"][number]> = {}) => measure("seal_media", { sealed, ...more });
    const sealing = (more: Partial<StatementInput>) => statement({ ruleId: "R2", facts: SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post, reason: SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.deciding, source: "notice", ...more });

    test("on a post case, while deciding: the images of the post, with their number, and the interim redress", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", measures: [seal({ posts: 1, images: 3, deletedImages: 0 })] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (3 in all): nobody can see them, you included.`);
      expect(out).toContain(`The facts: ${SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post}`);
      expect(out).toContain(`korbat's reasons: ${SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.deciding}`);
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
      // Neither sentence of a seal for good (the rule's own text speaks of both, so they are looked for as whole paragraphs' parts).
      expect(out[0]).not.toContain(W.sealForGood);
      expect(out.at(-1)).not.toContain(W.sealAppeal);
    });

    test("on an account case: every image on the account's posts, with and without posts the author had deleted", () => {
      const live = statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [seal({ posts: 4, images: 9, deletedImages: 0 })] }));
      expect(live[0]).toBe("korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (9 on 4 posts): nobody can see them, you included.");
      const kept = statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [seal({ posts: 4, images: 9, deletedImages: 2 })] }));
      expect(kept[0]).toBe(
        "korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (9 on 4 posts): nobody can see them, you included. 2 of them are on posts you had deleted, which korbat had kept under its terms (Your data).",
      );
    });

    test("for good: kept only for the authorities, and the appeal waits until they have assessed the images", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(sealing({ reason: SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.final, measures: [seal({ posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 })] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (2 in all): nobody can see them, you included. They are kept only for the authorities korbat reports this to.`);
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(`${appeal(DECIDED)} An appeal of a seal waits until the authorities have assessed the images.`);
      const account = statementParagraphs(sealing({ post: null, measures: [seal({ posts: 2, images: 5, deletedImages: 1 })] }));
      expect(account[0]).toBe(
        "korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (5 on 2 posts): nobody can see them, you included. 1 of them is on a post you had deleted, which korbat had kept under its terms (Your data). They are kept only for the authorities korbat reports this to.",
      );
    });

    test("a seal that changed nothing says so: already sealed, or the post or the account deleted", () => {
      const first = (more: Partial<StatementInput>, noEffect: "already" | "deleted") => statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", measures: [seal({ posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 }, { noEffect })], ...more }))[0];
      expect(first({}, "already")).toBe(
        `korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (2 in all): nobody can see them, you included. Another decision already keeps these images sealed, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
      );
      expect(first({}, "deleted")).toBe(`korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (2 in all): nobody can see them, you included. You had deleted this post, so this changes nothing anyone sees.`);
      expect(first({ post: null }, "deleted")).toBe("korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (2 on 1 post): nobody can see them, you included. Your account is deleted, so this changes nothing.");
    });

    test("a lifted seal", () => {
      const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R2" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The authority answered on 2 October 2026.", measures: [], reversals: [reversal("unseal_media")], reviewed }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe("korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed it.");
      expect(out[1]).toBe("korbat lifted the seal on these images. If an image is still not shown, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies.");
    });
  });

  describe("reversals and what ended", () => {
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    const correction = (more: Partial<StatementInput>) => statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The post is satire.", measures: [], reviewed, ...more });
    const FIELD = (field: string) => `korbat does not put back your ${field} as it was before the reset: set it again in Settings, Profile if you wish.`;
    const KEPT = `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days.`;
    const KEPT_R4 = `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days, unless korbat had already erased it under rule R4.`;

    test("a correction of a final decision renders that decision's rule from its own row and version, and its reason", () => {
      // The corrected decision was made under rulebook version 1: its rule reads as that version worded it.
      const out = statementParagraphs(correction({ reviewed: { ...reviewed, rulesVersion: 1 }, reversals: [reversal("restore")] }));
      expect(out).toEqual([
        "korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed it.",
        `Your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        `That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 1)!.text}`,
        "Why korbat changed it: The post is satire.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
      const part = statementParagraphs(correction({ outcome: "partly_reversed", reversals: [reversal("restore_media")] }));
      expect(part[0]).toBe("korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed part of it.");
      expect(part[1]).toBe(
        `One image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
      );
      // A corrected decision on the law renders its legal reference.
      const law = statementParagraphs(correction({ reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed: { ...reviewed, ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241." } }));
      expect(law).toContain("That decision rested on the law: Section 241.");
    });

    test("a correction of an interim decision lifts what was done while deciding", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(correction({ reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed: { ...reviewed, kind: "interim" } }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe("korbat lifted what it did while deciding on 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC.");
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });

    test("a review answers the appeal: kept, reversed in part or reversed", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The post was read again.", measures: [], reviewed }))).toEqual([
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and kept that decision.",
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        `That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
        "Why korbat kept it: The post was read again.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }))[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed that decision.",
      );
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "partly_reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore_media")], reviewed }))[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed part of that decision.",
      );
    });

    test("the field-restore sentence, with and without its 30-day sentence, and with the R4 form", () => {
      const lifted = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]>, kind: ReversalKind = "restore_bio") => statementParagraphs(correction({ post: null, reversals: [reversal(kind, { resetDecisionId: RESET_DECISION, ...more })] }))[1];
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: false })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R4" })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT_R4}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R3" }, "restore_display_name")).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your display name. ${FIELD("display name")} ${KEPT}`);
    });

    test("a final no-action decision that ends measures taken while deciding names them, and nothing else it did", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(
        statement({
          outcome: "no_violation",
          ground: null,
          ruleId: null,
          facts: null,
          reason: null,
          measures: [],
          endedMeasures: [
            { kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, ...NO_RESET },
            { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: IMAGE, ...NO_RESET },
          ],
        }),
      );
      expect(out).toEqual([
        `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.withhold.label}, ${MEASURES.withhold_media.label}.`,
        "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
    });

    test("the field sentence after an interim reset ended by a closing decision, with and without its 30-day sentence, and none for a field the closing decision resets itself", () => {
      const ended = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["endedMeasures"][number]>, kind: MeasureKind = "reset_bio") => ({ kind, mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: RESET_DECISION, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null, ...more });
      const closing = (endedMeasures: DecisionStatement["endedMeasures"], more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}) =>
        statementParagraphs(statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, post: null, measures: [], endedMeasures, ...more }));
      expect(closing([ended({})])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")}`);
      expect(closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true })])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`);
      expect(closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R4" })])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT_R4}`);
      // Two resets of two fields: one field sentence each.
      expect(closing([ended({}, "reset_display_name"), ended({ oldValueKept: true })])[0]).toBe(
        `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_display_name.label}, ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("display name")} ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`,
      );
      // The closing decision resets the bio itself: its own reset's sentences speak for the field, and no field sentence is added.
      const own = closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true })], { outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R6", facts: "f", reason: "r", measures: [measure("reset_bio")] });
